lore: A majestic colossus sculpted from marble and brass, displaying the immortality and glory of a great civilization of old. Now, this statue stands slumbering within the undersea Faded Castle, awaiting the arrival of one who dares challenge the majesty of the ancient ruler.
attacks: Overture
Upon entering combat, leaps off its pedestal, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Geo Shield

The Legatus Golem is protected by a Geo shield that increases its RES to all DMG by 60%. The shield is weakest against Blunt Attacks. If the shield is destroyed, the Legatus Golem will become paralyzed for ~12 seconds before regaining its shield.
Melee Combo 1
Performs 2 slashes and a downward cleave, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK, 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Melee Combo 2
Performs 2 slashes, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK as Pyro DMG, then slams down its shield, causing cascading explosions that deal 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Melee Combo 3
Performs a stomp and a downward cleave, dealing 70% ATK, 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Melee Combo 4
Performs a stomp, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG, then slams down its shield, causing cascading explosions that deal 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Drive-By
Ignites its sword and charges towards the player, then performs an upward slash, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Triple Heatblades
Launches 3 vertical blades forward, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Resonant Detonation

Summons a resonator and charges. If hit 6 times, the resonator will be destroyed, reducing the Geo Shield's durability by 6.4 Gauge Units. If not destroyed in time, it will explode, dealing 90% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Fervorous Tune

Performs with its shield-violin and sword-bow, producing several small orbs that home towards the player, each dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG, followed by a final large orb, which deals 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Raining Melody
Performs with its shield-violin and sword-bow, producing 3 rings of musical notes that fall to the ground, each dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Fulgent Fortissimo

Causes 3 consecutive, expanding explosions, each dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. Then, raises its sword as it gathers immense energy, and performs one massive leaping strike, dealing 200% ATK as Pyro DMG in a straight line.

lore: A monster from the Abyss Order that wields frigid, icy blades in battle. Just as there are saints who will spread and glorify the profound gospel, there are envoys who must correct any twisted strains and remove any dissonance. People often say that steel feels like ice as it pierces the body, but this dark frost is said to freeze even the soul.
tips: An Abyss Order monster that uses a dark power to command ice and frost in battle. Some of its attacks decrease the Stamina of characters while dealing DMG against them.
attacks: Dark Frost Enchantment
Every time the Abyss Herald uses an attack, it has a chance to obtain an enchantment of dark frost.
Stance of Desolation
Readies its blade and prepares to attack, and performs different actions depending on its distance from the player:
Frigid Sweep
Charges before performing a wide-reaching circular slash, dealing 90% ATK as Cryo DMG. While shielded, this attack's AoE is increased, and the DMG dealt is increased to 100% ATK.
Wintry Rush
Slowly walks and brandishes its blade, then accelerates and rushes towards the player to perform a single slash, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Dark Frost Icicle

Fires a projectile from its blade that deals 78% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is guaranteed to receive Dark Frost Enchantment but will reduce the current probability of obtaining the enchantment by 61%.
Icy Dominion

After its HP reaches 20%, the Abyss Herald leaps into the air and slams down, dealing 200% ATK as Cryo DMG in a large area around itself, and imbues itself with a durable shield, providing it immunity to all DMG until its shield is broken.
The Dark Frost Falls

Leaps into the air and fires 2 waves of 4 projectiles at the ground, each dealing 66% ATK as Cryo DMG when it lands. This attack is guaranteed to receive Dark Frost Enchantment but will reduce the current probability of obtaining the enchantment by 100%.

lore: Servants of the Abyss Order that use Hydro in combat. These silent figures are the vanguard of the Abyss, brandishing Tidal Blades that can engulf everything in an instant, crumpling armor and obliterating heretics. They shall bring preordained damnation upon the foolish masses.
tips: An Abyss Order monster that uses a dark power to command warped torrents in battle. Some of its attacks increase the CD of characters' skills if they are currently in cooldown.
attacks: Rippling Slash Combo
Performs a series of slashes with its blade, dealing Hydro DMG.
Rippling Blades
Conjures a concentrated water projectile with its blade and fires it forward, each dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Torrential Shock
Raises both arms before unleashing a cross-shaped water projectile with its blades dealing 25% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Vortex Edge
Turns into a spinning wheel and charges at the player, rapidly dealing 40% ATK as Hydro DMG on contact. DMG from repeated hits may be reduced according to its Damage Sequence.
Watery Rebirth
After its HP reaches 20%, the Abyss Herald will imbue itself with a powerful Hydro shield, providing it immunity to all DMG until its shield is broken.
The Wicked Torrents
Slashes the air numerous times with its blade before unleashing 8 Hydro projectiles in a circular pattern, each dealing 25% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: Wielders of abyssal fire who pursue the meaning behind texts and scriptures. Is a member of the Abyss Order. The surface people have a slightly distorted understanding of what their name means, calling them "Lectors," when their name can also mean "exegete." Reading the word of grace grants them great power.
tips: A monster of the Abyss Order who sings of the warmth of the dark flames. Some of its attacks will apply the brand of the abyssal flame when they deal DMG to characters. These brands will explode after a short while, causing the whole party to lose large amounts of HP. You may be able to use Shields to prevent the brand from being applied. Your active character can succumb to HP loss resulting from the brands' explosions. When the Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames enters a state where it is defended by a shield of abyssal fire, destroy its Darkfire Furnace to deplete its shield more easily.
attacks: Brand of the Abyssal Flame

When certain attacks by the Abyss Lector deal DMG to the player, they will apply the Brand of the Abyssal Flame status to the player. Shortly after being applied, the Brand of Abyssal Flame expires, causing the entire party to lose HP.
Flame of Salvation
Conjures a large fireball which it throws at the player, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Sparking Flares
Summons 5 small flares above itself before shooting them at the player, each dealing 26.6% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Scorching Scriptures
When a character strays near to the Abyss Lector, it will release a powerful infernal wave around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Searing Precept

Summons 3 bursts of flame to flare up from the ground, dealing 26.6% ATK as Pyro DMG applying Brand of the Abyssal Flame to players who take DMG from this attack. This attack is used twice in a row when the Lector is shielded.
Fiery Rebirth

After its HP reaches 20%, the Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames will imbue itself with a powerful Pyro shield, providing it immunity to all DMG until its shield is broken. The shield is weakest to Hydro.
Ominous Star

Summons a meteor to crash into the ground, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG, leaving behind a Darkfire Furnace on impact. While the Darkfire Furnace is active, the Lector will be able to use The Fathomless Flames.
The Fathomless Flames

Summons many bursts of flame to flare up form the ground for the entire duration of the Darkfire Furnace, dealing 26.6% ATK as Pyro DMG and applying the Brand of the Abyssal Flame to players who take DMG from this attack.

lore: A monster who serves the Abyss Order and commands lightning while singing the praises of the darkness. These are the evangelists and the scholars of the Abyss. Their violent lightning strikes the hearts of unbelievers with dark wisdom, warped by the shadowy depths of an eternal night, its violet glow proclaiming the existence of a great power that corrodes human intellect.
tips: A creature of the Abyss Order that calls upon thunder and lightning in praise of the darkness. It possesses some ability to disrupt elemental powers, and some of its attacks will drain characters' Elemental Energy when dealing DMG to them.
attacks: Den of Thunder

Summons a falling bolt of Electro energy to strike its foe, dealing 66.6% ATK as Electro DMG. When below 60% HP it, will summon 2 consecutive bolts. When its shield is active, it will summon 3 consecutive bolts.
Wild Thunderburst

Conjures a wave of lightning bolts striking down in a line towards the player, dealing 53.3% ATK as Electro DMG. When its shield is active, it will unleash two waves of lightning at once, usually from different directions but sometimes in a straight line.
Thunderous Declaration
When a character strays near to the Abyss Lector, it will cause a powerful electro explosion around itself, 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Shock of the Enigmatic Abyss
Conjures 3 Electro orbs that launch towards the player's current position, dealing 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG. If this attack deals DMG to the player, also drains 20 Energy from each party member.
Electric Rebirth
After its HP reaches 20%, the Abyss Lector: Violet Lightning will imbue itself with a powerful Electro shield, providing it immunity to all DMG until its shield is broken.
The Violet Lightning
Summons many Electro orbs around it, after a short pause the orbs will be sent out in all directions and then stop for a second before exploding, dealing 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: This dragon-shaped combat machine is a being that inspires fear, much like the lord who once ruled these vast lands. It is said that the now-destroyed realm once sought forbidden knowledge and attempted to create perpetual-motion machines that could match or even surpass primordial lifeforms. This mysterious, tireless mechanical monstrosity seems to be proof that they did indeed reach heights that mortals should never have attained.
tips: A ruin machine that can absorb energy and hurl it back as an attack. This machine has even greater abilities than the Ruin Drake, being able to attack from the air and on the ground. The Aeonblight Drake can periodically release a dangerous torrent of energy and increase its own Elemental RES against the previous main type of Elemental DMG it has suffered. Under various circumstances, the cores all over its body will be exposed. Take such opportunities to attack those cores, and you may be able to immobilize this creature and remove its Elemental RES boost. Whenever this creature recovers from paralysis, it will switch between aerial and ground-attack forms.
attacks: Energy Surge
Charges before scattering a great number of bombs into the air, dealing 100% ATK when they land as Physical DMG or Elemental DMG matching the Aeonblight Drake's currently absorbed element.
Paralysis

During Energy Surge, Grounded Charge, and Missile Barrage, weak spots on the Aeonblight Drake's head or chest will be exposed. Two additional weak spots on both wings are also exposed while it is airborne.
Tail Sweep
Performs a sweeping attack with its tail, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Thruster Smash
Smashes the ground twice with its thrusters, dealing 75% ATK, 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Grounded Combo 1
Attacks twice with its nose, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Physical DMG and follows up with a Tail Sweep.
Grounded Combo 2
Performs Tail Sweep followed by Thruster Smash.
Grounded Charge

If the player is far away, charges at high speed towards the player, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. If this attack successfully hits, follows up with a Tail Sweep. While charging, the weak point on its head is exposed.
Machine Gun Volley
Fires off a volley in front of it, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Missile Barrage
Locks onto the player and fires a barrage of missiles, each dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG. During this attack, the weak point on its chest is exposed.
Airborne Charge

If the player is far away, charges at high speed towards the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. If this attack successfully hits, follows up with a tail sweep, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.

algorithm_of_semi_intransient_matrix_of_.special: Tomb Guard of the Desert King
lore: A perpetual motion machine that rules over the many constructs scattered throughout the desert. It seems that the lonely ruler's will still indwells this device. Perhaps due to a friend's teachings in a dream or perhaps because he coveted the power of the holy ones in the skies, the king created mysterious devices that should not exist in this world before founding his realm in these lands. Amidst the ruins of the City of the Pillars, the ancient crystals still reflect the glory of the golden paradise, though none now live who remember the king's dreams.
tips: This ancient aggregation of machinery hails from the desert and has quirks that modern-day civilizations cannot comprehend. In battle, the Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network will fire its components out while its core enters an "invisible" state that hides it and increases its RES. Use Catalyze reactions to strike this core, or use Electro attacks on it during such times as the fired components have been destroyed and need to recover to cancel this invisibility and cause the core to be immobilized due to overclocking. If you fail to cancel the core's invisibility for too long, the Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network will begin to display its power by using a mighty overclocked attack...
attacks: Laser Zone

Marks a large area, within which it fires countless lasers, each dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. After the laser zone dissipates, sweeps forwards with two more lasers that rapidly deal 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players touching them.
Invisible State
Leaves 2 types of parts on the field and becomes invisible, gaining +200% All RES.
Repulse
Generates a force shield that pushes the player away, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. This attack is used after recovering from a paralyzed state.
Reshape
Fires a bolt that strikes down at the player's location and drills into the ground, dealing 50% ATK, 70% ATK as as Physical DMG. This attack is used after recovering from a paralyzed state.
Prospect
Fires out a large energy beam at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is used after recovering from a paralyzed state.
Tracking Laser

Locks onto the player and fires a large tracking laser beam at the player, dealing 70% ATK as as Physical DMG. This attack is used if the player destroys a part but fails to hit it with Electro during the recovery state.
Laser Barrage
Fires many lasers at the ground in front of it, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is used if the player destroys a part but fails to hit it with Electro during the recovery state.
Missile Blast
Fires a large missile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is used if the player destroys a part but fails to hit it with Electro during the recovery state.
Overclocked Attack

If the Matrix stays in its invisible state for too long, gathers all of its parts and draws energy before releasing a large shockwave that expands outwards covering the entire arena, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG, then becomes paralyzed for a period of…

all_devouring_narwhal.special: Visitor From the Far Side of the Sea of Stars
lore: A mysterious and gargantuan creature from another world.
attacks: Leap

Leaps out of the ground and slams down towards the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. Cracks form on the ground around the impact area, transforming into a splash after a delay, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Penetrate

Cracks form on the ground below the player. The narwhal then penetrates through the ground, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. Several splashes then occur around the impacted area, each dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Dive
Dives down from above, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. Several splashes then occur around the impacted area, each dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Starfall Shower
Summons crystals to rain down from the sky across the arena, each dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Astral Downpour

Summons many beams of light to fall from the sky, each dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG on appearance and 12.5% ATK as Hydro DoT to characters standing in them. Repeated instances of the on-appearance DMG may be reduced down to 25% ATK due to the Damage Sequence.
Eye of Maelstrom
Summons an Eye of Maelstrom at the center of the arena. The eye will charge as it slowly pulls nearby players in, eventually exploding, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Ravaging Devourer
The narwhal starts the fight with an empty Fury bar:
Greatsword Strike
The Dark Shadow can perform 4 different attacks with its greatsword. All greatsword attacks can be chained consecutively in various sequences.
Eye of Maelstrom
Charges an attack using Pneumousia energy. If hit by an Arkhe-aligned attack while charging, the attack will be interrupted and the Dark Shadow will lose 25% of its Max HP.
Falling Thunder
Waves of lightning strikes will periodically land around the arena, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: The noblest and greatest of souls, who watches over the lupical of Wolvendom. When the wolfpack is imperiled, it will emerge in the form of a wolf and show forth its fangs and claws.

The wolves of Wolvendom are frightening phantoms to the people of Mondstadt: A blurred shape flashing through the forest, a chilling howl in the indeterminate distance, the creeping sense of eyes constantly nailed to their backs... Humans rarely have the opportunity to lock their eyes with a wolf, for this is the law Lupus Boreas laid down for its race.
attacks: Wolf Leap

Andrius jumps into the air and leaps toward the ice circle that appears on the ground, dealing 83.3% ATK as Cryo DMG and generating a Cryo Energy Orb. This attack cannot be dodged using Dash i-frames.
Wolf Charge
After charging for a while, Andrius will quickly dash towards the player, dealing 100% ATK Cryo DMG and leaving an ice trail in his wake.
Wolf Slash (Cryo)
Andrius raises his front legs and slashes towards his front, dealing 58.3% ATK as Cryo DMG to players around him.
Tail Sweep (Ranged)
Andrius raises his hind legs and sweeps his tail quickly while shooting small icicles towards the player, dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Spinning Slash

Andrius creates circular ice surfaces around him before spinning quickly, dealing 83.3% ATK as Cryo DMG (The actual range of slash is wider in front of him than behind him) and generating a Cryo Energy Orb. This attack cannot be dodged using Dash i-frames.
Repositioning
After attacking his hind legs, Andrius will reposition himself to face the player(s).
Push
At the start of Phase 2, pushes nearby player away from himself.
Frozen Pillars

At the start of Phase 2, 6 pillars and icy floor will be generated around the edge of the arena. The icy floor will deal 4.16% ATK as Cryo DoT to characters who step on it and reduce their Movement Speed by 12%.
Icicle Storm
Andrius charges for a while and summons icicles that fall from the sky, dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG. The fallen icicles cannot be dodged using Dash i-frames.
Wolf King Roar
Andrius charges for a while and then roars, dealing 0.83–2.5% ATK as Anemo DoT in a huge AoE around him. The DMG is higher the farther the player is from Andrius.
Wolf Slash (Anemo)
Andrius raises his front legs and slashes towards his front, dealing 58.3% ATK as Anemo DMG to players around him.
Tail Sweep (Melee)
Andrius raises his hind legs and sweeps his tail quickly, dealing 58.3% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Ice Waves

Andrius raises his front legs while creating an ice path in front of him that applies Cryo to characters that stand on it while drastically reducing their Movement Speed. Then releases ice waves on the path, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Wind Blades
Andrius raises his front legs, then summons 3 vertical wind blades in a 60-degree forward arc, dealing 41.6% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Small Phantom Wolf
Andrius summons a small phantom wolf to attack the player(s), dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG. The frequency of this attack will escalate as time progresses.

lore: Hilichurl wanderers who do not belong to any hilichurl tribe. It almost seems as if they are searching for the fated genesis of their kind, seeking to uncover some bygone splendor that once belonged to their people. If these monsters capable of only crude language and bereft of missing history could record their own epics and legends, the hilichurl wanderers would be the heroes in said tales.
tips: A mysterious hilichurl warrior that can manipulate Anemo to a certain degree. In battle, such hilichurls will enter a hovering state with the aid of Anemo Slimes. Attack these Anemo Slimes to shoot the Rogues down.
attacks: Single Slash
Swings its blade once, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Double Slash
Swings its blade twice, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Anemo DMG. If the player is still within melee range afterwards, follows up with a Single Slash.
Triple Throw
Transforms its blade into a shuriken and throws 3 spinning blades consecutively, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 85% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Shuriken Throw

Transforms its blade into a shuriken and throws it at the player. The shuriken will travel a certain distance before turning back to return to the Hilichurl Rogue, and deals 85% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Floating State

Summons an Anemo Slime and uses it to float. While floating, fires wind blades at the player thrice, dealing 80% ATK, 80% ATK, 100% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit. If the player hits the slime, the Hilichurl Rogue will fall down onto the ground.

lore: Code name: Beth. A high-purity Anemo entity. Elemental hypostases are life forms which have completely abandoned their former appearance and biological structure, making them able to reach the highest level of elemental purity. Research into hypostases is mainly led by scholars of Sumeru Akademiya, but due to the level of danger that they pose, little of substance is known about hypostases beyond their scientific name and code name.
tips: Elemental creatures who protect themselves from incoming attack with their durable shell. Find an opportune moment to land a blow to their elemental core. They are able to control their elemental orb in fights and restore their health when they feel threatened. If you fail to utilize the upcurrents to absorb these orbs, the battle will be significantly harder.
attacks: Crystalfly
Flies into the air and turns into a giant crystalfly, then causes a wind eruption below the player, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG and suspending the player in mid-air if hit.
Vacuum

Quickly flies next to the player and forms a ring of shell pieces that create a vacuum which pulls the player towards the core while dealing 25% ATK as Anemo DoT. It is hard, if not outright impossible to escape the pull.
Clap
Quickly flies next to the player and forms a large wall, which folds in a "clapping" motion very quickly, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG in an area in front of the wall.
Meteors

Moves to a location away from the player and sends pieces of its shell into the sky. Over the next few seconds, three total shell pieces will fall from the sky towards the player, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG and leaving updrafts where they land.
Missiles

Moves to a location away from the player and floats into the sky, forming a rhombus with its shell pieces. Then, it sucks shell pieces into its core to form and fire wind blasts that deal 75% ATK as Anemo DMG, it fires a total of 3 blasts.
Tornadoes
Teleports to the center of the arena and spirals high into the air, forming a tornado beneath it.
Vacuum Burst

Teleports next to the player and forms a spinning dome formation with its shell, which deals 10% ATK as Anemo DMG to players that come in contact. It will then proceed to absorb random orbs from the air, unleashing large shockwaves in the process.
Second Wind

When HP is low (approx. 5%), moves to the center of the arena and forms 4 large floating Anemo Orbs along with several updrafts. After some time (approx. 15 seconds), absorbs any Anemo Orbs that remain, healing a large portion of its HP (approx.

lore: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that spreads the message of Anemo. Hilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. Their ability to command the flowing winds stems from dark, forgotten memories.
attacks: Prayer to the Winds
Summons 3 small tornadoes that move in random directions, dealing 25% ATK as Anemo DMG to players that come in contact. The tornadoes will persist after the Samachurl is defeated.
Vacuum Trap
Creates a Vacuum Field at the player's location that sucks them towards the center but does not deal DMG.
Staff Strike
If the player is within melee range, swings its staff at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back. The Samachurl also falls in the process due to the staff's weight.
Enhancement
Certain enhanced Anemo Samachurls can be found in certain Domains, Spiral Abyss, overworld events and challenges. There are 2 possible types of enhancements:

lore: A small monster created by the coalescing of Anemo dispersed throughout nature. It is able to float in the air to a certain degree due to the power of Anemo.
attacks: Bump
Moves away and briefly inflates before shooting itself at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Fall Immunity
When knocked off the ground, the Anemo Slime will inflate and flap its wings to slowly float down, making them unable to take fall DMG.
Inflated
If the Anemo Slime takes DMG while inflated, it will be instantly defeated regardless of the amount of DMG dealt. However, it is still immune to Anemo DMG in this state.
Final Burst
When defeated, releases a short burst of wind, pushing the player back slightly before dropping any collectible loot.

lore: A monster birthed from a high concentration of Anemo that can float in the air. As reason might dictate, monsters made from coalesced Anemo already come equipped with the ability to float. As such, their petal-like wings are most likely to be a mimetic organ first and foremost.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury
Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated.
Wind Blast

Shoots two consecutive homing wind bolts that each deals 80% ATK as Anemo DMG. If at max Fury, instead shoots three non-homing bolts in a spread pattern, each dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG and becomes its only attack.
Puff Blow
Spins, puffs up, then releases a swirl of wind dealing 100% ATK as AoE Anemo DMG.
Final Burst

Explodes after a short pause when defeated dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG. If at max Fury, DMG is increased to 120% ATK, and leaves behind a Vacuum Field for 10 seconds that sucks in players and items while dealing 40% ATK as Anemo DoT.

lore: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles. From an evolutionary perspective, it is assumed that Fontemer Aberrants have developed from aquatic creatures due to environmental factors specific to Fontaine. As such, it can be inferred that at some point in the past, Fontaine's original aquatic lifeforms differed little from those native to the other regions of Teyvat.
attacks: Bubble Shot
Fires a bubble at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: Although the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering is the main organization involved in clockwork meka research and design, there are also many independent engineers and workshops that are not affiliated with the Research Institute. The first ever machine of this type was designed by an independent engineer to commemorate their lover and sponsor. In the end, it was acquired by the Maison Gardiennage as a tool to uphold municipal security — or, as some would have it, state apparatus enforcing the monopoly on violence.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Annihilation Specialist Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe twice will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Slash Kick
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Slashes once with its sword, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG, and optionally follows up with a kick, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG.
Summon Area Alert Mek

This ability is only used in Spiral Abyss and Imaginarium Theater. Summons an Area Alert Mek with same Arkhe alignment. The summoned Area Alert Mek will despawn when the Annihilation Specialist Mek is defeated.
Leaping Thunder
Dashes towards the player and performs a stab, a sweep and a leaping strike, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Lightning Raid
Summons 4 lightning strikes, with each strike dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack can be used twice quick succession.
Whirling Legblades
Performs 2 kicks, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Hydro DMG, then does an upside-down spin to launch 3 Ceaseless Blades at the player, each dealing 35% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Bladed Waltz
Spins rapidly on one leg towards the player, dealing 60% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack can be used twice in quick succession.

lore: A mechanism that is able to fire out the energy produced by an annihilation reaction. Strictly speaking, it was originally a test device that emerged from research undertaken by the Institute of Natural Philosophy before the Fontaine Research Institute had been established. As such, despite its considerable commercial success as a sentinel and defensive device, most engineers do not consider it to be a true clockwork meka.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and its combat capabilities.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Area Alert Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to attack for a period of time.
Explosive Bubble
Fires a bubble at the player, which explodes on hit, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Cryo Projectile
Fires 3 consecutive projectiles at the player, each dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A clockwork meka designed to transmit and enhance signals. The power that drives this clockwork meka is generated from a controlled annihilation reaction between ousia and pneuma in the kinetic core. As a result, overloading it with excessive energy will cause its original equilibrium to be disrupted.
tips: A machine created to complement the energy defects and increase the operational efficiency of clockwork meka. The ousia or pneuma energies have different enhancive effects, and this machine can also periodically generate energy, allowing it to replenish the power of nearby disabled clockwork meka that shares a similar energy source. After their energy is annihilated by an attack charged with the opposite signature, it will induce an Overloaded state and cause the machine to lose energy, requiring the machine to spend time on Self-Repairs before it can restore its energy generation functions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Arithmetic Enhancer Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become stunned for a short period of time.
Tail Swipe
This attack is used when there are no Clockwork Meka with identical Arkhe alignment nearby. Attacks using its tail, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
ATK Increase
If there are -aligned Clockwork Meka nearby, enters support mode and increases their ATK by 20%.
Restore Pneuma
If a nearby -aligned Clockwork Meka has their Arkhe annihilated, the Arithmetic Enhancer Mek will restore their Arkhe.
RES Increase
If there are -aligned Clockwork Meka nearby, enters support mode and increases their RES to all DMG by 20%.
Restore Ousia
If a nearby -aligned Clockwork Meka has their Arkhe annihilated, the Arithmetic Enhancer Mek will restore their Arkhe.
Arkhe-Powered
The Local Legend is powered by . Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe while it is not shielded will cause it to lose Arkhe and become stunned for a short period of time.
Geo Shield

The Local Legend protects itself with a Geo shield that grants it a 200% increase to all RES while active and protects it from Annihilation Reactions caused by attacks. The shield is weakest against Blunt Attacks.
Gravity Reduction Field
The Local Legend has a Gravity Reduction Field around it while Arkhe is available, which greatly boosts the jumping height of characters within.
Gravity Ripple

Periodically sends out a shockwave that expands outwards that can be jumped over, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG on hit. If used the second time during a single Gravity Reduction Field, releases three consecutive shockwaves at the end.
Enhanced Attack 2

Consecutively detonates multiple explosions around itself, each dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG and spawns several rocks midair. The rocks then fire themselves at the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Enhanced Attack 3
Marks areas on the ground where rocks emerge from the ground after a short delay, dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Tail Swipe
Attacks using its tail, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when Arkhe is unavailable.

lore: A crab that makes its home in borrowed shells. It seems not to have any of the aggressiveness possessed by many wild animals. Perhaps it is because animals who attack for purposes other than obtaining food possess some degree of territoriality, yet the territory of the Armored Crab is naught but the small home upon its back.

Alongside the Recon Log Mek, this was one of the first new-type clockwork meka to be made (though of course, after hundreds of years, no one refers to them as "new-type" anymore — this was simply to differentiate them from traditional clockwork mechanisms that were powered by potential energy.) It was named to commemorate a friend of its inventor, and was originally designed to help people. However, its ability to attack people — thereby avoiding the need to put friendly personnel at risk — subsequently came to be seen as its real strength.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Assault Specialist Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe twice will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Up-Close Pummelling
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Performs a downward smack with its baton, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.
Double Strike
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Attacks with its baton and shield, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Offensive Shieldstrike
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Dashes forward and attacks with its shield, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Multi-Smash
Swings its baton 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 70% ATK, 90% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Sprinting Strike
If the player is far away, dashes towards the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. This may be followed by another dash, or a single melee strike that deals 90% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Slam
Performs a jumping slam its shield, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG.
Shield Riposte
Performs a sweep and a slam with its shield, dealing 60% ATK, 90% ATK as Electro DMG.
Shield Sweep
Performs 3 sweeps with its shield, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 60% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: An enormous dragon as ancient as the mountains themselves. In an age that has all but faded from memory, he stood shoulder to shoulder with one who ruled over a harbor of stone. But in the end, the two came into conflict, and the dragon was banished to a dark place deep underground. Over the long years of his imprisonment, his power has slowly dissipated. He has also become disfigured from the various kinds of erosion he has been subjected to. The faint rattling of this dragon lord's shackles and his deep, angry growl echo through the bowels of the mountains like memories of a bygone era.
attacks: Earthen Skull
Slams his head and unleashes ground explosions that move in a straight line, dealing 33.3% ATK on impact and 66.6% ATK with each explosion as Geo DMG.
Body Slam
Slams his body sideways, dealing 66.6% ATK as Geo DMG in a large area that extends towards the attack's direction. This attack cannot be avoided using dash i-frames.
Seismo-Waves
Slams his foreleg once and emits three consecutive shockwaves, dealing 33.3% ATK, 16.6% ATK, 16.6% ATK as Geo DMG with each shockwave respectively.
Decimating Rockfall
Jumps, then greatly impacts the earth and leaves cracked earth that will explode twice around him in a large AoE. The second explosion has a larger AoE than the first. Deals 50% ATK * 2 as Geo DMG.
Tail Slam
Slams his tail once if target is behind him, dealing 66.6% ATK as Geo DMG.
Sweeping Branch
Performs a quick sweep attack, dealing 66.6% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack cannot be avoided using dash i-frames.
Sundering Charge

Rushes forward, goring enemy units on with his tusks and tossing them into the air. The impact and the toss deal 33.3% ATK and 66.6% ATK as Geo DMG respectively. This attack cannot be avoided using dash i-frames.
Burrow
Submerges underground and digs around the arena. This action will trigger a massive earthquake and many rocks will rains to the arena for a while, dealing 33.3% ATK as Geo DMG.
Primeval Spring
Spawns a line of Elemental-infused stones towards the target. The stones will explode shortly upon impact. The impact and explosion deal 16.6% ATK and 33.3% ATK respectively as Geo DMG.
Phase Transition

Upon reaching 75% HP, Azhdaha performs Tremors before entering a brief invulnerability phase and infuses an element (Hydro or Pyro), gaining an additional 60% Elemental Resistance to this infused Element, resulting in a total of 70% Elemental Resistance to…
Pyro/Hydro Mark
When Azhdaha deals Pyro or Hydro DMG to an unshielded character, a mark will appear on that character that persists for as long as that character is affected by that element.
Tremors

Slams his legs unto earth, unleashing continuous shockwaves around him for 5 times and ending with one final huge shockwave. The first 5 shockwaves each deal 50% ATK and the final shockwave deals 66.6% ATK, as Geo DMG.
The King's Rebuke
Roars and initiates a large AoE attack of the infused element.
Phase Transition

Upon reaching 45% HP, Azhdaha performs Tremors before entering a brief invulnerability phase and infuses an element (Electro or Cryo), gaining an additional 50% Elemental Resistance to this infused Element, resulting in a total of 60% Elemental Resistance…
Electro/Cryo Mark
When Azhdaha deals Electro or Cryo DMG to an unshielded character, a mark will appear on that character that persists for as long as that character is affected by that element.
Moonlit Wave

Submerges underground while leaving his tail on the surface. Azhdaha cannot be killed in this state, but can still be damaged. If Azhdaha's HP reaches 0 in during this attack, one extra hit will be required to kill him once he reappears above ground.
Thunder Sphere
Forms several Thunder Spheres and launches them towards the target, each dealing 46.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Fractal Lance
Forms a Cryo Sphere in the air, that will then periodically summon 4 crystal lances 5 times, homing towards the target, dealing 46.6% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit.

lore: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles. The ability to fire water bombs is of course not uncommon among Fontemer Aberrants. But for your average careless diver, most of whom are tourists, a high-pressure water current of this kind can pose a significant threat. The thickness of diving equipment is therefore necessary for two reasons — firstly, to resist the pressure of the water itself, but secondly, to protect against the attacks of Fontemer Aberrants.
attacks: Water Gun
Fires a stream of water that deals 86% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Pounce
If the player is too close, springs backwards and deals 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Taunt
Crosses its arms, shakes its head in disapproval, and yawns.

biting_cold_wayob_manifestation.special: Envoy of Night and Wandering Spirits
lore: The Masters of the Night-Wind believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls. The Masters of the Night-Wind have tried using many mediums to communicate with the Night Kingdom. Eventually, they discovered that the medium that allowed them to establish the most stable connection with the Wayob was obsidian. This may explain why, over the ages, Wayob Manifestations have taken on a form that resembles a stone statue. The Masters of the Night-Wind believe their Wayob has the power to control the process of freezing and crystallization, and can also command both fixedness and mutability.
tips: The Wayob worshipped by the various tribes of Natlan manifest themselves in the form of these obsidian totems. In battle, the Wayob Manifestation will deploy its Arena: Moment of Trial, creating a Shield for itself and absorbing the Elemental Energy of all characters in the Arena. Characters in the Arena deal greatly increased DMG. If the Shield is broken before the Arena expires, they will also regain a large amount of Energy. However, if they fail to break the Shield, the Manifestation will generate an Elemental Ward based on the value of the remaining Shield.
attacks: Blizzard
Causes blizzard to rain down in a circular area, repeatedly dealing 20% ATK as Cryo DMG every 0.3 seconds for 1.5 seconds. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Biting Storm

Releases a windstorm in a cone-shaped area in front of itself, repeatedly dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG every 0.3 seconds for 6 seconds. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Rupturing Blast
Charges and fires a beam of energy, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Arena: Moment of Trial
Deploys an Arena and gains a non-elemental shield equal to 111.4% of the Wayob Manifestation's Max HP which can be destroyed by dealing DMG.
Penetrating Chill

Charges before releasing a blast across the entire arena that causes the active character to lose 60% of their Max HP. This will bypass i-frames, including HP-locking i-frames from sources like Elemental Bursts.
Protection Spirit
Creates an inactive Protection Spirit. When any character in the party restores HP, the Protection Spirit will also restore the same amount of HP.

lore: A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker." Though Truthseeker is, strictly speaking, a sword art, its teachings can also be used with various other weapons — and in the realm's darkest hour, those who had to protect their homeland had little room to be fussy anyway.
tips: This seems to have once been a trusted guard of high standing in some land who wielded the power of Geo. Its attacks become stronger and fiercer when they hit shielded characters, at the cost of its own health.
attacks: Dual Ax Combo
Performs 2 ax swings followed by a downward cleave with both axes, dealing 70% ATK, 85% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Whirling Sweep
Combines its axes and and performs 2 spinning sweeps, dealing 75% ATK, 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Shield Slam
Combines its axes into a shield and slams it down in front of him, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and protects itself against attacks from the front for a short period of time.
Guardian Greatshield
If there is a Shadowy Husk nearby (Black Serpent Knights do not count), rushes towards the Shadowy Husk, combines its axes, and forms a large shield that blocks all DMG from the front.
Rockbreaking Rampage

If one of the Black Serpent Knight: Rockbreaker Ax's attacks is fully absorbed by a player's Shield (does not count if the shield breaks as a result of the attack), the attack will be interrupted and it will enter the Rockbreaking Rampage state for 11…
Frenzied Spin

Performs 5 spinning sweeps, dealing 80% ATK with the first 4 spins and 100% ATK with the final spin as Geo DMG. This attack is only used under the Rockbreaking Rampage state if the player is less than 7 m away.
Frenzied Charge
Charges at the player and performs an upward cleave, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack is only used under the Rockbreaking Rampage state if the player is 7 m or farther away.

lore: A guard of some standing in the court, sundering the foes of the nation's rulers using a sword art known as "Truthseeker." The Twilight Sword was once one of their number. That realm's glory has been extinguished, never again to be reclaimed.
tips: This seems to have once been a trusted guard of high standing in some land who wielded the power of the winds. Its attacks become faster and stronger when they hit shielded characters, at the cost of its own health.
attacks: Blink

If one of the Black Serpent Knight: Windcutter's attacks is fully absorbed by a player's Shield (does not count if the shield breaks as a result of the attack), it will gain a temporary buff at the cost of 15% of its Current HP, which increases its ATK by…
2-Slash Combo
Performs 2 consecutive slashes, dealing 80% ATK with each slash as Anemo DMG. The combo may end early if the player leaves its range.
3-Slash Combo
Performs 3 consecutive slashes, dealing 60% ATK, 80% ATK, 80% ATK with each slash respectively as Anemo DMG. The combo may end early if the player leaves its range.
Whirling Windblades

Loosens their sword and launches several spinning blades forward before retracting them. The spinning blades deal 60% ATK when launching and retracting as Anemo DMG and deal 40% ATK as Anemo DMG upon contact.
Windspike Whipsmash
Loosens their sword and slams it in a whip-like fashion, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Swiftwind Seekers
Forms 6 projectiles before launching them at the player consecutively, each dealing 30% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.

lore: Muscular hilichurls who wield large two-handed axes. Attacks with large strikes, and will use Pyro Slimes to infuse their axes with Pyro. They are very lethal. Usually, repeatedly quenching a weapon the way a Blazing Axe Mitachurl does will decrease the hardness of the metal and cause the axe-head's edge to chip more easily. But such is the strength of the mitachurls that even should the edge disappear altogether, they can still use their axes as hammers.
attacks: Swing Combo
Swings its axe twice, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG with each swing.
Flowfire Edge + Pyro Slime Toss

After some time has passed or when the player character is out of reach, the Blazing Axe Mitachurl will dig up Pyro Slimes from the ground to infuse their axe with Pyro before throwing it to the player, dealing 37.5% ATK as Physical DMG.
Axe Spin
Spins the axe wildly, rapidly dealing 12.5% ATK as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG. At the end of this attack, performs a powerful final swing, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG.
Axe Slam

Leaps into the air to slam down at the player's location with their axe, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG. When the axe is infused, it will emit 5 trails of 3 fiery blasts around it which each deal 16.5% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Pyro Slime Throw
If the character is at a differing elevation from the Mitachurl, throws an ignited Pyro Slime at them, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Burning Damage Immunity
The Blazing Axe Mitachurl is immune to damage dealt by the Burning Elemental Reaction (but not the reaction itself) and damage from burning grass.

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Pyro, resulting in its present form. One of the manifestations with the most violent temperament, even at the frigid edges of the world, it is wreathed in unquenchable flame. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Pyro Aura
While not in the Gloomveiled state, the Frostnight Scion has an immutable Pyro aura.
Slash
Performs a slash with its left wing, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. If in the Gloomveiled state, may perform another slash and a cross slash with both wings, dealing 80% ATK, 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Flying Slam
Flies into the air and slams down onto the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Stomp
Stomps the ground in front of it with its front legs, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Gloomveil

Periodically enters a Gloomveiled state, increasing its RES to all DMG except Pyro by 50%, enhancing its attacks, and gaining the ability to relocate by disappearing and reappearing, but also losing its immunity to Pyro (Pyro RES in this state is 100%).
Back Kick
Performs a kick with its hind legs, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Fireball
Shoots a large fireball at the player, dealing 90% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack is only used while in the Gloomveiled state.

lore: A type of mammal that resides in the watery regions of Fontaine. It communicates with its companions through melodious sounds. Due to its density, water is a much more efficient medium of sound than air. Drawing inspiration from the Blubberbeast, someone from the Research Institute invented a type of technology that converted images into data to facilitate instant transmission. But due to the technical limitations of the experiment, it never became widely adopted outside the Institute. In reality, however, data transmission technology based on fluid and sound has existed since ancient times. As the saying goes, there's nothing new under the sun.
attacks: Belly Drum
Slaps its belly to produce 3 slow-moving sound waves, each dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.
Tail Slap
If rudely interrupted while resting, raises then slams down its tail, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Invisibility
Turns invisible and moves around while repeatedly firing slow-moving projectiles at the player, each dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Belly Drum
Slaps its belly to produce 1 to 3 slow-moving projectiles, each dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Cleansing Shower

Forms an orb within their mouth and launches it at the player. On hit, the orb deals 5% ATK as Electro DMG and drains 10 Energy from the active character. If the active character has less than 10 Energy, inflicts HP Loss.
Spinning Sweep
Curls up and quickly spins, dealing 30% ATK * 2 as Electro DMG.
Homing Shards
Forms an orb in front of it that fires a spread of three bolts after a moment. The bolts will then shoot themselves towards the player's position, dealing 30% ATK as Electro DMG.
Slash Combo
If the player is within melee range, performs 2 horizontal slashes followed by a downward smash, dealing 30% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK respectively as Physical DMG with each hit.

lore: The adult form of a male Bubbly Seahorse. It is extremely aggressive. Some people even claim to have encountered the king among the seahorses. It is said that they are proud beings with four long limbs.
tips: An aquatic life form that has embarked on a unique evolutionary track due to Fontaine's environmental factors. When under the effects of Electro, it can unleash fiercer elemental attacks and will possess even stronger defensive capabilities. If you use Elemental Reactions to remove its Elemental Ward, things should be easier to handle.
attacks: Bubble Spit
Shoots a projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Electro Shield
The Bubbler Seahorse possesses an Electro shield that grants it 60% RES to all DMG and enhanced attacks. The shield can be destroyed using Elemental Reactions.
Lightning Bolt
Charges and unleashes a single lightning bolt, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Ball Lightning
Conjures a slow-moving orb that travels forward and explodes, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG.
Homing Bolts
Unleashes 2 projectiles that home towards the player, each dealing 35% ATK as Electro DMG.
Bubble Spit
This attack is only used while unshielded. Shoots a projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.

lore: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles. Among the (admittedly somewhat sparse) ranks of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts, Bubbly Seahorses have many fans. As with clockwork meka enthusiasts, a small minority of Fontemer Aberrant enthusiasts can be very standoffish when it comes to people whose opinions differ from their own.
attacks: Bubble Spit
Shoots 2–3 projectiles at the player, each dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.

burning_aflame_wayob_manifestation.special: Envoy of Night and Wandering Spirits
lore: The Flower-Feather Clan believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls. They say that long ago, Wayob Manifestations looked very different from how they do today, taking on a rougher form that was more akin to that of an obsidian statue. But once their outline had been recorded in woven scrolls, there have been few changes in their appearance since. The people of the Flower-Feather Clan believe their Wayob has the power to control fire and burning flames, and can also control the flow of heat and blazing winds.
tips: The Wayob worshipped by the various tribes of Natlan manifest themselves in the form of these obsidian totems. In battle, the Wayob Manifestation will deploy its Arena: Moment of Trial, creating a Shield for itself and absorbing the Elemental Energy of all characters in the Arena. Characters in the Arena deal greatly increased DMG. If the Shield is broken before the Arena expires, they will also regain a large amount of Energy. However, if they fail to break the Shield, the Manifestation will generate an Elemental Ward based on the value of the remaining Shield.
attacks: Airstrike
Summons 6 consecutive beams of energy to strike down at the player's location, each dealing 30% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Flashing Blaze
Fires 9 fast-moving homing projectiles at the player, each dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Rupturing Blast
Charges and fires a beam of energy, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Arena: Moment of Trial
Deploys an Arena and gains a non-elemental shield equal to 111.4% of the Wayob Manifestation's Max HP which can be destroyed by dealing DMG.
Rotor Spin
Performs a spinning attack, dealing 20% ATK × 3 as Physical DMG.
Shattering Box
Marks a rectangular area, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG after a delay.
Eruption

Marks a circular area at the player's location and causes an eruption after a delay, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. The eruption leaves behind a pool of fire that lasts for 35s and deals 10% Character Max HP as True Pyro DMG every 0.5s to characters within it.
Infernal Skyfire 1

Returns to the center of the arena and begins charging, continuously causing eruptions on the floor which each deal 70% ATK as Pyro DMG. Gaseous Phlogiston Currents will appear around the edge of the arena, which allow the player to glide up.
Infernal Skyfire 2
Returns to the center of the arena, levitates into the air and begins charging, continuously causing eruptions on the floor which each deal 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A cunning Volkodlak that disguises its hand cannon as a tree trunk. Skilled at disguising the weapons and cargo they carry, they are often entrusted with transporting goods or relaying intelligence. The hand cannon they carry was likely something they made in their spare time. At times, they also use it to fire signal rounds disguised as fireworks. Don't be fooled by their appearance. These fae are far more shrewd and cunning than they seem.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Single Shot
Fires a single shot from its trunk cannon, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Shot
Fires three shots from its trunk cannon, each shot dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cleave
If the player is too close to the Channel Contact, it will raise its cannon and slam the bladed edge down on the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cannon Barrage
Drops its trunk cannon behind it and imbues itself with Dendro. The cannon will launch six shots that target the player's position in a small AoE, with each shot dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.

lore: The adult form of an Angelic Sea Hare. The "wings" on its back are actually fat used for storing elemental energy. This type of sea creature spends its whole life eating and conserving energy far beyond its actual requirements. Perhaps if the oceans dry out some day, they will be able to continue to survive — or simply become an important source of nutrition for other creatures...
tips: An aquatic life form that has embarked on a unique evolutionary track due to Fontaine's environmental factors. When under the effects of Cryo, it can unleash fiercer elemental attacks and will possess stronger defensive capabilities. If you use Elemental Reactions to remove its Elemental Ward, things should be easier to handle.
attacks: Bubble Shot
Fires a bubble at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Spinning Charge
Charges at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Archangel Protection
The Cherubic Sea Hare possesses a shield that grants it 60% RES to all DMG and enhanced attacks. The shield can be destroyed using Elemental Reactions.
Bubble Shot
Fires a bubble at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack is only used while not shielded.
Spinning Charge
Charges at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Snowball Shot
Fires a homing projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while shielded.
Iced Jelly Blast
Charges then releases a blast around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while shielded.
Bubble Shot
Fires a bubble at the player, dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Spinning Charge

Charges at the player up to twice in succession, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. If it is hit by the Xenochromatic Jellyfish's ability during this attack, the attack will be interrupted and it will lose 15% of its Max HP.
Bubble Volley

Charges and fires 6 bubbles at the player, each dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG. If it is hit by the Xenochromatic Jellyfish's ability during this attack, the attack will be interrupted and it will lose 15% of its Max HP.

lore: "Childe" Tartaglia, Eleventh of the Fatui Harbingers. He draws power from the ominous Delusion he possesses and fights using martial arts that he learned in a land of darkness.

He is a pure warrior with an insatiable lust for battle. Each bloody conflict, each life-and-death struggle is a delightful trial to him. People say that the young Childe is famed throughout the land for his battle prowess. But he has never taken big talk of this kind to heart.

After all... "You shall ever be the eye of the storm, "And the clashing of steel shall ever accompany you. "The pitch-black memory of stepping into uttermost darkness, "Shall, at last, become the strength by which you will overturn this world."
attacks: Riptide (Hydro)
Most attacks that hit the player will leave a Riptide mark.
Rapid Fire
Performs consecutive shots with a bow at the player, dealing 35% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Airstrike (Riptide)
Performs multiple consecutive shots with a bow upwards that fall to deal 75% ATK as Hydro DMG, consuming Riptide on hit.
Shark Waves
Unleashes at least 2 and up to 6 consecutive shark-shaped waves with a bow, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG and applying Riptide.
Slide
Slides quickly to any point of the arena to reposition himself, or slides to the player's location and performs a forward slash, dealing 62.5% ATK as Hydro DMG and consuming Riptide.
Hydro Shield

When hit by melee attacks, creates a Hydro shield that blocks all incoming DMG. If attacked while shielded, there is a 13% chance for Childe to drop the shield and performs a spinning slash, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Hydro Counter
Shoots out a huge Hydro energy blast in front of him that deals 150% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Blast (Hydro)
Unleashes explosive energy around himself that launches players away from him but dealing no DMG.
Staggered

If Childe sustains enough poise damage, he will enter a staggered state with significantly lowered RES and Interruption Resistance until he performs Blast. Poise damage can stack even when Childe is shielded.

lore: A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster. If a four-legged beast were given a carapace and charging horn like those of an Onikabuto, it might well become a shock force capable of breaking through enemy formations. In theory, man-made monsters designed around a single function rarely survive in the wild. Once they lose the place or purpose for which they were made, most perish for having defied the laws of nature. Clearly, however, the Armored Beast is not one of them. Today, on the frozen lands of Snezhnaya, Armored Beasts can often be seen hunting in packs.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Combo
Performs a three-part attack consisting of a claw swipe, a ram, and a swing, dealing ?% ATK, ?% ATK and 30% ATK as Physical DMG, respectively

Crystal Shot

Condenses its elemental energy into a Rock Crystal and fires it at the player, causing it to home in on them and deal ?% ATK as Geo DMG. If affected by a Stellar Glimmer Reaction, the ability is interrupted and drops ? Geo Elemental Particles.

lore: A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster. If a monster that burrows and moves through earth and snow were granted vision that could see all within the shadows, could it become an even stronger predator? The experiment proved astonishingly successful. These Burrowbeasts move beneath the surface at night, digging traps in the dark or hiding in the shadows to hunt. According to a report in Vestnik, a worker living in Svetloledovka once saw a giant Burrowbeast nearly as tall as two people... though that is probably nothing more than a wild rumor.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!

Charges up an energy projectile before launching it at the player. This shot will track the player at moderate speed and if hit by it, will deal ?% ATK as Electro DMG.

Burrow

lore: A product of bio-alchemy, a man-made monster with an exceptionally unusual formation. A man-made monster not formed according to its creator's design, but through the spontaneous assembly of life segments. As a result, it came to possess certain wondrous traits, including the ability to freely wield elemental power. Even if life is broken down until almost nothing remains but segments, could some will or power still guide them to grow according to a mysterious plan? Perhaps no one knows the answer to that by now.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!

lore: A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster. A short-legged elephant with wings could likely migrate without being restricted by terrain, and would also be able to reach fruit growing in higher places. For that purpose alone, its creator brought such a beast into being. Later, during the war against the dark tide, Chimeric Winged Elephants worked alongside the Vila in intelligence and communications, ensuring that the Belyi Tsar's commands could pass smoothly and swiftly as his army advanced.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!

lore: A product of bio-alchemy, one of the man-made monsters that was abandoned. To bring a certain great wish to fruition, an alchemist created numerous primordial bodies known as "Prototypes" through a technique that must never be retold. Of these, only one successfully grew into the perfect creation he had planned. The others, though close to perfection, ultimately failed, and were carelessly remade into two-headed monsters. Though regarded as failures, these special two-headed monsters still possess tremendous power. Among chimeras, there is nothing that can stand against them.
tips: The Chimeric Winged Lion will oscillate between two enhanced states: "Thundercall" and "Galeforce." When it is in the Thundercall state, it will become weakened when its Elemental Ward is broken. Additionally, any attempts by it to spread its thunder blades can be disrupted by the Stellar Glimmer reaction. When it is in the Galeforce state, it will attempt to absorb any Anemo Orbs that are on the field to charge its attack. At this time, destroying the orbs or using the Stellar Glimmer reaction can stop its charging and weaken it.
attacks: Thundercall

Upon initiating combat, enters a Thundercall state, generating a Electro Ward and placing an immutable Electro aura on itself. This ward is weakest to Cryo, Pyro and Dendro attacks, although Stellar Glimmer Reactions are most effective in depleting the ward.
Double Swipe
Swipes in front of it with its claws twice, dealing 30%, 30% ATK as Anemo DMG. If player still close nearby, it will perform an additional sword swipe, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG.
Sweeping Slash

Flies up into the air and summons a sword in its mouth before crashing into the player's position, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. If player stands nearby, it will follow an extra sword attack, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG.
Homing Orbs
Summons five Electro orbs above it before launching them at the player, with each orb dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG. Repeated hits are reduced accordingly to the Damage Sequence.
Pulsating Blast

Plunges a thunder sword into the ground, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG in a large AoE. The lion head will then discharge energy onto the blade, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG , and repeating the AoE attack thrice.
Homing Arrows
Flies into the air and summons eight Anemo arrows. The arrows are launched once the last arrow is generated, and they will target the player's position upon being fired, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Thunderstorm Chimeric Roar
Discharges a powerful flurry of energy from its mouth, dealing 50% ATK; the lion head deals Anemo DMG, while the falcon head deals Electro DMG.
Galeforce

Summons five Anemo orbs around it, initiating a charging sequence and a Fury bar. These orbs can be destroyed by using any Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo attack on them. Each leftover orb will fill the gauge by 1/3.

lore: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land." These walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Their close-combat-oriented rotating blades allow them to deal fatal damage to their foes and shred shrubbery and obstacles to open the way, allowing units to operate with ease even amidst thick vegetation.
attacks: Slash
Slashes at the player with its saw, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Shred
Slowly moves toward the player while spinning its saw in front of it, dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG every 0.2s to players in contact with the saw.
Kuuvahki Multi-Thrust Assault
Infuses its saw with kuuvahki before slowly moving toward the player while spinning its saw in front of it, dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG every 0.2s to players in contact with the saw.

lore: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land." Equipped with Crawler Track Movement Mechanisms, these Landcruisers are normally used to storm enemy positions, where they can pass over rough terrain such as mud and melting snow despite heavy armor and armaments through their excellent load-bearing capabilities and off-road mobility. When close-combat Landcruisers approach enemy defensive lines in formation, rotating blades raised for battle, most foes will concentrate fire on them, allowing other units the opportunity to unleash their firepower...

consecrated_fanged_beast.special: The Lush One, Devourer of the Mighty
lore: A predator that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms. Survival of the fittest is written in the law of nature. But pets and Consecrated Beasts are exceptions. Human beings' baits and the remains of immortal beings are essentially deliberate or unintentional traps. The price of coveting the gift of the strongest is much more painful than being locked in a cage.
tips: A predator that was warped and transformed by its consumption of the body of a mighty life-form. During combat, it will enter the powerful Phagocytic form. Some of its attacks will unleash Phagocytic Energy Blocks. Use the corresponding elemental attacks to destroy these Energy Blocks to absorb the power within them, which can then be unleashed when attacking the Consecrated Fanged Beast, dealing significant DMG and paralyzing the creature temporarily.
attacks: Phagocytic Form
Enters Phagocytic Form immediately when in combat, increasing its Dendro RES by 60% and all other RES by 30%.

Attacks with its claw then its head, dealing 60% ATK, 70% ATK as Dendro DMG then leaps and launches 3 trails of vines that each deal 80% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.

Performs 3 rapid claw strikes and 2 slower claw strikes, dealing 30% ATK × 3, 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.

The Consecrated Fanged Beast possesses 50% Freeze Resistance at all times, decreasing the effectiveness of the Frozen Elemental Reaction.

lore: A reptile that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms. Though now imbued with the power of elemental manipulation, the Consecrated Beasts themselves still cannot fully digest the pieces of flesh they devoured from the immortal carcasses that they ate. Instead, the pieces slowly fused with the beasts themselves, weaving a bony shell over their body, one that shares a similar composition to a certain type of smelting material from Inazuma.

lore: A reptile that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms. Majestic beasts are sometimes revered by human beings as the embodiment of a greater power, their visages turned to analogy to feed in reference to a person, feeding their ego. However, the majority of beasts that have absorbed the "greater power" were slain by the overwhelming nature of the power itself. Only a few among their number evolved new forms.

consecrated_red_vulture.special: The Burning One, Devourer of the Mighty
lore: A scavenging bird of prey that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms. The greater lifeforms devoured by Consecrated Beasts often have nigh-immortal consciousness that can never be fully silenced or eradicated. The very power and consciousness gained by Consecrated Beasts devouring these lifeforms will, in turn, drive them to seek more violence and carrion.

consecrated_scorpion.special: The Fulgurous One, Devourer of the Mighty
lore: An arthropod that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms. Lifeforms are governed by the laws of evolution, Consecrated Beasts exploited these rules by being fortunate enough to discover a long-dead carcass of a greater being before any of their competition ever did. Animals and humans often have far more in common than the latter is willing to acknowledge.

Spikes

lore: A type of large clockwork meka which also has immeasurable value when utilized in building construction and archeological excavation. Its name comes from an engineer employed by Callas during the construction of the Clementine Line. With Callas' financial backing, this engineer built the legendary "Golden Vessel" — a gigantic piece of construction machinery which was used to dig the Poisson Tunnel. Once the job was complete, this type of clockwork meka was designed with a similar structure but reduced to a smaller scale.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Construction Specialist Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe twice will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Melee Attack
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Strikes the ground with both of its mechanical arms, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Melee
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Strikes the ground 3 times successively, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Ranged Attack
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Fires a single bomb at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Pizza Cutter
Lowers its arm down to the ground, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG, charges forward with its gear spinning, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit, then raises its arm again, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Spin
Lowers its arm and spins rapidly, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Rapid Frostfire
Continuously fires ice projectiles at the player, each dealing 20% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Crane Smash
Performs a swing and a downward smash with its mechanical arm, dealing 75% ATK, 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: The crownless kings of Enkanomiya await the challenge of a true hero. Defeat the Rimebiter Bathysmal Vishap and the Bolteater Bathysmal Vishap to prove your valor.
attacks: Cleansing Shower
Forms an orb within their mouth and launches it at the player. On hit, the orb deals 5% ATK as Cryo DMG or Electro DMG and drains 30 Energy from the active character.
Spike Field

One of the vishaps plugs its tail into the ground, creating a large field, within which ice shards or Electro Energy frequently spike from the ground at random locations, dealing 60% ATK as Cryo DMG or Electro DMG.
Spinning Sweep
Curls up and quickly spins, dealing 30% ATK * 2 as Cryo DMG or Electro DMG.
Homing Shards

Rimebiter: Flings three shards at the player from its tail that travel on an arching trajectory, each dealing 30% ATK as Cryo DMG.Bolteater: Summons an orb in front of it that fires three bolts in a spread after a delay.
Critical Assist

After Double Beams, the vishap at critical health jumps into nearby water and swims around the arena, and periodically launches waves of 3 projectiles that home towards the player, each dealing 30% ATKas Cryo DMG or Electro DMG on hit.
Rapid Fire

The vishaps connect their tails and fire a barrage of alternating Cryo and Electro shards at the player, each dealing 20% ATK as Cryo DMG or Electro DMG. Repeated DMG instances will have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Double Beams

Once one of the vishaps reaches critical health, both vishaps join their tails at the center of the arena, forms a circular field below them that randomly and rapidly deals 100% ATK as Cryo DoT and Electro DoT simultaneously, and each fires a laser beam…
Slash Combo
If the player is within melee range, the Rimebiter Vishap performs 2 horizontal slashes followed by a downward smash, dealing 30% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK respectively as Physical DMG with each hit.
Assist

If a wall is intact, the Bolteater Vishap climbs up a wall and repeatedly launches Cleansing Shower orbs at the player. Orbs launched this way have the same Energy or HP draining effects, although with a minor homing property and a slower travel speed.
Revival

A visible link connects the two Vishaps. If one Vishap's HP reaches 1.2% and the other Vishap is not defeated within the next 10 seconds, the defeated Vishap will be revived with 50%/40%/30%/20% of its Max HP if revived 1/2/3/4+ time(s).

lore: Muscular hilichurls who wield large, two-handed axes. Attacks with large strikes and uses Electro Slimes to infuse their axes with Electro. Their blows are very lethal. Axes forged from steel are highly conductive material. The image of those tall and strong Crackling Axe Mitachurls holding their axes up to summon lightning is quite majestic to the hilichurls.
attacks: Swing Combo
Swings its axe up to 3 times, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG.
Ripple Electro Edge + Electro Slime Toss

After some time has passed or when the player character is out of reach, the Crackling Axe Mitachurl will dig up Electro Slimes from the ground to charge its axe before throwing it to the player, dealing 37.5% ATK as Electro DMG.
