Axe Spin
Spins the axe wildly, rapidly dealing 12.5% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG. At the end of this attack, performs a powerful final swing, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG.
Axe Dance
Performs a two-move dance with its axe to deal 50% ATK and 75% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack can only be used while the axe is infused.
Electro Slime Throw
If the character is at a differing elevation from the Mitachurl, throws either an Electro Slime or a small Mutant Electro Slime, dealing 62.5% ATK or 75% ATK as Electro DMG.
Lightning Axe

Raises its axe to summon a powerful lightning to strike down the player character, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG. The lightning is so tremendous that it will shock the Mitachurl to the ground, stunning it briefly.
Axe Slam
Leaps into the air to slam down at the player's location with their axe, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG. This attack is only performed by enhanced Crackling Axe Mitachurls.

lore: Abyss creatures that call upon Cryo in battle. Though they dabble with great power and can even create icicles by condensing and freezing water vapor in the atmosphere, their bodies are very vulnerable in and of themselves. Once their protective Ward has been broken, they are at your mercy.
tips: Uses a Cryo Ward to protect itself. Perhaps you can break down its defenses with Pyro or other Elemental Attacks that react with Cryo.
attacks: Frozen Shield

Upon initiating combat, the Cryo Abyss Mage immediately gains a Cryo Shield, protecting it from damage. The shield takes damage from certain Elemental Reactions and Poise Damage and suffers additional damage based on the strength of the attacks it receives.
Cryo Thorns
Shoots an ice projectile at the target, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG
Special Attack: Frostdrift Offering
Drops an icicle from directly above the target 3 times, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Teleportation

If the target is too far from the mage, it clutches its mask and teleports directly in front of the target, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG at its location upon reappearance. The mage can also teleport away from the player to avoid attacks when vulnerable.
Rimestorm Rite

If the mage is left alone after its shield is destroyed, summons 2 rings of icicles that revolve around it similar to Kaeya's Glacial Waltz. Icicles deal 70% ATK as Cryo DMG and launch targets upon contact.
Water Freeze

Due to their elemental powers, the Cryo Abyss Mage will freeze water they touch or hover over. This does not protect them from drowning in deep water if Pyro attacks are used to melt the ice underneath them.
Cryo and Frozen Immunity
Cryo Abyss Mage is immune to being immobilized by the Frozen elemental reaction. Cryo attacks against it also will not apply the Cryo aura, but can still deal damage.
Enhancement
Certain enhanced Cryo Abyss Mages can be found in certain Domains, Spiral Abyss, overworld events and challenges. There are 3 possible types of enhancements: Attack, Shield, and Teleportation.

lore: Little creatures that can ever so slightly manipulate Cryo. They and other such creatures are known collectively as Cicins. They are individually very weak, but it is precisely because they are weak that they have evolved unique methods of movement that allow them to avoid predators.
attacks: Cicin Icicle
Fires an icicle at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Hilichurls have discovered the use of Cryo Slimes in effectively keeping food fresh. Hilichurls have surprising amounts of wisdom in the practical use of Slimes, whether it be the use of Pyro and Cryo Slimes to make Exploding Barrels, or the use of Anemo Slimes in vehicles... Perhaps this is their way of adapting to their hard lot in life.
attacks: Cryo Slime Throw
Digs a Cryo Slime out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. Staggering the Grenadier during this attack will knock the Cryo Slime out of its hands.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. These archers wield simple crossbows, and unmelting ice shrouds their arrowheads. It is said that wounds caused by these arrowheads heal very slowly, as the cold will slow the circulation of blood.
attacks: Ice Arrow
Charges as Cryo energy accumulates on their arrowhead, before firing an arrow at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: Code name: Daleth. A high-purity Cryo entity. Research suggests that there are subtle differences between elemental hypostases and other elemental life forms in terms of their physical composition. Perhaps these differences can account for their high level of homeostasis and their almost mechanical movements.
tips: An elemental creature that protects itself from incoming attack with its durable shell. Find an opportune moment to land a blow to its elemental core. At critical moments, it will enter a Warded regenerative state, firing Frostfruit to attack its foes while restoring its own HP. Use Charged Attacks to redirect the Frostfruit back at the Cryo Hypostasis to swiftly knock it out of its regenerative state.
attacks: Sheer Cold Acceleration
Being near the Cryo Hypostasis accelerates the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation by 200%.
Plunging Ice Shards

Creates a barrier of piercing icicles around itself while spawning icicles where the player is standing with a short delay, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. Icicles do not target the player while inside the barrier.
Ice Ring Waltz
Transforms into a wheel that travels in a straight line towards the player and deals 50% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit. This attack may turn up to three times.
Icespike Shot

Flies into the air and forms a rhombus with its shell pieces before firing each of them at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. The trajectory of these projectiles is curved, but can be dodged by dashing under the Hypostasis during the attack.
Crystalline Skirt

Forms a "skirt" of icicles which it shoots out in three rings of increasing diameter, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. The final ring leaves behind a short-lived ring of frost that deals 30% ATK as Cryo DMG to characters stepping on it.
Clap
Flies next to the player and forms a large wall, which folds in a "clapping" motion very quickly, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG in front of the wall.
Sternfrost Prism

When HP is low (5%), teleports to the center of the arena and forms a Cryo shield around itself. While maintaining this state, lobs several Frostfruits around the arena, dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG on landing. while regenerating 5% of its Max HP every 3s.
Icicle Barrage
While attempting to revive, if the player is close, shoots out a barrage of icicles, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Plunging Ice Shards
Icicle spikes will spawn much more rapidly.
Icespike Shot
Each icicle will split into 3 mini icicles shortly after being fired, each dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit.
Crystalline Skirt
In addition to the original attack, homing icicles will be fired, each dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit.
Sternfrost Prism
The Cryo Hypostasis will shoot 5 Frostfruits per wave instead of 3. 1 or 2 layers of 3 protective barriers capable of blocking Frostfruits will appear and rotate around the Hypostasis.

lore: A monster formed from a vine that was imbued with the essence of biting frost within the ley lines. Some studies suggest that plants are like the organs of the world, harmonizing the turbulent elemental energies of the ley lines. Concrete examples of this phenomena are Mist Flowers, Whopperflowers, and the like, which brim over with elemental energy. In certain circumstances, certain plants will turn into creatures of monstrous size and intent — such as the Cryo Regisvines — in the course of many years.
tips: Carnivorous plants that use the alluring appearance of their flowers to deceive their prey. Their vine-like stalks are surprisingly tough to cut through. Perhaps the organ shaped like a Cryo core growing near their roots could be the key to defeating them...
attacks: Stunned
Destroying the Cryo Regisvine's shield at its core will stun it. Pyro is the most effective at damaging the shield.
Ice Beams
Flings two ice beams into an overlapping cross pattern, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. It may follow up with another two beams in an outward cross pattern.
Homing Icicles
Fires 2, 4, or 6 barrages of icicles that home toward the player, dealing 12.5% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit. These icicles will follow the character for a few seconds before losing their homing attribute.
Faceplant
Charges and slams itself into the ground, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG and causing three trails of ice to spike from the ground, with each spike dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Spin
A circle appears around the Regisvine indicating the radius of the attack.
Blizzard
This attack is used if the Regisvine's core is not broken after a long period of time, and is always preceded by Spin.
Flail
Smashes its head on the floor and swings 360 degrees around its roots, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG and knocking players away.
Half Flail
If the player is behind the Regisvine, performs a sweep with its head to face the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Half Flail Combo

Performs the following twice: Smashes its head on the floor and swings 180 degrees around its roots two times consecutively, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK as Cryo DMG on the head smash and the swing respectively. Then follows with Faceplant.
Rotary Spray

Leans its head forward at the player, and after locking onto the players location, fires a huge beam of Cryo from its corolla while slowly turn around 360 degrees, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG every 0.2 seconds to any players caught in the beam and…

lore: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that calls upon the bite of Cryo. Hilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. These shamans remember the frosty chants and are even more skilled in the art of using them to entrap their foes.
attacks: Icicle Spikes

Summons icicles that spike from the ground at the player's location, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. Also leaves behind a frozen patch of ground that deals 15% ATK as Cryo DoT to players that step on it.
Ice Pillars

Summons pillars below itself and any nearby Samachurls, Hilichurl Shooters, and Abyss Mages, giving them a higher ground to attack. The pillars also periodically release blasts around it, dealing 15% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Staff Strike
If the player is within melee range, swings its staff at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back. The Samachurl also falls in the process due to the staff's weight.

lore: A small monster created through the coagulation of Cryo in the natural environment. Competitors once spread malicious rumors that the Dawn Winery used Cryo Slimes to control the temperature of their wine cellar and preserve the quality of their alcohol.
attacks: Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Drowning Immunity
The Cryo Slime constantly freezes surfaces of water below them, making them unable to drown.

lore: A monster born from highly-concentrated Cryo elements that can float in the air. A certain alchemist once studied these beings, speculating that they might be a kind of Slime or the Traveler, as none of the above needed a Vision to use the elements. He was reprimanded by his teacher.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury
Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated.
Ice Missile
Shoots a slow homing projectile that deals 80% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit, after a couple of seconds the projectile will lose its homing property and start to travel in a straight line.
Frost Bomb
Spins before shooting out a downward snowball that bursts dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Snowball Sling
Consecutively launches 6 snowballs at the player that burst on contact dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack will only occur at max Fury and will be the only attack it uses in that state.
Final Burst
Explodes after a short pause when defeated dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. If at max Fury, DMG is increased to 120% ATK, and leaves behind a patch of frost on the ground that deals 40% ATK as Cryo DoT.
Frozen Immunity
The Cryo Specter is immune to the Frozen reaction.

lore: A mimetic plant monster that appears out of nowhere and uses Cryo in combat. These plants lurk under the surface and ambush unsuspecting prey. With the passage of years, sufficient nutrition, and the right environment, it could even take root somewhere and grow into a giant Cryo Regisvine...
attacks: Burrow
Sinks into the ground and emerges nearby.
Ambush
If the player interacts with a disguised Cryo Whopperflower, bursts from the ground, dealing 300% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Spin
If the player is within melee range, flattens while spinning its petals to deal 50% ATK * 3 as Cryo DMG around itself.
Normal Attack: Crystalline Spikes
Shoots out trails of spikes from the ground near the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Charged Attack: Frost Cannon
Closes its petals, consuming one of the "fruits" orbiting around it and creating a Cryo shield, giving it ~10 seconds to charge up its attack.
Recharge
Once all three "fruits" are consumed, the Whopperflower will plunge into the ground and restore all three, creating a visual AoE but will not deal any DMG.

lore: Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline. The all-purpose scout combat package is designed for both long- and short-range combat, and not only leads scout Landcruiser squads, but also provides close support for All-Purpose Storm Landcruisers during high-intensity battles, such as crossing specialized anti-Landcruiser trenches, or destroying enemy strongpoints. This Landcruiser type can also keep up with the tip of the spear as it breaks through in depth, before swinging out to the wings and swiftly attacking key targets in the enemy's rear lines.
tips: A heavily armed ship that cruises on land and, thanks to certain modifications, can harness the power of kuuvahki to deploy special functions. Attack it a certain number of times with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions while it's using kuuvahki to stop it in its tracks. Because of its reliance on kuuvahki, you might be able to make use of the properties of kuuvahki to more effectively attack.
attacks: Slash
Slashes once with its saw hand, dealing 75% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Stream
Spews a stream of water outward with its double barrel gun, dealing 60% ATK as Hydro DMG every second to players it hits.
Rapid Fire
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player with its minigun, dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG with each bullet.
Kuuvahki All-Purpose Barrier
If there are other enemies nearby, infuses its shield with kuuvahki and forms a protective barrier in front of it that blocks all frontal attacks.
Kuuvahki Multi-Projectile Fire
Absorbs kuuvahki into its weaponry before opening its missile launcher and firing a long continuous barrage of bullets at the player lasting 10 seconds, dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG with each bullet.

lore: Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline. The all-purpose storm combat package combines multi-barrel automatic guns with close-quarter rotating blades, allowing this Landcruiser to battle opponents at any range, while heavy howitzers on both arms allow it to obliterate cover and deny defenders the benefit of their fortifications. According to combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy, these Landcruisers must be supported by all nearby units when they attack, speedily punching a hole in enemy lines, which will allow for follow-up attacks in depth that will then cause the enemy defenses to collapse completely.
tips: A heavily armed ship that cruises on land and, thanks to certain modifications, can harness the power of kuuvahki to deploy special functions. Attack it a certain number of times with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions while it's using kuuvahki to stop it in its tracks. Because of its reliance on kuuvahki, you might be able to make use of the properties of kuuvahki to more effectively attack.
attacks: Slash
Slashes once, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG.
Pincer
Turns both saws into claw arms and crushes them together on the player, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG.
Rapid Fire
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player from its minigun, dealing 20% ATK as Electro DMG with each bullet.
Kuuvahki Multi-Thrust Assault
Infuses both saw arms with kuuvahki before performing two slashes with them, dealing 85% ATK, 85% ATK as Electro DMG.
Kuuvahki Multi-Projectile Fire

Absorbs kuuvahki into its weaponry before opening its missile launcher and firing a long continuous barrage of bullets at the player lasting 10 seconds, dealing 20% ATK as Electro DMG with each bullet.

cutting_edge_fire_support_ground_effect_.special: Cutting Edge Fire Support Ground Effect
lore: Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline. After being equipped with high-efficiency jet engines, this Ground Effect Landcruiser has gained the ability to carry multiple armaments, allowing it to deliver this sizable firepower anywhere on the battlefield in a timely fashion. As such, the combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy states that they are to be organized as a "Quick Reaction Force" in large-scale battles, meant to guard against enemy breakthroughs or counterattacks, and to press the advantage if the battle is going favorably. Of course, all such Landcruisers have the ability to operate independently, and on long tours of duty, they can form the core of a small squad and thus maximize the firepower of various Fatui unit types...
tips: A heavily armed ship that cruises on land and, thanks to certain modifications, can harness the power of kuuvahki to deploy special functions. Attack it a certain number of times with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions while it's using kuuvahki to stop it in its tracks. Because of its reliance on kuuvahki, you might be able to make use of the properties of kuuvahki to more effectively attack.
attacks: Blast
Blasts the ground underneath itself with its boosters, dealing 85% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Rapid Fire
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player, dealing 20% ATK as Pyro DMG with each bullet.
Charge
Charges at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG on contact.
Kuuvahki Multi-Projectile Fire
Absorbs kuuvahki into its weaponry before opening its missile launcher and firing a long continuous barrage of bullets at the player lasting 10 seconds, dealing 20% ATK as Pyro DMG with each bullet.

lore: A clockwork meka designed to conducting underwater attacks. Unlike "Underwater Patrol Mek" models, it is expected to take on much larger and fiercer opponents. Of course, the price it pays for such capabilities and its cost of manufacture is that is unable to fully unleash its capabilities against smaller opponents. Long ago, Fontaine was once scarred by the tragic invasion of a massive monster. The revered White Armada that sailed upon the great terrestrial lake was completely destroyed in defense of the nation. The designer hoped that were such a thing to happen again, the clockwork meka would possess enough naval firepower to be the first line of defense, going before the soldiers and generals.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and its combat capabilities.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Deepwater Assault Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe twice will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to attack for a period of time.
Wind Shot
Launches a projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Torpedo
Launches 2 homing projectiles at the player, each dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.

lore: Code Name: Zayin. A high-purity Dendro entity. According to the deductions of some researchers, Elemental Hypostases have the knowledge required to "learn," which is how they use "mimesis" to initiate attacks. However, the ability to incorporate information to create change also opens one to the risk of information contamination. As this creature learns and changes, the purpose of its birth — no matter how academically unquantifiable it may still be — may yet become so distorted as to be rendered irrelevant.
tips: A hypostasis that uses an inert shell to defend itself. It now displays abnormalities due to having been corrupted by some unknown influence. You must seize moments where its elemental core is exposed to attack effectively. When it is in danger, it will release Restorative Piths that have the properties of Tri-Lakshana Creatures. Use Dendro to revive these Piths and induce a Normal State in them to continuously cleanse the Dendro Hypostasis, and use Electro to trigger their Activated state and speed up the cleansing process. Using Dendro attacks on the Dendro Hypostasis' core can also help to cleanse the creature. Complete the cleansing process to complete the challenge.
attacks: Mucky Orbs
Shoots 3 waves of orbs at the player, each dealing 40% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit and leaving behind residuals on the ground that deals 5% ATK as Dendro DMG every 0.5s.
Whip Combo
Transforms itself into a whip and attacks thrice, dealing 40% ATK, 60% ATK, 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Plunging Attack

Transforms into a large ball and encases itself in a vine shell, then leaps up and slams down at the player's location 3 times, dealing 70% ATK, 70% ATK, 100% ATK as Dendro DMG. Using Pyro to burn down the vine shell will interrupt this attack.
Vine Spikes

Sends its shell into the ground that transform into 4 vines that spike from the ground, dealing 20% ATK as Dendro DMG. Shortly after, additional thorns will grow from the vines, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG. These vines can be burned down using Pyro.
Ring of Thorns

Surrounds a large area with vine barriers that deal 10% ATK as Dendro DMG on contact. The vines will gradually close in towards the Hypostasis. After the vines reach the Hypostasis, a powerful explosion will occur, dealing 250% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Revival Phase

When the Hypostasis's HP reaches 5%, it will enter its revival phase and release 3 Restorative Piths. A cleansing progress bar will appear below the health bar. When this bar is fully filled, cleansing will be complete and the fight will end.
Restorative Piths
Restorative Piths will be present at all times throughout the battle.
Revival Phase
In Fearless and Extreme difficulties, the cleansing efficiency will be reduced.

lore: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that awakens the might of Dendro. Hilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. A grudge stirs beneath that mask, and poison ivy sprouts as hateful whispers issue forth from it.
attacks: Venomous Vines
Summons three thorny vines on the battlefield, blocking off a wide area and dealing extremely minor Physical DMG to players that come in contact. The vines can be destroyed using Pyro.
Dendro Field
Summons a green field around the player that applies 1.6 gauge units of Dendro every 0.5s to any player or enemy within it, but does not deal DMG. This Dendro status lasts for 8 seconds.
Staff Strike
If the player is within melee range, swings its staff at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back. The Samachurl also falls in the process due to the staff's weight.

lore: A slime that has undergone ecological changes due to abundant Dendro in its environment. It has also taken on the weaknesses of the Dendro element, and will burn intensely the moment it meets a bright flame.
attacks: Panic
When attacked by Pyro, Dendro Slimes will be forced out of their burrowed state, and will jump around while Burning is in effect.
Stalk
If the player is out of melee range and has their back turned against it, peeks from the ground before approaching the player. It will stop moving if the player turns towards it.
Bump (Burrowed)
If the player is within melee range and has their back turned against it, peeks from the ground before temporarily jumping out and bumping into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Peek
If the Dendro Slime is attacked while peeking, it will be forced out of its burrowed state. If the player turns towards the Dendro Slime while it is taking a peek, it will be startled and jump back.
Bump
While on ground, bumps into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A monster born from high-density Dendro energy that can float in the air. A researcher from Vahumana once did research into the ecological peculiarities of Dendro Specters, finding them to be quite similar to the legendary "Aranara." His conclusion was that the Aranara were actually Dendro Specters. This researcher would become a little-known writer of fairy tales.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury

Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated. When they have a full Fury bar, they will grow bigger and gain access to enhanced attacks.
Orb Throw
Lobs an orb of Dendro energy at the player which bursts on contact, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Energy Field

Summons a field of leaves below the player which gradually expands before bursting, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG. If the field hits a target, it will generate an energy orb which fills the Fury of itself by 50%.
Spread Spin

Repeatedly spins to release 3 sprays of leaves around itself, with each spray having a larger radius than the last, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG with each spray. This attack will only occur at max Fury and will be the only attack it uses in that state.
Final Burst
Explodes after a short pause when defeated, dealing 125% ATK as Dendro DMG.

lore: A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it is a guardian who watches over the Pillar Hall of the heavens. Though entrusted with "eyes" as a guardian of the Pillar Hall of Space, these entities can do nothing but extol the "Ideal Forms" of the noumenal world. With no way to behold the complexities of the phenomenal world, they are thus not counted among the kindred of angels. Whether this inherent contradiction is a product of their creator's rational design, or if the master they serve ultimately failed to grasp the intent of that primordial being, is a truth that remains beyond our reach.
tips: A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, it can monitor and counter elemental attacks. In combat, the Domain Keeper will enter the Deluded Eye state. While in this state, the Domain Keeper will track the number of Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo DMG instances it takes, respectively. When it has taken 3 instances of DMG from any of these elements, the Domain Keeper will exit this state and transform into the corresponding elemental form, applying that element to itself and gaining a RES increase in the corresponding element.
attacks: Melee Combo
Swipes twice at the player using its hand followed by a thrust with its wing, dealing 25% ATK, 25% ATK, 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Spinning Slash
Materialises a sword in its hand before performing a spinning slash while charging forward a short distance, dealing 33% ATK x 2 + 34% ATK as Geo DMG.
Lunging Thrust
Materialises a sword in its hand before performing a single lunging thrust, dealing 75% ATK as Geo DMG.
Blades
Materialises a sword in its hand before launching two slanted blade projectiles at the player, each dealing 40% ATK as Geo DMG.
Deluded Eye

Enters the Deluded Eye state with a Fury bar. In this state, the Keeper will monitor any Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo hits taken. All four elements are monitored simultaneously, and the element with the most progress will be displayed on the Fury bar.
Phenomenal Fracture

After performing 4 attacks while transformed, the Keeper will gather a large amount of elemental energy matching the element the Keeper transformed into in its hand before slamming it into the ground beneath it, dealing 150% ATK as matching Elemental DMG…

lore: Abyss creatures that utilize Electro in battles. While studying at the Akademiya, researcher Alva Nikola once conducted a systematic study of the methods by which Electro Abyss Mages manipulate Electro and came up with a theoretical weapon known as the Nikola Coil. However, it has yet to be put into practice. Some say that his research materials were eaten during a fungal infestation.
attacks: Electro Shield

Upon initiating combat, the Electro Abyss Mage immediately gains an Electro Shield, protecting it from damage. The shield takes damage from certain Elemental Reactions and suffers additional damage based on the strength of the attacks it receives.
Thunderbolt
Shoots an Electro projectile at the target, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG
Special Attack: Lingering Light

Summons a large Tanglebolt Ring around itself and deals one instance of 80% ATK as Electro DMG to targets anywhere inside the ring's AoE. Afterwards, the ring itself will deal 80% ATK as Electro DMG to targets upon contact.
Teleportation

If the target is too far from the mage, it clutches its mask and teleports directly in front of the target, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG at its location upon reappearance. The mage can also teleport away from the player to avoid attacks when vulnerable.
Rite of Rolling Thunder

If the mage is left alone after its shield is destroyed, repeatedly shoots out 4 medium-sized orbs in different directions around it, dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG. During this attack, the mage's Interruption Resistance is increased.
Enhancement
Certain enhanced Electro Abyss Mages can be found in certain Domains, Spiral Abyss, overworld events and challenges. There are 2 possible types of enhancements: Attack and Shield.

lore: Little creatures that can ever so slightly manipulate Electro. They and other such creatures are known collectively as Cicins, and though they are individually weak, they can cause significant damage under the right circumstances.
attacks: Hurtling Bolt
Fires a bolt at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Electro Slimes don't seem to have as many applications as Pyro Slimes or Anemo Slimes in the benighted lives of the Hilichurls. Perhaps one day they may discover the flow of Elements between Electro Slime and Mutant Electro Slime and make some great progress... ?
attacks: Electro Slime Throw
Digs an Electro Slime out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. Staggering the Grenadier during this attack will knock the Electro Slime out of its hands.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. These archers wield simple crossbows, and their arrowheads are crafted from carved Electro Crystals that will deliver an electric shock upon impact. They say that Hilichurl Shooters of exceptional skill can fire five crossbow bolts at once — a most impressive feat indeed.
attacks: Thunder Arrow
Charges as Electro energy accumulates on their arrowhead, before firing an arrow at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: Code name: Aleph. A high-purity Electro entity. Elemental hypostases are the highest forms of elemental structures, usually formed either at a location bursting with elemental energy or at a clogged ley line. Elemental hypostases have developed various attacks based on their elemental attributes.
tips: Protects itself with a cubical shell that is elementally inert. Attacks are only effective when its elemental core is exposed. When HP is low, it splits into three crystalline prisms that can absorb elemental energy. Make sure to destroy them all.
attacks: Electro Crystal Projection
Flies into the air and forms a rhombus with its shell pieces, firing two each for a total of four attacks, dealing 25% ATK as Electro DMG on hit. The core will be exposed during this attack.
Clap
Quickly flies next to the player and forms a large wall, which folds in a "clapping" motion very quickly, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG in front of the wall.
Rock-Paper-Scissors Combo

Performs a telegraphed 3-hit combo consisting of a forward punch, a "cutting" attack as a pair of scissors, and a ground slap with a giant hand. Sometimes, only the punch is performed, in which case the telegraph does not appear.
Drill
Turns into a giant drill and spins across the arena, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG and 25% ATK as Physical DMG continuously upon contact.
Tremors

Moves to the center of the arena and forms a spinning dome formation with its shell while sending out many small waves of shell pieces, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG on hit. When this attack ends, an Electro Energy Orb will be generated.
Lightning Lockdown

Sends shell pieces into the sky and rains them down in an octagon formation around the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG and trapping them, before raining lightning in the cage, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Rotating Lasers

Forms a ring around its core with its shell pieces, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG and begins firing lasers out in 4 directions. The ring will then rotate, moving the lasers with it, dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG on hit.
Absorbing Prism

When HP is low (approx. 5%), teleports to the center of the arena and forms 3 Revival Prisms, which can only be damaged using elemental reactions. After 15 seconds, absorbs the Prisms and heals for 15%/35%/50% of its HP for 1/2/3 prisms absorbed.

lore: A huge vine that has morphed into a monster through the conduction of high-voltage currents through the Ley Lines. Electricity surges constantly from its canopy like the unending rage of the earth itself. Kshahrewar researchers once submitted that a complex circuit matrix might be set up around this creature to carry electrical energy to the city for use there. This plan was stridently opposed by scholars from Spantamad, who sacrificed 10 Shroomboars to drive home the point about the dangers of utilizing electricity.
tips: A predatory plant in the same vein as the Cryo and Pyro Regisvines, this creature can create an organ that resembles Electro Cores at its roots or corolla. When this type of organ starts to shift, its state will change, condensing into either a Waxing Stamen or a Waning Stamen. When the two types of stamens are present at the same time, they will attract one another and then unleash a powerful electrical explosion when they make contact. Destroying these stamens quickly is key to an easier battle experience.
attacks: State Shift
Upon entering battle, the Electro Regisvine will form a shield (core) at its corolla. The shield will periodically shift positions between the Regisvine's corolla and roots.

lore: A wizened, mumbling Hilichurl, one that prays to Electro. Hilichurls especially gifted in commanding elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. Since they possess such advanced skill in creating electricity and summoning thunder, you may as well use the crackling sound to compose an elegy.
attacks: Thunderclap Totem
Summons thunder that strikes a random location, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG and leaving behind a Thundercall Staff. The staffs cannot be destroyed.
Thunderstrike Hex
The Samachurl and any summoned Thundercall Staffs will simultaneously release up to 3 shockwaves around themselves, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Staff Strike
If the player is within melee range, swings its staff at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back. The Samachurl also falls in the process due to the staff's weight.

lore: A small monster created by the coalescing of Electro dispersed throughout nature. According to analyses, the jumping of Electro Slimes reflects the electric potential difference in the ground. In areas brimming over with Electro, their unusual movements can be observed and used to avoid danger.
attacks: Electricity
When electricity is present on an Electro Slime (indicated when its "antenna" is glowing), it will be inflicted with Electro at all times, and its attacks will deal Electro DMG.
Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG if electricity is present or Physical DMG if electricity is not present.

lore: A monster born from highly-concentrated Electro elements that can float in the air. A certain researcher once studied these creatures. He believed that they must be Hypostases of some kind. After all, they both had elemental peculiarities and were birthed from areas saturated with elemental energy, right? By the way, he was later investigated for academic corruption.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury
Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated.
Thunderstrike
Floats a bit before summoning three lightning bolts to strike down around the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Blitz Bump
Spins and charges towards the player in a shaky manner, dealing 62.5% ATK as Electro DMG.
Zip Zap Bash

Zips about a few times, dealing 15% ATK as Electro DMG to players caught in its electricity, before slamming downwards dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack will only occur at max Fury and will be the only attack it uses in that state.
Final Burst
Explodes after a short pause when defeated dealing 62.5% ATK as Electro DMG. If at max Fury, it will follow the player before it explodes, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: Energetic mimetic Plant monsters that use Electro to attack their prey. When fully-charged with Electro energy, they can unleash a strong electric current from their crowns. As such, some researchers have tried to apply them in other areas...
attacks: Burrow
Sinks into the ground and emerges nearby.
Ambush
If the player interacts with a disguised Electro Whopperflower, bursts from the ground, dealing 300% ATK as Electro DMG.
Spin
If the player is within melee range, flattens while spinning its petals to deal 50% ATK * 3 as Electro DMG around itself.
Normal Attack: Orb Lay
Lobs out 3 orbs next to it that stay on the ground for a few seconds, dealing 33% ATK as Electro DMG on landing and 10% ATK as Electro DMG to players that come in contact.
Charged Attack: Focused Laser

Closes its petals, consuming one of the "fruits" orbiting around it and creating a Electro shield, giving it ~5 seconds to charge up its attack. If allowed to fully charge, it will bend over, point its top at the player, and charge up a laser blast.
Recharge
Once all three "fruits" are consumed, the Whopperflower will burrow into the ground and restore all three creating a visual AoE but will not deal any damage.

emperor_of_fire_and_iron.special: Searing Tide Pulsing Beneath the Mountains
lore: One of the two sovereigns who once stood at the apex of the aberrant species of the Fontemer, and the subject of many a tale among sailors. An Armored Crab that avoids predation, and can keep hunting and eating, will continue to grow, continually seeking out suitable shells to become its new armor. But eventually, it became simply too gargantuan. Before the first diluvian period, a massive Armored Crab once attacked a ship, and was finally forced back into the depths by Basil Elton, who had not yet been reinstated as a naval commander. Imagine this world: All of humanity has been purged from Teyvat, and the ever-growing Emperor of Fire and Iron eventually wears the Palais Mermonia upon its body like a luxurious coat of white stone. Of course, in such a world, there naturally would be no one to call it, half-jokingly and half in awe, the "Emperor of Fire and Iron."
tips: An Armored Crablord that has survived for countless eons and surpassed almost all other Fontemer Aberrants. The twin molten horns located high up on its body are Pyro-aligned organs that can unleash more vicious elemental attacks and grant it even stronger defensive capabilities. When the Armored Crablord unleashes certain attacks, its twin molten horns are closer to the ground. This provides for a great opportunity to use Elemental Reactions to remove the Pyro element within.
attacks: Ambush
Upon being aggroed, strikes the ground in front with its claw, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Twin Molten Horns

The Emperor of Fire and Iron has a pair of horns on top of it that grants it a 60% RES (80% in Spiral Abyss) increase to all DMG and enables it to use stronger attacks. The horns are Pyro-infused and can be destroyed using Elemental Reactions.
Left Claw Strike
Slams its left claw into the ground, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Right Claw Strike
Swings at the target with its right claw, dealing 50% ATK or 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charging Strike
Rushes towards the player and swings one of its claws, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used while the Molten Horns are intact.
Leaping Crush

Leaps into the air and slams down at the player's location, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG. After this attack, its horns become exposed to melee attacks for a period of time. This attack is only used while the Molten Horns are intact.
Volcanic Eruption

Shoots countless fireballs out of its horns, each dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG upon landing and leaving the struck ground burnt. Burnt ground deals 6% ATK as Pyro DMG every 0.5s to players standing on it.
Molten Trail

Thrusts a fireball into the ground with its claw, dealing 30% ATK as Pyro DMG and causes a trail of explosions, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG and leaving the ground burnt. Burnt ground deals 6% ATK as Pyro DMG every 0.5s to players standing on it.
Searing Coronation

Moves to the center of the arena and half-buries itself to charge a massive explosion, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG and leaving ground near the center of the arena burnt. Burnt ground deals 6% ATK as Pyro DMG every 0.5s to players standing on it.
Regeneration
30 seconds (20 seconds in Spiral Abyss, 10 seconds for Stygian Fearless/Dire) after its horns have been broken, digs into the ground and resurfaces with a new pair of intact horns.
Sternshield Support
On Fearless/Dire difficulty in Stygian Onslaught, summons three Sternshield Crabs to assist it in battle. These crabs possess a Pyro aura around them.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. These ax-wielding ladies often wade into the slaughter without fear, creating openings for their comrades to capitalize on. They will sometimes sit by the fireside in their sand-swept homeland and play songs that were lost in that golden sea.
attacks: Sand Throw
Throws sand at the player, dealing no DMG but applying a visual effect to the player's screen that obscures vision.
Axe Swing
Performs one or two swings with her axe, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG with each swing.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps hailing from a place where the sands shine like gold. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. The Eremite tradition is to use bows to engage their foes, but ever since the Akademiya permitted them to buy crossbows at the bazaars, only the proudest shooters would still use bows, which take many years of practice to master.
attacks: Crossbow Shot
Fires a single bolt, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Rapid Fire
Fires up to 5 bolts in quick succession, each dealing 65% ATK as Physical DMG. If the players are close, he stops shooting.
Poison Bomb
Infuses his bolt with Dendro before firing it off, dealing 70% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit and leaving a poison mist that deals 20% ATK as Dendro DMG every 0.5 seconds.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. A true scion of a warrior tribe, such warriors see battle as their ordained purpose, and unlike some barbarian who wields a large ax with ease, these tribespeople are also quite well-versed in the lore and songs of the desert ruins. An ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.
tips: These warriors form the backbone of the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. They will unleash the ominous spirit sealed in their weapons after taking a certain amount of damage to enter an Infused Form that greatly boosts their combat capabilities. Once this Infused Form ends, they will enter a weakened state for a time.
attacks: Spinning Sweep
Performs a single overhead sweep, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG.
Axe Swipe
Swings his axe once, then again twice, dealing 60% ATK, 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Whirling Cleave
If the player is far away, jumps towards the player and performs two spinning sweeps, dealing 40% ATK, 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Ominous Spirit Unleashed
When his HP is lower than 70%, he may enter an enhanced state, gaining enhanced attacks and high Interruption Resistance. This state lasts for 20 seconds.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. A young lady lost in the ancient dream of the desert songs. To her, the thrill of bloody battle is her true reward. Legend has it that the women of this tribe are often afflicted by the wandering spirits of the desert, a condition that leads many of them to an early end. Perhaps this one can only be free of these apparitions when her blood is up in combat. An ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon she uses, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.
tips: These sword-dancers may be found in the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. They will unleash the ominous spirit sealed in their weapons after taking a certain amount of damage to enter an Infused Form that greatly boosts their combat capabilities. Once this Infused Form ends, they will enter a weakened state for a time.
attacks: Agile Thrust
Performs a two part combo consisting of a quick slash and a thrusting jab, dealing 40% ATK and 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Blitz Strike
Performs a cross slash, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Waterwheel
If the player is far away, charges towards the player and transforms into a rolling wheel, dealing 50% ATK × 2 as Hydro DMG.
Ominous Spirit Unleashed
When her HP is lower than 70%, she may enter an enhanced state, gaining enhanced attacks and high Interruption Resistance. This state lasts for 20 seconds.
Enhanced Melee Combo
Performs Agile Thrust followed by Blitz Strike, dealing 60% ATK, 50% ATK, 75% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Whirling Slashes
Winds up before unleashing a vertical slash and a horizontal slash followed by a Blitz Strike, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 75% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Enhanced Ranged Combo
Performs Waterwheel followed by Blitz Strike, dealing 70% ATK × 2, 75% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. They will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. The children of the desert have a rich tradition of song and dance. Originally used to praise and serve the gods, the crafts were later adapted for battle and the seduction of kings. Many tales of the sands feature dancers who murdered kings relaxed in their beds or standing atop high towers. Even though all such gods and kings have now faded into the flowing sands, the memory of dance yet persists in the desert-dwellers' veins. Ominous, fragmented spirits are sealed within the weapons they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once these weapons awaken, they can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be their wielders or their wielders' foes.
tips: This dancer may be found in one of the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. She will unleash the Spirit of Omen: Dendro Spirit-Serpent contained within her weapon to fight alongside her after taking a certain amount of damage. This will cause her to enter an Infused Form. If the Spirit-Serpent is defeated, she will enter a weakened state for a fixed amount of time thereafter.
attacks: Floral-Ring Caress
Performs a 2-part or 3-part combo with her chakram, dealing 80% ATK, 100% ATK, 35% ATK × 3 as Dendro DMG.
Spiraling Whirl
Summons 2 chakrams to orbit herself, dealing 35% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.
Returning Ringblade
Throws her chakram at the player, which travels a certain distance before returning, dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.
Teleport
If not in the Enhanced State, teleports to the player's location and performs a single slash, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Spirit of Omen's Awakening: Dendro Spirit-Serpent

When the Eremite Floral Ring-Dancer's HP is lower than 70% (or immediately upon entering combat in the Spiral Abyss), she will enter an enhanced state by summoning a Spirit of Omen: Dendro Spirit-Serpent to assist in battle, gaining increased RES and high…
Spirit Combo: Prismfall Prison

The Eremite Floral Ring-Dancer forms a barrier that traps players inside, while the Spirit of Omen: Dendro Spirit-Serpent conjures 7 prisms before firing them at the player, each dealing 30% Spirit's ATK as Dendro DMG.

lore: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. In this age where crossbows are in widespread use, only the most experienced of Eremite warriors know how to use a longbow in battle. They do not even need their eyes — merely their ears with which they sense the flow of wind and sand alike — to judge the location of their foes. Ominous, fragmented spirits are sealed within the weapons they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once these weapons awaken, they can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be their wielders or their wielders' foes.
tips: This huntress may be found in one of the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. She will unleash the Spirit of Omen: Wind Glede contained within her body to fight alongside her after taking a certain amount of damage. This will cause her to enter an Infused Form. If the Glede is defeated, she will enter a weakened state for a fixed amount of time thereafter.
attacks: Piercing Squall
When the player is nearby, forms a wind arrow and strikes the ground in front of her, dealing 75% ATK as Anemo DMG. This attack will not be used in the Enhanced State.
Melee Combo
Performs a sweeping kick and a quick slash with a wind arrow, dealing 60% ATK and 70% ATK as Anemo DMG and finishes with a Piercing Squall. This attack will not be used in the Enhanced State.
Storm Chase
If the player is far away, dashes swiftly at the player and performs a melee slash with a wind arrow, dealing 75% ATK as Anemo DMG. This attack will not be used in the Enhanced State.
Gale Strike
Fires a wind arrow at the player, dealing 75% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Vacuum Shot

Suspends herself mid-air and forms a Vacuum Field below her that pulls the player in before unleashing a charged arrow at the ground, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG. This attack will not be used in the Enhanced State.
Ominous Spirit Unleashed

When the Eremite Galehunter's HP is lower than 70% (or immediately upon entering combat in the Spiral Abyss), she will enter an enhanced state by summoning a Spirit of Omen: Wind Glede to assist in battle, gaining increased RES and high Interruption…
Jump Back
Jumps away from the player when close, following up with a Gale Strike. This attack is only used in the Enhanced State.
Spirit Combo: Vacuum Airstrike

The Spirit of Omen: Wind Glede forms a large Vacuum Field at the player's location while the Eremite Galehunter charges and fires a powerful arrow into the air, which lands inside the Vacuum Field, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. This warrior wields a unique fist blade and joined the Eremites to seek out stronger foes. Rather than the pay, these warriors fight more to attain greater martial might.
attacks: Upward Slash
Performs a single upward slash, dealing 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Melee Combo
Performs a 3-hit combo, dealing 45% ATK, 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charged Attack
Charges before unleashing a quick 3-hit combo, dealing 20% ATK, 20% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. These warriors use Ravenbeak Halberds in battle. It is said that ascetics who served the deity of the desert would carry these halberds as symbols of their office. These weapons once had a true name, but it has long been lost to the desert sands.
attacks: Sweep Combo
When in melee range, performs a sweep and a jumping slam with his halberd, dealing 20% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charge Combo
When far from the player, charges at the player, dealing 15% ATK as Physical DMG on hit, then performs a jumping slam, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Even though they will work for anyone as long as the pay is good, they will never forget their roots in the Great Red Sand. After the collapse of its civilizations, the stories of the desert were passed down generation after generation in oral tradition just like the sparks in the wind and the rain in the clouds. As time passed, some stories were lost while others survived, albeit with significant changes. "The Eremites" is the umbrella term given to the tribes of the desert by those too ignorant or disdainful to learn the tribes' myriad differences. Within those referred to as the Eremites, many have also indeed already forgotten the tales of the desert. Fear not, however, for those who still remember will never betray the spirit of the sands yet flowing through their veins.
tips: This oracle may be found in one of the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. She will unleash the Spirit of Omen: Pyro Scorpion contained within her body after taking a certain amount of damage. This will cause her to enter an Infused Form. If the Scorpion is defeated, she will enter a weakened state for a fixed amount of time thereafter.
attacks: Gem Missiles
Fires 4 projectiles at the player, each dealing 25% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Searing Glare
Fires a single beam at the ground, causing an explosion that deals 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Blazing Strike
Conjures 4 gems and shoots them into the sky, which then land at the player's location, each dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Teleport
Blinks away from the player.
Spirit of Omen's Awakening: Pyro Scorpion

When the Eremite Scorching Loremaster's HP is lower than 70% (or immediately upon entering combat in the Spiral Abyss), she will enter an enhanced state by summoning a Spirit of Omen: Pyro Scorpion to assist in battle, gaining increased RES and high…
Spirit Combo: Meteoric Descent

The Eremite Scorching Loremaster teleports in front of the player and fires a drill in front of her, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG, while the Spirit of Omen: Pyro Scorpion digs into the ground, resurfaces briefly while propelling forward, and marks a massive…

lore: A person hailing from the loosely-organized mercenary bands of the desert. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. In ancient days, these heavily-equipped warriors were the domain of the personal, trusted guards of the Lord of the Blazing Sun. It is perhaps on this account that they gleam like the golden sun itself to this day. Ominous, fragmented spirits are sealed within the weapons they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once these weapons awaken, they can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be their wielders or their wielders' foes.
tips: This warrior may be found in one of the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. He will unleash the Spirit of Omen: Stone Drake contained within his body to fight alongside him after taking a certain amount of damage. This will cause him to enter an Infused Form. If the drake's spirit is defeated, he will enter a weakened state for a fixed amount of time thereafter.
attacks: Tremors
Causes two trails of explosions. Each explosion deals 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Melee Combo
Performs two melee strikes, dealing 75% ATK, 75% ATK as Geo DMG, followed by Tremors.
Spinning Charge
Spins his weapon wildly and charges at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG with each spin. At the end of the charge, performs an additional slash, dealing 75% ATK as Geo DMG.
Splitrock Slam
Jumps into the air and slams down at the player's location, dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG.
Ominous Spirit Unleashed

When the Eremite Stone Enchanter's HP is lower than 70% (or immediately upon entering combat in the Spiral Abyss), he will enter an enhanced state by summoning a Spirit of Omen: Stone Drake to assist in battle, gaining increased RES and high Interruption…
Single Slash
Performs a single slash, dealing 75% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack is only used in the Enhanced State.
Block
Forms a shield that blocks attacks from the direction that he is facing. This ability is only used in the Enhanced State.
Spirit Combo: Triple Quake

The Eremite Stone Enchanter performs Splitrock Slam, while the Spirit of Omen: Stone Drake dives into the ground, dealing 35% Spirit's ATK Geo DMG, then resurfaces at the player's location, and slams down once again, dealing 80% Spirit's ATK, 100% Spirit's…
Tremors
Causes two trails of explosions. Each explosion deals 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Melee Combo
Performs two melee strikes, dealing 75% ATK, 75% ATK as Geo DMG. The 2nd strike will not be used in Normal and Hard difficulties.
Splitrock Slam
Jumps into the air and slams down at the player's location, dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack is only used in Hard difficulty.
Ultimate Technique: Spinning Charge
The Eremite Stone Enchanter has a Fury meter that fills by 1 point when hit by the player's attacks.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. A professional mercenary who cares about nothing outside of work and the mission at hand. To such people, their only game plan is to complete the mission, and their high asking prices on the market match that committment. An ominous, fragmented spirit is sealed within the weapon they use, awakening in moments of peril. Once it does, it can only be silenced by the cries of the vanquished — whether that be its wielder, or its wielder's foe.
tips: These agile warriors may be found in the many scattered mercenary groups that hail from the desert. They will unleash the ominous spirit sealed in their weapons after taking a certain amount of damage to enter an Infused Form that greatly boosts their combat capabilities. Once this Infused Form ends, they will enter a weakened state for a time.
attacks: Sweeping Slash
Connects his dual blades together and performs a sweeping slash, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Slash Combo
Performs a three-part melee combo consisting of a double hack and a cross slash, dealing 40% ATK, 40% ATK, 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Ominous Spirit Unleashed
When his HP is lower than 70%, he may enter an enhanced state, gaining enhanced attacks and high Interruption Resistance. This state lasts for 20 seconds.
Returning Frostwheel
Connects his dual blades and throws it out as a vertical wheel that travels a short distance and returns to him, dealing 25% ATK × 2 as Cryo DMG on hit. This attack is only used while enhanced.
Boomerang

Connects his dual blades and throws it out as a horizontal disc that travels in a circle and and returns to him, dealing 35% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit and then follows up with one Returning Frostwheel. This attack is only used while enhanced.
Taunt
If the player is far away, he will hold his blades outwards to taunt the player. This leaves him open to attacks.

lore: A member of a loosely-organized mercenary corps from the golden desert sands. Will work for anyone as long as the pay is good. This desert warrior wields a large curved blade in battle. The skills such fighters boast of have been passed down since the days when their now-lost civilization was still extant, and are not only techniques to be used in battle, but also serve well as a performing art popular in various lands. It is said that this sword art was once practiced from horseback.
attacks: Slash and Dodge
Slashes once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG, then jumps backwards.
Rapid Swing Approach
Repeatedly swings his sword while slowly approaching the player, dealing 15% ATK as Physical DMG. If this attack hits the player, immediately follows up with Slash and Dodge.
Taunt

Either points their sword at the player or shows off their handling of it. During the sword trick variant of the taunt, hitting the Sword-Dancer with a projectile or lunging attack will cause them to be knocked down.

lore: A strange monster that must continually absorb heat to stay in an active state. The ancient civilization used many different types of golden designs to drive the flow of phlogiston, allowing massive constructs and magnificent cities to operate under the wisdom of the golden patterns. It is said that in addition to machines with fixed structures, the creatures known as Avatars of Lava are actually badly damaged lifeforms that were once created in the same way. However, after the flames of the sacred mountain were extinguished, most of them lost their sense of purpose and direction.
tips: A strange monster that needs to constantly absorb thermal energy to survive. However, it seems to damage itself should it absorb too much. After you use Pyro attacks to cause it to fully enter an Overburn state, it will rapidly disintegrate.
attacks: Erosion

When the Eroding Avatar of Lava is hit by a Pyro attack, it will gain 1% Fury for every 1 GU of Pyro it applies. When the Fury bar reaches 20%, 40%, and 60%, it will take True Physical DMG equal to 11.25%, 9%, and 6.75% of its Max HP respectively.
Melee Combo 1
Performs two horizontal punches and one downward smash, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK as Geo DMG.
Melee Combo 2

Performs a diagonal punch and one downward smash, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Geo DMG, and sending a wave of rocks forward, dealing 70% ATK as Geo DMG. Repeated hits by the wave have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Rock Throw
If the player is far away, throws a large rock at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Rolling Smash
If the player is far away, transforms itself into a ball and rolls towards the player. Upon reaching the player, performs one downward smash, dealing 90% ATK as Geo DMG.
Double Protection
Possesses both a Geo Ward and a Fury bar. The Ward is weakest against Geo and Blunt Attacks, and the Fury bar will fill upon being hit by Pyro. While the Ward is active, it is immune to all DMG.
Earthshaker Strike

Enlarges its fists and performs three consecutive ground smashes with increasing range, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 100% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack is only used as long as one of two protections are active.

lore: Shouki no Kami, as an artificial divinity created using all the might of Sumeru's Six Darshans, has power that rivals that of true gods. But those of this world who call such a being a "false deity" misunderstand the true meaning of the word. Shouki no Kami now understands countless things and shoulders unassailable might, and may be said to surpass mortals. If gods must love mortals, then Shouki no Kami, who grants failure in equal measure to humanity, loves them also. If gods must watch over humanity, ... ... then Shouki no Kami, who has borne witness to infinite love, hatred, partings, grudges, and maddening anger — thus does he watch over mortals.

"Too much happiness you have had!" "It has made you foolish. Arrogant. Horrifying in your greed." "Let this era end!" "Let the new god announce the defeat of the old." "Foolish mortal... There is yet time for you to kneel."
attacks: Raw Frost/Remnant Flame

When Shouki no Kami uses Cryo or Pyro attacks, they will cover tiles of the floor with the Raw Frost or Remnant Flame effect. Affected floor tiles will deal 5% ATK as Cryo DMG or 15% ATK as Pyro DMG every 0.5s when stepped on.
Arm Slam

Slams one arm down and creates a shockwave, dealing 75% ATK, 100% ATK as Pyro DMG or Cryo DMG. After some time, swipes his arm across the arena, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG or Cryo DMG to players in its path. A large Energy Block will spawn after this attack.
Arm Combo

Moves one arm across the arena while continuously spraying ice or fire from the palm, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG or Pyro DMG every 0.1s, then slams his other arm down, dealing 66% ATK as Pyro DMG or Cryo DMG.
Waterspout

Summons 3 vortexes that pull nearby players in while dealing 33% ATK as Anemo DMG every 0.5s, then transforms them into waterspouts that move around the arena and deal 50% ATK as Hydro DMG every 0.5s.
Electrostreak

Shoots a massive beam at the floor, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG every 0.5s across the entire arena. At the end of the attack, unleashes a more powerful shockwave, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG across the entire arena.
Shard Rain

Summons countless Electro shards to rain down, each dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. Afterwards, forms 2 large prisms that travel towards the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG upon landing. 2 small Energy Blocks will spawn after this attack.
Laser Array

Summons an array of of laser cannons to surround himself, continuously rotating and firing off many large laser beams that deal 100% ATK as Electro DMG on hit. A large Energy Block will spawn after this attack.
Partial Paralysis Recovery
If one of the Electro matrices is activated, Shouki no Kami will raise one of his hands and summon thunderbolts to strike down, dealing 66% ATK as Electro DMG.
Triple Earthshock

Performs a 3-part combo consisting of a stomp with his foot and 2 slams with his arm, dealing 75% ATK, 75% ATK, 100% ATK as Electro DMG. The final slam sends out an expanding wave that deals 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Thunder Lance

Thrusts two pairs of massive lances into the ground. Each deals 100% ATK as Electro DMG on landing and will continue to deal 25% ATK as Electro DMG every 0.5s in the impacted area. A large Energy Block will spawn after this attack.
Bomb Scatter

Scatters many Cryo, Hydro, and Pyro bombs on the floor, each dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG, Hydro DMG, or Pyro DMG upon landing, then conjures countless sparks that strike the ground randomly, each dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG, Hydro DMG, or Pyro DMG.

lore: To push his heretical experiments to their end, Dottore has severed the constraints of his corporeal form. Now, he has merged as one with the Irminsul that threads through all of Teyvat. This world inherently predates any natural order. Until it cast its gaze, the origin and terminus of all matter were indeterminate. Yet the weak, seeking to escape the crushing weight of freedom, would rather bow before the throne of "Certainty." Only those with the resolve to pierce the veil of mundane perception may earn the right to forge a "new world." That is the domain of "Possibility" — a perpetual and magnificent experiment that shall never reach its end. It's time to enliven this stagnant, unchanging reality... "How can you be certain that I am not capable of perfecting it?"
attacks: Cube Array
Raises his right arm, causing a transparent barrier of red Irminsul to appear behind him. Shortly afterwards, launches cubes in front of him, dealing 85% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Electro Shot
Flies into the air and fires an Electro cube, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG. May teleport to use this attack if the player is far away.
Cryo Spikes
Flicks his right hand, launching Cryo spikes in a cone formation that deals 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Electro Strike
Targets a large area around him before rising up and slamming the ground with his right fist, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG. May teleport to use this attack if the player is far away.
Electro Wave
Raises his right fist, launching a line of 5 Electro eruptions in front of him, dealing 25% ATK, 30% ATK, 35% ATK, 45% ATK, 55% ATK as Electro DMG. May be followed by Cryo Strike.
Crushing Walls

Summons two transparent barriers of blue Irminsul to the sides before slamming them on each other, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG if caught. Follows up with Electro Waves. When HP is lower than 70%, follows up with with Electro Shot then Electro Waves.
Triple Strike

When the player is far away, spawns 3 overlapping circular indicators that in sequence, fill and erupt into jagged spikes, dealing 55% ATK as Cryo DMG. When HP is lower than 70%, this attack will also be used at close range, and is followed by Cryo Strike.
Circular Sweep
Extremely rarely, performs a circular sweep in front of himself, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Digital Waves
When the player is far away, launches two corrupted Irminsul waves at the player, each dealing 65% ATK as Physical DMG.
Zig-Zag Approach
When the player is far away, teleports toward the player in a zig-zag pattern.
Stagger Protection
If staggered twice within the span of 5s, Dottore will blink away.
Tidal Wave
Launches three sets of corrupted Irminsul waves at the player, each dealing 45% ATK as Physical DMG.
Corruption Blast

Teleports to the edge of the arena. Dottore will then summon a barrier of corrupted Irminsul to protect him, temporarily increasing his RES by 300%, gaining a Fury bar, and beginning a 35s countdown. The barrier is supported by two nodes on each side.
Chess Pieces

Summons a copy of the Chess Game: King Piece and Chess Game: Queen Piece. The King Piece will use Summon Rook, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG while the Queen Piece will use Queen's Twinblade, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Eruptions
Targets the area surrounding the player with four rapid eruptions from the ground, each dealing 35% ATK as Physical DMG.
Grid Strike
Summons a line at each of the 4 edges of the arena, before having them cross to the other side, dealing 35% ATK as Physical DMG on contact.
Musou no Hitotachi
Teleports to the north central edge of the platform and manifests a copy of the Musou no Hitotachi, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG over a large area.
Abyssal Strike

Summons Xiuhcoatl's Pyro sword and slashes with it, unleashing a Pyro wave that deals 80% ATK as Pyro DMG followed by a Cryo wave that deals 80% ATK as Cryo DMG and finishes by summoning wings that launch numerous projectiles across the arena, each dealing…

lore: The corporeal form of extremely high-quality Anemo energies. The formation of an Eye of the Storm indicates that the elemental ley lines of a region are blocked, which has led to siltation. Its reckless, heedless wielding of storms that all but sweeps people off their feet may be due to its nature as a symbol of the world stricken by malaise.
tips: A dangerous opponent that can summon a Hurricane Sphere to deal sustained DMG. Try using the Wind Current generated in the center to swiftly leave the ground.
attacks: Vacuum Crash

Creates a Vacuum Field that draws the player to the middle of the circle, and then crashes down hard at the center, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG. After using this ability, it will be stunned temporarily.
Tornado
While in mid-air, the Eye of the Storm charges for a while, and then quickly forms a tornado that charges in a straight line, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG to players that come in contact.
Domain of the Wild Wind
Flies high, and starts to channel Anemo power to the earth, creating a wind barrier around it that prevents the player from moving out and deals 20% ATK Anemo DMG upon contact.

lore: A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline. Among the many different Volkodlaks, those resembling giant elephants or mammoths possess some of the noblest bloodlines. Their clan once produced many formidable war leaders, many of whom even served as close retainers to the King of Beasts. Yet the greater an individual fae's power and the longer its life, the harder it becomes for such beings to form a clan. Compared with other Volkodlaks, this type is now far rarer in Snezhnaya.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Slash
Raises its blade before slamming it down in front of it, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Slash Combo
Slashes the player with its blade before slamming its blade onto the ground, dealing 80% ATK, 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Tusk Strike
Imbues its horns with Pyro energy before performing an upward strike, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Snout Shot
Fires a single projectile from its snout, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Punch
Punches with its left fist, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Frenzy
Grabs a flask from its pouch and drinks from it.

lore: A Fatui mage who can command Cryo Cicins in battle. Their origins and what they look like under that mask are both mysteries. Reason dictates that those who lack Visions should not be able to control the elements as these mages do. However, in addition to using Mist Grass to control the Cryo Cicins, they also boldly wield the might of frost. Seeing them as they wander the land in their seemingly aimless way, one can't help but wonder about the duty that must compel them...
attacks: Misty Summons

Summons three Cryo Cicins. Summoned Cicins will despawn when the Cryo Cicin Mage is defeated. The mage will only use this ability when no Cicins are summoned. While summoning Cicins, the mage's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Cicin Pyramid

Commands summoned Cicins to quickly surround the target and simultaneously release a burst, dealing 100% Cicin's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG after a brief delay. After the attack, the Cicins become immobilized briefly.
Cicin Icicle

Teleports summoned Cicins somewhere around the target, then commands them to sequentially charge to the target and release a burst, dealing 100% Cicin's ATK as Cryo DMG after a brief delay. While charging, Cicins deal Cryo DMG on contact.
Cicin Decoy
Swaps positions with summoned Cicin(s), causing them to release a burst afterwards, dealing 100% Cicin's ATK as Cryo DMG.
Flowing Cicin Shield
Conjures or completely replenishes a Cryo shield with energy from summoned Cryo Cicin(s). The shield is weakest to Pyro and can be damaged further with Poise Damage.
Blizzard, Branch, Blossom
Channels Cryo energy to disgorge ice shards from the ground, dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG to surrounding targets.

lore: A Fatui mage who can command Electro Cicins in battle. Their origins and what they look like under that mask are both mysteries. Similarly to the way that Electro Cicins go crazy for Mist Grass, Cicin Mages take great pleasure in toying with their prey.
attacks: Misty Call

Summons three Electro Cicins. Summoned Cicins will despawn when the Electro Cicin Mage is defeated. The Mage will only use this ability when no summoned Cicins are present. While summoning Cicins, the mage's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Hurtling Bolts

Teleports summoned Cicins into a line in front of the Mage and commands them to charge consecutively at the target in balls of Electro, dealing 100% Cicin's ATK as Electro DMG. After charging, Cicins become immobilized briefly.
Blink
Travels through the air to a nearby point as an electric current. The Mage can use this ability immediately after recovering poise, allowing her to blink out of a stagger or knockback animation.
Blink (Approaching)

Consecutively blinks up to 4 times towards the target. The Mage will only use this ability if far from the target. This is considered a different ability than the regular Blink, so the Mage can use them in succession.
Thunderbolt
Summons a falling bolt of Electro energy to strike their foe, dealing 100% ATK as AoE Electro DMG; leaves behind a static charge that deals 25% ATK as Electro DoT to targets within.
Thundering Shield

After ~40 seconds, absorbs all summoned Cicins, deals 100% ATK as Electro DMG to nearby characters and conjures an Electro Cicin Shield, and then begins flying towards the player, and continuously deals 25% ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding targets.

lore: A Fatui secret agent. The duty of a Fatui agent is to settle debts — but not only those of a monetary or goods-in-kind nature. They also ensure dues are paid when it comes to the principle of "an eye for an eye." If there is one thing the Fatui are not known for, it is leniency, and whoever dares to oppose them will invoke the full force of their wrath.
attacks: Prowl

Creates 3 rapidly spinning Pyro knives in a wide circle around them, dealing 25% ATK as Pyro DMG to players hit by them. During this attack, the Pyro Agent's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Stealth

Enters an invisible state, but their silhouette may remain visible should they be affected by certain elements. Their footsteps will show up on certain terrain as well. When using attacks while invisible, the Agent will temporarily show himself.
Melee Slash
At melee range, slashes their target with a swift knife blow, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Thrust
When out of melee range, dashes towards and attacks with their knife, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack can be used while invisible.
Shadow Strike
While invisible, sends a silhouette forward towards the player to deal 75% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Clones

After using Stealth, Pyro Agents create a clone of themselves with Thrust and Shadow Strike a maximum of 6 times. Clones can be removed by any source of damage or elemental applications. Clones are resistant but not immune to Pyro attacks.
Blade Ablaze
