Once 6 clones have been created, all present clones will circle the player before charging at them in sequence, each dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG, with the Pyro Agent performing a final strike from above, dealing 85% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Clone Slash

When the Pyro Agent performs an attack in the invisible state, all present clones will perform a Melee Slash at their location, each dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used by enhanced versions of the Pyro Agent found mostly in Domains.
Blade Ablaze

At the start of battle, charges at the player many times in quick succession, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit, then performs a final strike from above, dealing 85% ATK as Pyro DMG. While charging at the player, the Local Legend imbues himself with Pyro.
Stealth

The Local Legend permanently has his stealth state active, allowing him to stay invisible and untargetable between attacks. Unlike the normal variant, the Local Legend does not become visible even when affected by elements.
Clones

Whenever the Local Legend uses Thrust or Shadow Strike, a clone will be summoned. While a clone is on field, it will launch spinning knives in coordination with the Local Legend's attacks, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Thrust
When out of melee range, dashes towards and attacks with their knife, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Shadow Strike
While invisible, sends a silhouette forward towards the player to deal 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Shadowblade Tactics
After creating six clones, launches a spinning knife at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. Then, dispels all clones and regenerates four new ones, occupying one of them.

lore: A skirmisher armed with the ability to manipulate Anemo and heal their comrades. They departed from their motherland and did so for its sake. They left their family, yet gained allies to stick through thick and thin with. —Perhaps such thoughts are what get them through the unscrupulous work that their missions entail.
tips: Fatui Skirmishers that manipulate Anemo energy to support fellow Fatui in battle. They use restorative Anemo powers on weakened allied skirmishers who've lost their elemental buffs, allowing them to quickly jump back into the fray.
attacks: Interruption Resistance
While performing any attacks, the Anemoboxer Vanguard's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Hurricane Jab
Performs a powerful punch with their gauntlets, dealing 33.3% ATK as Physical DMG.
Gathering the Winds and Avenging Squall
Generates a Stormwind Barrier in front of them capable of blocking attacks from the direction they're facing.
Galeforce Agitation
The Anemoboxer Vanguard will recuperate any nearby Skirmisher that has been stunned from the forced removal of their elemental armor, most times allowing them to reactivate it quickly.

lore: A soldier encased within a Fatui war machine. Armed with equipment that can control the elements to a certain extent, their guns are capable of firing jets of frost. Though this may confer elemental power beyond the ken of ordinary humans, that power may yet come at a price...
tips: Fatui Skirmishers that shoot Cryo projectiles in battle. They receive some kind of elemental buff. Perhaps using an element that reacts with Cryo could make quick work of their buff...
attacks: Freezing Spray
Sprays frost from their cannon in an arc in front of them, continuously dealing 30% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frozen Descent
Leaps into the air and smashes down at the player's location, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Close-Range Charge
If the player strays too near, rams the player with their belly, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when the Elemental Buff is inactive.
Elemental Buff: Cryo
Upon reaching 50% HP or after some time has passed, generates a Cryo shield, granting them a massive increase in Resistances and enhancing their Freezing Spray attack. The shield is weakest to Pyro.
Vengeance
Upon being defeated, leaves behind a large ice field which, deals 40% ATK as Cryo DMG every 0.2 seconds. Vasily will be attracted to the field.

lore: A sturdily-built skirmisher armed with an Electro-powered war-hammer. As a Fatui soldier, one has access to munificent resources: salaries, armaments, and supplies. But at the same time, it also means much time away from home and family and putting one's life in the hands of comrades one has never met.
tips: Fatui Skirmishers that wield a hammer flowing with Electro energy in battle. They receive some kind of elemental buff. Perhaps using an element that reacts with Electro could make quick work of their buff...
attacks: Rapid Hammer Strike
Performs a combo attack that consists of an upward hammer swing, a downward slam, and a sideways swing, dealing 66.6% ATK, 66.6% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG.
Raging Charge

Charges at the player and performs a powerful downward slam, dealing 33.3% ATK as Physical DMG on collision and 100% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG with the slam. If the player is close enough they will not charge and just slam down immediately.
Elemental Buff: Electro

Upon reaching 50% HP or after some time has passed, generates an Electro shield, granting them a massive increase in Resistances, infusing their hammer with Electro and making their attacks Faster. The shield is weakest to Cryo.
Vengeance
Upon being defeated, drops an explosive which after a short delay, deals 300% ATK as Electro DMG and fully restores shields for remaining allies.

lore: A skirmisher with the ability to generate a Geo Ward and defend their allies. Unlike the elite Mages and Agents, Fatui Skirmishers are soldiers of lesser individual might. To complete their tasks and reduce losses in men and material, their tactics are thus more reliant on teamwork.
tips: Fatui Skirmishers that wield staffs to manipulate Geo energy and summon crystallized Wards. They receive some kind of elemental buff. Perhaps using an element that reacts with Geo could make quick work of their buff and Ward alike...
attacks: Rock Projectile
Shoots a small rock projectile from their staff towards the player, dealing 66.6% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Shining Withdraw
Teleports away if the player strays too close. This ability is only used when their Elemental Buff is active.
Crystal Shield

If an ally is nearby, forms a large dome around themselves that blocks ranged projectiles and increases ATK of all allies inside the dome by 20%. This ability is only used when their Elemental Buff is active.
Elemental Buff: Geo

Upon reaching 50% HP or after some time has passed, generates a Geo shield, granting them a massive increase in Resistances and enhancing their abilities. The shield takes Poise Damage, with Blunt Attacks being especially effective.

lore: A soldier encased within a Fatui war machine. Armed with equipment that can control the elements to a certain extent, their guns are capable of firing jets of water. These skirmishers do not question if they shall live or die as they advance into nations far from home to complete reconnaissance missions and lay the groundwork for operations to come.
tips: Fatui Skirmishers that shoot Hydro projectiles in battle. They receive some kind of elemental buff. Perhaps using an element that reacts with Hydro could make quick work of their buff...
attacks: Water Blast
Shoots a fast projectile from their cannon, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Curative Bullet
Shoots a healing bubble at an ally which will heal them over a period of time.
Skilled Charge
If the player strays too near, rams the player with their belly, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when their Elemental Buff is inactive.
Elemental Buff: Hydro

Upon reaching 50% HP or after some time has passed, generates a Hydro shield, granting them a massive increase in Resistances and enhancing their Curative Bullet ability. The shield is weakest to Electro.

lore: A Fatui soldier who wields a flaming gun. Skirmisher weapons can control the elements to a certain extent, and their combat tactics utilize elemental reactions. Their ordnance and knowledge of squad-based combat thus constitute no small threat in battle.
tips: Fatui Skirmishers that shoot Pyro projectiles in battle. They receive some kind of elemental buff. Perhaps using an element that reacts with Pyro could make quick work of their buff...
attacks: Single-Shot Bullet
Shoots a fire bullet from their rifle, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Blazing Retreat
Jumps backwards if the player is too close.
Elemental Buff: Pyro

Upon reaching 50% HP or after some time has passed, generates a Pyro shield, granting them a massive increase in Resistances and enhancing their attacks. The shield is weakest to Hydro. Breaking the shield will leave them stunned and vulnerable to attack.
Vengeance
Upon being defeated, drops fire orbs that go towards remaining allies and increases their ATK by 200%.

lore: A warrior from the plains and a tribal guardian who watches over the golden fields. The art of unarmed combat is regarded with great honor among the Collective of Plenty. Warriors who embark on the long path of training for such an art must possess the strength to hurl a spear a thousand yards.
attacks: Punch
Punches twice, dealing 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Kick
Performs a kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Javelin Throw

Throws a javelin at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and consuming the javelin. The Ferocious Warrior: Grappler possesses 2 javelins initially, and will no longer use this attack once they are both consumed.
Knife Throw
Throws a knife at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when both javelins are consumed.
Ram Crash
Charges at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG upon contact.

lore: A warrior from the plains and a tribal guardian who watches over the golden fields. They are adept at using their horn-studded blades to strike at enemy weak spots — be careful not to let them detect any of yours.
attacks: Swing
Swings his weapon twice, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab
Stabs forward with his weapon, dealing 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Ram Crash
Charges at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG upon contact.

lore: A warrior from the plains and a tribal guardian who watches over the golden fields. They have trained their strength relentlessly since the moment they set their sights on becoming a warrior. When they bring their two-handed weapon down in a mighty strike, the sheer force is something no ordinary person can withstand.
attacks: Swing
Swings his weapon twice, dealing 90% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Smash
Stabs forward with the butt of his weapon and smashes down, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Ram Crash
Charges at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG upon contact.

lore: An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world. Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."
tips: A swarm of monsters that surged through the Rift of Hidden Depths. When several Fishers of Hidden Depths are present on-field, their connections to one another will form Deepdark Shield(s). The shield(s) can only be broken by Elemental Attacks or reaction DMG. Lunar Reaction DMG is especially effective at breaking the shield(s).

When the Deepdark Shield of one of the Fisher of Hidden Depths is broken, the monsters' shared connection causes all Deepdark Shields within the swarm to shatter. The entire swarm will then be grouped around the Fisher whose shield was broken.
attacks: Deepdark Shield

Upon entering combat, roars and generates a Deepdark Shield, which protects it from DMG and enhances its abilities. The Deepdark Shield's durability is equal to 200% Max HP the first time it is generated, but reduces to 50% Max HP for subsequent generations.
Charge
Charges at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG.
Pounce
Backflips and swipes its claws at the player, dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG.
Laser
Fires a laser beam at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG. Repeated hits are reduced according to the Damage Sequence. Multiple Fishers may use this attack in tandem.

floating_anemo_fungus.special: Spores Float, So Do Fungi Float Too?
lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. This mushroom may have a sizable cap, but the umbrella-shaped structure is in fact hollow, and thus does not make for a particularly good meal.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Floating Anemo Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Floating Anemo Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Orb Shot
Shoots an orb of Anemo energy at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.

floating_dendro_fungus.special: Spores Float, So Do Fungi Float Too?
lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. A researcher once said that these are some species of Dendro Specter. After this view was criticized, he changed his tack, claiming that this was just a literary turn of phrase.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Floating Dendro Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Floating Dendro Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Orb Throw
Throws an orb of Dendro energy at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.

floating_hydro_fungus.special: Spores Float, So Do Fungi Float Too?
lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. It is said that it tastes awful. However, such fungi have lots of moisture within them, and so can be used as an emergency water source...
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Floating Hydro Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Floating Hydro Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Bubble Spit
Shoots a bubble at the player, dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG and trapping the player on hit. This bubble will also trap other small enemies and apply the Wet status to them on hit.
Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.

flow_inverted_wayob_manifestation.special: Envoy of Night and Wandering Spirits
lore: The People of the Springs believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls. The so-called "Wayob" is the belief that gradually formed primarily from the tribes and obsidian totems after the people of Natlan began communicating with the kingdom of the Lord of the Night. A "Wayob" is a consciousness of collective thought, and the home of the ancestors' souls. The People of the Springs believe their Wayob has the power to control the tides and waves, and can control the changes of flowing and still, dead waters alike.
tips: The Wayob worshipped by the various tribes of Natlan manifest themselves in the form of these obsidian totems. In battle, the Wayob Manifestation will deploy its Arena: Moment of Trial, creating a Shield for itself and absorbing the Elemental Energy of all characters in the Arena. Characters in the Arena deal greatly increased DMG. If the Shield is broken before the Arena expires, they will also regain a large amount of Energy. However, if they fail to break the Shield, the Manifestation will generate an Elemental Ward based on the value of the remaining Shield.
attacks: Vacuum Burst
Summons a massive vortex which pulls players towards its center. A massive bubble forms and explodes within the vortex, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Mini Bubble
Summons a smaller bubble at the player's location that explodes, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Rupturing Blast
Charges and fires a beam of water, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Arena: Moment of Trial
Deploys an Arena and gains a non-elemental shield equal to 111.4% of the Wayob Manifestation's Max HP which can be destroyed by dealing DMG.
Shield
The Local Legend possesses a Hydro shield with extremely high durability. While the shield is active, it is immune to Frozen and Petrification.
Rotor Spin
Performs a spinning attack, dealing 20% ATK × 3 as Physical DMG.
Hydroflow Constructs

Summons 2 Hydroflow Constructs which move slowly towards the player. When in close proximity with the player or another obstruction, it will explode after a delay, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG. The Hydroflow Constructs can be frozen when hit with Cryo.
Water Spout

Summons a water spout at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG upon appearance. The water spout will linger for a few seconds (which won't deal DMG) and can be frozen into a pillar when hit with Cryo.
Equitable Judgment
Summons 6 Water Spouts across the arena, then releases a continuous water jet at the player for 10 seconds, continuously dealing 250% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Rupturing Blast
Charges and fires a beam of water, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack is only used while unshielded.
Regeneration
After its shield has been broken for a period of time, regenerates its shield and begins charging for 30 seconds. While charging, Hydroflow Constructs will spawn around the arena.

lore: A warrior from the source of the springs, and a tribal guardian that patrols the waters and shores. These warriors always lead the charge, and the swords in their hands are as teeth that saw through bone. The members of the tribe who practice the sword do so in the water, honing their skill and strength against the resistance of the water itself. The best among them can cleave a swimming fish in two.
attacks: Swing
Swings his weapon twice, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab
Stabs forward with his weapon, dealing 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Wavecrash
Charges at the player 3 times, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG upon contact.

lore: A warrior from the source of the springs, and a tribal guardian that patrols the waters and shores. Underestimate the incredible skills these brave harpoon-wielding warriors have gained through hunting and fishing at your peril. It is said that in the past, tribespeople would use these skills to hunt massive sea beasts with fins and scales as tough as iron.
attacks: Punch
Punches twice, dealing 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Kick
Performs a kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Harpoon Throw

Throws a harpoon at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and consuming the harpoon. The Flowing Blade Harpoon-Thrower possesses 2 harpoons initially, and will no longer use this attack once they are both consumed.
Knife Throw
Throws a knife at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when both harpoons are consumed.
Triple Wavecrash
Charges at the player 3 times, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG upon contact.

lore: A warrior from the source of the springs, and a tribal guardian that patrols the waters and shores. In lieu of weapons, these tribal warriors have mastered the techniques of raw, physical combat. Their seemingly ordinary fists and feet contain the power equal to the crashing waves.
attacks: Punch
Punches twice, dealing 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Kick
Performs a kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Wavecrash
Charges at the player 3 times, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG upon contact.

lore: A strange monster that must continually absorb heat to stay in an active state. Once, a more ancient and deep fire burned across all of Natlan in myriad forms. At that time, the once-great primitive residents used these fires to transmit light, heat, and wisdom. They believed that life and the soul too took their initial shape from the sparks that flew when flint was struck. If it possesses an eternally burning core, then even a stubborn stone can bring about life. The embers within the body of the Avatar of Lava seem to be the cold, ash-like remnants of that ancient era.
attacks: Pyro Infusion
The Fluid Avatar of Lava possesses a constant Pyro status.
Melee Combo
Uses its elastic arm to perform a wide sweep and a downward smash, dealing 70% ATK, 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Ranged Combo

Fires 2 lava shots from its hands, each dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG, then inserts its hand into the ground to create a pool of lava at the player's location, which then erupts, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Molten Scattershot
Scatters 10 lava projectiles forward, each dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Inferno Rise
Submerges into the ground and creates a pool of lava at the player's location. Then, reemerges within the lava pool, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.

foliar_swift_wayob_manifestation.special: Envoy of Night and Wandering Spirits
lore: The Scions of the Canopy believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls. In the stories of the storytellers, Wayob manifestations often appear as the messengers of trials, or guides to the kingdom of the Lord of the Night. A Saurian-Crowned Warrior once said that he fought with a Wayob in a trance while practicing his skills, and in doing so, gained deeper understanding. The Scions of the Canopy believe their Wayob has the power to control the growth of fruits and leaves, and can also control the roots of crops and draw the patterns of the veins of leaves.
tips: The Wayob worshipped by the various tribes of Natlan manifest themselves in the form of these obsidian totems. In battle, the Wayob Manifestation will deploy its Arena: Moment of Trial, creating a Shield for itself and absorbing the Elemental Energy of all characters in the Arena. Characters in the Arena deal greatly increased DMG. If the Shield is broken before the Arena expires, they will also regain a large amount of Energy. However, if they fail to break the Shield, the Manifestation will generate an Elemental Ward based on the value of the remaining Shield.
attacks: Chain Bursts

Locks onto the player with a sigil, and after a delay, causes 3 consecutive blasts that expand outward, each dealing 90% ATK as Dendro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Poison Field
Creates a field of poison at the player's location, dealing 20% ATK as Dendro DMG every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds.
Rupturing Blast
Charges and fires a beam of energy, dealing 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Arena: Moment of Trial
Deploys an Arena and gains a non-elemental shield equal to 111.4% of the Wayob Manifestation's Max HP which can be destroyed by dealing DMG.
Special Attack
Summons 7 circular blasts, each dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Land of Decision

Periodically, the Local Legend will exile the player into the Land of Decision. In this land, a single Swiftstep Seeker and Swiftstep Storm Scout will appear. Around these enemies, there is a poison field which deals 30% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.

lore: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land." The ground effect Landcruiser is able to "fly" a certain distance above ground by maintaining lift and generating pressure differentials through firing high-speed jet sprays at the surface, allowing it to more economically achieve combat cruising speed, avoid mines and traps, and perform highly effective assaults. However, costs and limits on operation time mean that mass-produced models carry limited payloads. As such, they are currently limited to Force Recon roles...
attacks: Rapid Fire
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG with each bullet.
Kuuvahki Multi-Projectile Fire
Absorbs kuuvahki into its weaponry before opening its missile launcher and firing a long continuous barrage of bullets at the player lasting 10 seconds, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG with each bullet.

lore: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land." These walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Equipped with Force Recon armaments, this Landcruiser can not only serve as a forward scout for the main force, but can also exploit openings and actively attack the enemy where their lines are weakest, thus playing a similar role to that of traditional cavalry...
attacks: Rapid Fire
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG with each bullet.
Kuuvahki Multi-Projectile Fire
Absorbs kuuvahki into its weaponry before opening its missile launcher and firing a long continuous barrage of bullets at the player lasting 10 seconds, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG with each bullet.

lore: An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land." Equipped with Crawler Track Movement Mechanisms, these Landcruisers are normally used to storm enemy positions, where they can pass over rough terrain such as mud and melting snow despite heavy armor and armaments through their excellent load-bearing capabilities and off-road mobility. Force Recon armaments include a multi-barrel automatic gun, allowing this Landcruiser to adjust its tactics to both close quarters and long-range combat. Whether it be long-range observation or obtaining enemy intel in the midst of fearsome firefights, this Landcruiser model is more than up to the task.
attacks: Rapid Fire
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG with each bullet.
Kuuvahki Multi-Projectile Fire

Absorbs kuuvahki into its weaponry before opening its missile launcher and firing a long continuous barrage of bullets at the player lasting 10 seconds, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG with each bullet.

lore: A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian who patrols the crystal mountains and rivers. A tribal warrior wielding a ball-headed club, she can turn even the hardest of rocks into dust with her crushing blows. When not using her weapon to fight, she instead often smashes open rocks in search of precious gems and traces of phlogiston crystals.
attacks: Swing
Swings her weapon twice, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab
Stabs forward with her weapon, dealing 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Headspin
Performs headspins while moving towards the player, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG upon contact.

lore: A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian that patrols the crystal mountains and rivers. In an era when the ridges were shattered and the tribes needed to rebuild, the warriors used javelins as markers to determine the locations on both sides of the canyon from which passages should be dug. That meant that each javelin had to be sunk deep into the rock.
attacks: Punch
Punches twice, dealing 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Kick
Performs a kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Javelin Throw

Throws a javelin at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and consuming the javelin. The Forged Sand Javelineer possesses 2 javelins initially, and will no longer use this attack once they are both consumed.
Knife Throw
Throws a knife at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when both javelins are consumed.
Headspin
Performs headspins while moving towards the player, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG upon contact.

lore: A valiant warrior of the canyon, and a tribal guardian that patrols the crystal mountains and rivers. Tribal warriors wielding massive warhammers with both hands, they are the vanguard that is the first to breach the enemy's defensive lines. For the Children of Echoes, who delight in gemstones and all manner of crafted ornaments, hammers are often the first tool to be touched by the tribe's warriors as children.
attacks: Swing
Swings his weapon twice, dealing 90% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Smash
Stabs forward with the butt of his weapon and smashes down, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Headspin
Performs headspins while moving towards the player, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG upon contact.

lore: An elite agent among the Fatui. Selected while still children, they can only become an "Operative" after many long years of training and teaching, after countless rounds have winnowed the field. They are the most outstanding soldiers among the Fatui, with extraordinary skill and unswerving loyalty.
tips: An elite Fatui special agent who can manipulate Cryo in battle. In combat, they will use the Hunt Down skill to attach a Bond of Life to characters they hit. While Bond of Life is active, the character will take continuous DMG, and Hunt Down will deal more DMG to them.
attacks: Swift Point
Teleports near the player and thrusts forward, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Spinslash
Dashes backwards, then performs a spinning slash while moving forward, dealing 80% ATK × 3 as Cryo DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Frosty Interjection
Performs a cross slash, fires an ice blast, and performs a blackflip slash, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Hunt Down

Sacrifices 5% of her Max HP (or 25% of current HP if HP percentage is under 20%) to initiate Hunt Down: Locks onto the player, teleports next to the player, and performs a swift retreating slash, dealing 40% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Bloody Pursuit

On Fearless/Dire difficulty in Stygian Onslaught, interruption RES completely amplified, making characters abilities impossible to interrupt and when preparing to use Hunt Down, it will enter the Bloody Pursuit state:

lore: A mysterious "lord" of hilichurls that stalks the snow and fog. This huge hilichurl is referred to as a "lawa" by its brethren. Its body, honed to the very limit, almost seems to blend into its Cryo-filled environment, and its stoic nobility is like that of the frozen northland rivers.
attacks: Punches

Roars and performs a punch with its left arm. It occasionally combos with both arms and slams the ground, dealing 37.5% ATK and 40% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only performed when the Frostarm Lawachurl is not in the Frost Force State.
Infused Frostarm

Generates a shield and enters the Frost Force State for as long as the shield is active. Under this state, it will use more powerful attacks. This shield will degrade over 90 seconds and can be further damaged using Elemental Reactions and Poise Damage.
Frosty Berserker
When in its Frost Force State, the Frostarm Lawachurl may roar and perform Upa Shato, Shockwave, Movo Lawa, and Shockwave in quick succession.
Dash

The Frostarm Lawachurl quickly charges at its target after a roar, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG and leaving 6 ice shards on the ground. Ice shards explode when a player is in close proximity, dealing 25% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charged Punch

Charges and swings its fist at the player with great force, dealing 37.5% ATK as Cryo DMG and sends out ice shards that explode and deal 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only performed when the Frostarm Lawachurl is in the Frost Force State.
Shockwave

Roars and slams both hands into the ground, causing sharp ice to spike from the ground, dealing 50% ATK and 62.5% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack can be done 1-2 times and is only performed when the Frostarm Lawachurl is in the Frost Force State.
Jumping Slam

Roars and jumps into the air, slamming down at the player's position, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and freezing the ground around the landing position, which deals 15% ATK as Cryo DoT to characters who step on it.
Slime Throw
If the player is at a higher elevation or too far away, the Lawachurl will roar and grab a Large Cryo Slime from the ground, throwing it at the player to deal 62.5% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: Proud beings that roam in the waning glow of the moon, wielding ancient powers long since tamed by the Lord of the Sky. Legends say these graceful, mystical beasts were born in the age when the Frost Moon still turned, and, favored by the divine emissary, they would not be tainted by the light of day. Even now, among the followers of the Frost Moon, they are regarded as sacred beasts lost to this world, retreating along secret lunar paths beyond the reach of mortal eyes. Yet, as they have for countless centuries past, they still wander in the shadows of the moon, treading the boundary between two worlds, guarding the lands coveted by calamity, and watching over those who dwell within them — for this is the very oath they first swore to the apostle of the golden city.
tips: An entity deeply affected by the power of the moon, and one of the most exceptional of all the scions. After it changes its form to enter a Gloomveiled state during combat, deal DMG to it to bathe it in light. This will force it to exit this Gloomveiled state and change its Elemental Type to the element whose DMG it received the most during the time it was Gloomveiled. If this was Lunar Reaction DMG, it will change its Elemental Type to Elementless.
attacks: Single Sweep
Sweeps the surrounding area with its wing, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG. If an element is absorbed via Gloomveiled state, deals the corresponding Elemental DMG instead.
Triple Sweep
Sweeps its wing 3 times, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Physical DMG. If an element is absorbed via Gloomveiled state, deals the corresponding Elemental DMG instead.
Moon Projectiles

Generates a crescent moon above its head and launches numerous projectiles at the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. If an element is absorbed via Gloomveiled state, deals the corresponding Elemental DMG instead.
Plunging Strike

Rises into the air and spreads its wings out before crashing onto the player's location in a large AoE, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. If an element is absorbed via Gloomveiled State, deals the corresponding Elemental DMG instead.
Gloomveiled State

Teleports to the center of the arena and generates a Fury bar. During the charging sequence, its RES to all DMG will increase by 120%, and it will launch wind blades across the arena, each dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Crashing Projectiles
While in its Gloomveiled state, large spherical projectiles will fall from above in a large AoE, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Enhanced Single Sweep
Sweeps the surrounding area with its wing, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used in its Gloomveiled State.
Enhanced Triple Sweep
Sweeps its wing 3 times, dealing 70% ATK, 70% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used in its Gloomveiled State.
Double Slash
Flies slightly into the air before using its wings to launch two air blades at the player, dealing 70% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used in its Gloomveiled State.
Enhanced Shockwave
Raises its front legs before slamming them onto the ground, generating a shockwave towards the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used in its Gloomveiled State.

furnace_shell_mountain_weasel.special: Hunter of the Ancient Sacred Mountain
lore: An ancient variant of mountain weasel that has adapted to a unique, Phlogiston-rich environment isolated from the outside world. By consuming creatures rich in Phlogiston, this species accumulates power in the shell it holds. After a prolonged existence in the ruins of the Sacred Mountain, its affinity for Phlogiston seems to have caused it to be influenced by the Source Mechanisms within the ruins, creating a unique symbiotic relationship between them.
tips: A unique ancient species of mountain beast that has long lived in the Sacred Mountain Ruins and has formed an interdependent relationship with the Source Mechanism. During battle, the Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel will burrow underground and activate its "Secret Source Core" to periodically attack surrounding enemies. At this time, dealing enough damage to the "Secret Source Core" will force it to emerge from underground. However, since it is hiding underground, using a Plunging Attack might prove more effective...
attacks: Melee Combo
Attacks with its claw followed by its tail, dealing 45% ATK, 60% ATK as Pyro DMG. May combo into a Tail Smash.
Tail Smash
Performs a front flip and smashes the ground with its tail, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Rolling Charge
If the player is far away, rolls towards the player, repeatedly dealing 10% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit. After rolling, performs a leaping tail slam, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Scorch Ray
Fires a fiery beam at the player using its Secret Source core, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Activate Core

Burrows underground and activates its Secret Source Core, gaining an elementless ward equal to 100% of its Max HP. While the core is active, periodically releases a shockwave, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG, up to a total of 4 times.

lore: Code name: Gimel. A high-purity Geo entity. Elemental hypostases are ultra-compact structures with a high mass. Concentrated elemental energy forms a solid shell around the core of the hypostasis, leaving only the core reactive to elemental stimuli.
tips: Elemental creatures who protect themselves from incoming attack with their durable shell. Find an opportune moment to land a blow to their elemental core. They are able to create Geo constructs in fights and restore their health when they feel threatened. You must be able to efficiently destroy these constructs if you want to defeat these creatures.
attacks: Summon Pillars

Summons 4 pillars in a large triangle formation around the arena, it will sit on one at a time and teleport between them. These pillars take Poise Damage, and are weakest against Blunt Attacks. When a pillar is destroyed, a Geo Energy Orb will be generated.
Stone Pellets
Flies into the air and forms a rhombus with its shell pieces before absorbing them all and using them to fire a continuous stream of stone pellets, dealing 25% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Stone Seal
Floats into the air and forms a sort of flat, plated formation out of shell pieces while channeling a Geo seal around the player.
Shockwave
Floats into the air and briefly channels energy into the pillar it is floating on before emitting a single shockwave, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack cannot be avoided using dash i-frames.
Tremors
Spirals into the air and channels energy into its pillar, causing all pillars to emit continuous shockwaves for the duration of the attack, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DoT.
Hammerfall

Teleports next to the player and forms its shell pieces into a giant hammer that it smashes into the ground, dealing 150% ATK as Geo DMG and sending out three trails of shockwaves in front of it that deal 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Clap
Quickly flies next to the player and forms a large wall, which folds in a "clapping" motion very quickly, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG in front of the wall.
Rain of Rocks

Causes pellets to continuously rain down in various small areas around the arena, dealing 25% ATK as Geo DoT. Particularly large chunks of rock periodically fall in the same areas, dealing 75% ATK as Geo DMG.
Terra Resurgence

When HP is low (approx. 5%), the Hypostasis teleports to the center of the arena and forms 3 pillars that channel Geo energy. After 15 seconds, the pillars are absorbed to heal 15%/35%/50% of its HP for 1/2/3 pillars absorbed.

lore: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that listens to the strength of Geo. Hilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. To the persevering mountains, these old hilichurls are but children, but their memories and experiences have guided them towards gaining power over rock and stone.
tips: Uses Geo attributes to form a solid stone pillar to separate itself from harm. The stone pillar can be destroyed with heavy Geo attacks, Claymore attacks, or strong explosions. If you can defeat it swiftly, its magical power will also vanish.
attacks: Rock Spikes
Summons rock spikes that erupt from the ground at the player's location, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Summoning of Stones
Summons pillars below itself and any nearby Samachurls, Hilichurl Shooters, and Abyss Mages, giving them a higher ground to attack. Blunt Attacks are the most effective at damaging these pillars.
Shattering Shockwaves
Periodically releases shockwaves around the summoned pillars, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Staff Strike
If the player is within melee range, swings its staff at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back. The Samachurl also falls in the process due to the staff's weight.

lore: Small monsters created through the buildup of Geo within the earth. Generally speaking, the crust of the earth is filled with Geo energy. Geo Slimes that are formed this way have a similarly "down-to-earth" sort of feeling.
attacks: Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A monster birthed from a high concentration of Geo that can float in the air. Geo Specters mimic the fruit of certain plants when their wings are closed together. As such, they are held by some ancient tales to be the fruit of a giant tree in the sky, and are regarded as having mysterious medical value.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury
Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated.
Rock Spit
Shoots three small homing rocks that deal 80% ATK as Geo DMG. The shots also knock the Specter backwards.
Propeller Bump
Spins before knocking into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Earthquake
Shoots a projectile at the ground under it that bursts into an earthquake that deals 100% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack will only occur at max Fury and will be the only attack it uses in that state.
Final Burst
Explodes after a short pause when defeated dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG. If at max Fury, DMG is increased to 120% ATK and AoE is increased significantly.

lore: A clockwork meka designed for surveying underground resources and certain minerals. Due to the fact that the desired metal type can be set, this device has proven very popular among Treasure Hoarders and Adventurers alike.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Geological Survey Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Stab
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Attacks the player with its two front legs, each dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Shot
Fires 3 consecutive projectiles at the player, each dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Shockwaves
Releases 3 consecutive shockwaves around itself, each dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: A mature Geovishap. It is said that after many years have passed, Geovishap Hatchlings will shed the armor that originally protected them and become Geovishaps. However, these two and the older, greater Primo Geovishaps have spent many years hibernating under the mountains, and have only emerged and become active in recent times. As such, none can personally attest to having witnessed or recorded such a thing in person.
tips: A bulky, adult Geovishap. In one of its modes of attack, if it hits a character with a shield and fails to break the shield, it will be stunned for a moment by the recoil...
attacks: Elemental Conversion

After reaching 40% HP or after enough time has passed, the Geovishap will draw elemental energy from its environment to absorb either Cryo, Electro, Hydro or Pyro, gaining a persistent elemental aura and enhancing some of its attacks based on the element…
Charge Attack

The Geovishap curls up into a ball and charges towards the player's location, dealing 30% ATK as Geo DMG. Subsequently, if this attack hits the player, it will perform a single jump attack, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG.
Jump Attack

The Geovishap will perform two jump attacks, jumping in the air and landing on the player's location, dealing 40% ATK and 60% ATK as Geo DMG. After this attack, it will temporarily be stunned for a couple seconds.
Slash and Punch

The Geovishap approaches the player, and then either performs a slash with its right hand claws or a slam where it will also drag its claw back towards itself, dealing 50% ATK and 40% ATK as Geo DMG, respectively.
Spike Attack

The Geovishap will perform a combo consisting of slams, first with its right hand, then its left, then both hands at once. Each slam will send out a line of spikes that chases the target. Each spike deals 16.5% ATK as Geo DMG.
Revival
If one Geovishap's HP reaches 1.2% and the other Geovishap is not defeated within the next 15 seconds, the defeated Geovishap will be revived with 20% of its Max HP.
Elemental Breath
Both Geovishaps leap to one side of the arena, dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG and Cryo DMG on landing.
Rolling Charge

Both Geovishaps leap to one side of the arena, dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG and Cryo DMG on landing. They then roar and curl up into balls to roll towards the player, dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG and Cryo DMG on hit.
Elemental Conversion
Infuses itself with Pyro immediately when in combat.
Triple Smash
Smashes the ground with its hands three times, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 75% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Slash and Pull

Performs a slash with its right hand, dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG, then punches its left hand into the ground and pulls it out, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG. The 2nd hit will knock players towards the Geovishap.
Leaping Smash
Leaps up and smashes down at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG but leaving itself stunned for a few seconds.
Elemental Conversion
Infuses itself with Cryo immediately when in combat.
Triple Smash
Smashes the ground with its hands three times, sending forward 1, 1, and 2 wave of icicles that spike from the ground, each dealing 30% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Slash and Pull

Performs a slash with its right hand, dealing 40% ATK as Cryo DMG, then punches its left hand into the ground and pulls it out, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. The 2nd hit will knock players towards the Geovishap.
Icicle Scatter

Fires 4 icicles in the player's general direction, each dealing 30% ATK as Cryo DMG on landing, and leaving behind an ice spike that detonates when the player comes in contact, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A young vishap with a hard Geo exoskeleton. Vishaps are exceptionally agile creatures that one would be wise not to underestimate in battle. Experts from Sumeru Akademiya believe that they become dragons when fully grown. By avoiding predators and natural disasters, perhaps they can even live long enough to become formidable beasts that reign over entire mountains.
tips: A small and very nimble lizard hatchling. When its attacks are deflected by a character with a shield, it seems to be paralyzed for a moment by the recoil...
attacks: Slash Attack
Approaches and performs a cross slash with its claws, dealing 55.5% ATK as Geo DMG.
Spinning Attack

Leaps into the air, curls up and starts spinning like a top at high speeds upon landing, dealing 44.4% ATK once as Physical DMG and continuously interrupting the player, before dealing 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG with the final spin.
Rolling Attack

Curls up into a ball and starts rolling around at high speeds, dealing 33.3% ATK as Geo DMG to the player on contact. The Hatchling does not target you and instead rolls around randomly while changing directions randomly.
Charge Attack
Curls up into a ball and rolls towards the player. On hit, deals 83.3% ATK as Physical DMG then bounces backwards and jumps back, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on landing.
Leap
Leaps into the air and smashes down at the player's location, dealing 83.3% ATK as Physical DMG.
Burrow
Burrows into the ground and pops up a fair distance away, or next to the player.

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Geo, resulting in its present form. Just about its entire body is covered by the accumulated Geo, while its tough antlers gleam with the luster of polished amber. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Swipe
Swipes at the player with its ring of crystals, dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG. While in the Gloomveiled state, performs another swipe, dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG.
Crystal Ball

Forms and launches a stone crystal ball at the player that deals 100% ATK as Geo DMG upon impact. While in the Gloomveiled state, the crystal ball will additionally scatter 5 crystal fragments mid-air that deal 10% ATK as Geo DMG on impact.
Stomp
Stomps the ground in front of it with its front legs, dealing 70% ATK as Geo DMG.
Gloomveil

Periodically enters a Gloomveiled state, increasing its RES to all DMG except Geo by 50%, enhancing its attacks, and gaining the ability to relocate by disappearing and reappearing, but also losing its immunity to Geo (Geo RES in this state is 100%).
Back Kick
Kicks backward with its hind legs, dealing 70% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack may be used immediately after it enters the Gloomveiled state, and cannot be used more than once per instance of this state.
Crystal Hail

Conjures a crystal ball above its body and slowly walks around the player. Teleports next to the player before firing three bursts of 4 lasers at the ground around it while walking around, dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice. Male Snegovik are natural-born knights, and most are born able to freely forge weapons from ice and snow. Legend tells that during the Belyi Tsar's campaign against the dark tide, a Snegovik serving as his guard unleashed a power that didn't belong to his kind, transforming into a towering giant. Though his final fate remains unknown, one who violated such a taboo surely could not have met with a happy end.
tips: When the fae known as the Snegovik feel threatened, they will ensconce themselves within an ice coffin. The ice coffin can be weakened by the Stellar Glimmer reaction and become more easily broken with Electro or Anemo attacks. When the ice coffin is intact, the Snegovik inside can recover a certain amount of lost HP. But when the ice coffin shatters, the unfortunate Snegovik inside will go along with it...
attacks: Double Punch
Punches with his right fist, dealing ?% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frost Barrage
Conjures three frozen shards with his right hand and launches them at the player, dealing ?% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frost Mace
Conjures a massive frost mace and swings it twice in front of him, dealing ?% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frost Slam
If far enough from the warden, conjures his mace before leaping and slamming onto the player's position, dealing ?% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Ice Coffin
Upon reaching ?% of his Max HP, immediately encases himself in an ice coffin, applying a Cryo Ward to himself. While entombed, he is unable to perform any other actions.

lore: A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice. Female Snegovik are known as Snegurochka, and most are born as mages capable of freely wielding the power of ice and snow. It's said that when Snegovik were first created, their souls were incomplete, and only by falling in love with humans could they make themselves whole. Yet once a Snegovik has attained wholeness, does it still need love? Perhaps not. Maybe this is why so many stories of love between Snegovik and human end in tragedy.
tips: When the fae known as the Snegovik feel threatened, they will ensconce themselves within an ice coffin. The ice coffin can be weakened by the Stellar Glimmer reaction and become more easily broken with Electro or Anemo attacks. When the ice coffin is intact, the Snegovik inside can recover a certain amount of lost HP. But when the ice coffin shatters, the unfortunate Snegovik inside will go along with it...
attacks: Ice Crystal
Condenses a large cluster of ice crystals and hurls it at the player, dealing ?% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frost Spikes
Continuously fires 4 ice spikes, dealing ?% ATK as Cryo DMG with the first hit and ?% ATK as Cryo DMG with each subsequent hit.
Ice Coffin

Upon reaching ?% of her Max HP, she encases herself in an Ice Coffin, becoming unable to act. After 16 seconds, the coffin is removed, and she restores ?% of her Max HP. This effect can only trigger once.

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Electro, resulting in its present form. One of the manifestations with the most violent temperament, it commands steel-shattering bolts of lightning like mere servants, such that any land it passes through shall be marked as if by a marauding, thunderous calamity. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Electro Aura
While not in the Gloomveiled state, the Frostnight Scion has an immutable Electro aura.
Tail Swipe
Swings its tail at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG. If in a Gloomveiled state, may perform another swipe, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG, and/or combo into Tail Slam.
Tail Slam
Slams its tail at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG. If in a Gloomveiled state, summons a trail of 3 lightning strikes after the slam, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG with each strike.
Stomp
Stomps the ground in front of it, dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Gloomveil

Periodically enters a Gloomveiled state, increasing its RES to all DMG except Electro by 50%, enhancing its attacks, and gaining the ability to relocate by disappearing and reappearing, but also losing its immunity to Electro (Electro RES in this state is…
Back Kick
Performs a kick with its hind legs, dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack is only used while in the Gloomveiled state.
Tri-Shot

Relocates away from the player and summons three orbs above it that fire beams outward in a spread pattern, each dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. The center orb always aims at the player. This attack is only used while in the Gloomveiled state.

lore: Hailing from a dark world, this ruler of the black wolves has the power to call upon its followers, its hidden claws, to dissolve space itself and forge a rift through which it may enter. The Wolflord has no name, for it was but one of "Gold"'s unintentional creations, and that is precisely why it is obsessed with invading worlds that do not belong to it and making a name for itself. That said, the wolf pack is far from unintelligent. After suffering a defeat in its previous invasion, a deserted island where no humans or protectors dwell has been selected for them to prepare for their lord's descent.
tips: The king of the Riftwolves. The Golden Wolflord's attacks can apply stacks of the "Corrosion" status, which will cause all characters in the party to continuously lose HP. In combat, the Wolflord will summon Rifthound Skulls to provide it with a Ward. It can also enter the Elemental Devourer state, which will decrease its Geo RES and increase its offensive capabilities. Attack the Rifthound Skulls with Geo DMG to destroy the Golden Wolflord's Ward swiftly.
attacks: Corrosion
As with all Riftwolves, the Golden Wolflord is capable of inflicting stacks of Corrosion with its attacks.
Tornado

The Golden Wolflord generates a massive tornado that moves around the arena, randomly and rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG. Repeated hits will have their DMG reduced according to its Damage Sequence.
Laser Beam

The Golden Wolflord fires a laser beam from its mouth, raking across the arena, randomly and rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG to players caught in the beam. Repeated hits will have their DMG reduced according to its Damage Sequence.
Ramming Attack
The Golden Wolflord rams the player with its mass, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG on hit. The Golden Wolflord will be stunned after this attack. This attack is not used while shielded.
Skull Strike
The Golden Wolflord sends its skulls to attack the player in sets of three, one at a time, each dealing 25% ATK as Geo DMG on impact.
Sweep
Sweeps the surrounding area with its tail, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Rifthound Skulls + Elemental Devourer

Upon reaching 70% HP, the Golden Wolflord enters the Elemental Devourer state and generates a shield, pushing nearby players away, and summoning 3 Rifthound Skulls to the edges of the arena that deal 50% ATK as Geo DMG on landing.Zach Aguilar calls these…
Earthshaking Dive
Flies up and dives into the ground with great force, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG in a massive area covering the majority of the arena.

lore: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability. This being has undergone almost complete keratinization due to the influence of Geo. When one considers that Fungi evolved from spores, perhaps this one might even be the foundation for a further evolution into some new life form altogether — if given time, that is. This creature has a position of command amongst colonies of fungal beasts and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift
When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Grounded Geoshroom will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Grounded Geoshroom can only undergo state shift once.
Melee Combo
Combos 2 melee strikes, dealing 70% ATK, 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charge
Charges towards the player, dealing 30% ATK, 85% ATK as Geo DMG.
Head Slam
Performs a front flip and smashes the ground with its head, dealing 30% ATK, 85% ATK as Geo DMG.
State Shift
Immediately enters the Scorched state upon spawning, indicated with a Fury bar. Unlike its original, it is able to shift between Scorched, normal and Activated states indefinitely.
Projectiles
Flings two Geo projectiles from its cap, dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG. Only used in the Scorched state. This attack is affected by the Damage Sequence.
Scorched Charge
Charges at the player before flinging its cap upwards, dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG. Only used in the Scorched state.
Slam Combo
Grows in size before jumping up and attempting to crush the player with its cap 6 times, the first 5 slams dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG, and the final slam dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Sweep
If directly next to the Geoshroom in its Scorched state, it will sweep its head in a circle around it, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG.
Kick
If too close, briefly steps back before kicking the player, dealing 25% ATK as Geo DMG. Only used in its normal state.
Roar
Briefly roars for no effect. Only used in its normal state.
Fungal Barrage
When struck with any instance of Electro DMG in its normal state, the boss will dance around as a warning action, and increase its Activation progress by 1, which counts at most once every 3 seconds.

lore: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability. This creature may look like a bird, but it cannot fly. Due to the influence of Hydro energies, it is astoundingly agile compared to others of its kind. Some research has inferred that this creature is in fact an aggregation of countless tiny spores rather than a single entity. This creature has a position of command amongst colonies of Fungi and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Grounded Hydroshroom will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Grounded Hydroshroom can only undergo state shift once.
Kick
Kicks the player, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: An ancient Snegovik held in high esteem among her kin. She once served the legendary Great Snegurochka, whose name was steeped in crimson infamy, and was entrusted with the solemn duty of protecting the Snegovik clan for the rest of her life. It is said that seven were given this charge, but she alone remains. Every succession of the Snegovik sovereign must therefore take place under her watchful eye. After the current Snegurochka princess ascended to power, she left the clan's manor in the mountains — perhaps because their ideals no longer aligned.
tips: When the Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow's HP falls below a certain level, it will ensconce itself in an ice coffin and periodically deal AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents. Ice coffins can become fragile from Stellar Glimmer reactions. When this happens, they are especially vulnerable to Electro and Anemo attacks. If the ice coffin hasn't taken damage, she will recover some HP and forge an ice blade to counterattack. However, if the ice coffin has taken damage, she becomes weakened for some time...
attacks: Circular Slash
Summons a second sword and slashes in a spinning motion, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Double Slash
Slashes with her sword once and again in a wider range, dealing 40% ATK and 40% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Piercing Strike
Thrusts her sword at her target, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. Can follow up with Circular Slash.
Blade Flourish
Slashes twice, dealing 30% ATK as Cryo DMG and follows up with Double Slash.
Icicle Scatter
Summons six icicles and flings three at a time toward her target's location, dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Ice Coffin

Upon reaching 50% of her Max HP, after 10s, teleports to the center of the arena and encases herself in an ice coffin, applying a Cryo Ward to herself and dealing 3.1% ATK as DoT Cryo DMG each 0.5 seconds.

lore: Apep once walked through an ocean of fragrant grass, gigantic trees, and unimaginably long vines like a fish with its many offspring swimming through the sea. Finally, the grass, trees, and vines withered and turned to dust, while countless beings as minute as grains of gravel built a fragile kingdom upon Apep's land. Apep and its offspring let the sea of sand rage like boiling water and swept houses down as if they were falling leaves. Until the day when the new Lord of Sand reconciled with the king who lost their homeland, the dunes under the sun belonged to humanity, while the dragon's oasis remained in the hearts of the dragons. Apep shared the knowledge of evolution with its many offspring, because spreading knowledge ensures dissemination while the stagnation of hoarded wisdom courted only decay. Till the day the promise between it and the Lord of Sand was finally attained, with ultimate wisdom claimed. Henceforth, it reaped only sights of oblivion, of an endless calamity. Apep found itself swallowed alone amidst the scenery of the catastrophe. All the people, gods, dragons, beasts, birds, and fish. All memories, wisdom, words, and hatred were ground into colorless dust, and the last of the moonlight burned away into a rain of pale fire, falling on the barren land. ... Apep once deemed the bottom of the sea of sand to be its grave, not the palace of a dispossessed king. The poison of "wisdom" would soon free Apep from the hatred and anger festering within it over countless moons. Apep had grown weary of the colorless apocalypse. Then, finally, the young god and the golden Traveler let it recall once again, even though the verdant land it once ruled had been reduced to this gilded wasteland, even though Apep and its many offspring had grown twisted and wretched to secure their continued survival therein, Apep still treasured the sight and scenes of the oasis, sparkling in its heart.
attacks: Emerging Strike
Submerges into the ground and reemerges at the player's location, then swipes with both of its front limbs, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Body Sweep
Spins its body to sweep over a large area, dealing 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
4-Part Combo

Performs a combo consisting of a swipe, a slam, a sweep, and another slam, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG. This combo may also end early at the 2nd part, or may start from the 2nd part.
Remote Crusher
Inserts 4 limbs into the ground, which reemerge at the player's location and slam down successively, each dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Slam

Reemerges at the center of the arena and slams the ground thrice, dealing 70% ATK, 70% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG. Also sends out a wave of spiky orbs with each slam, which may home towards the player and deals 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Tail Sweep
If the player is behind it, swipes its tail twice, dealing 70% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Emerging Strike
Submerges into the ground and reemerges at the player's location, then sweeps with its body, dealing 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Triple Airstrike
Marks a large area on the ground and summons elemental energy to strike down, for a total of 3 times, dealing 100% ATK, 70% ATK, 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Helix Shower
Conjures countless double helix-shaped projectiles and fires them at the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Double Swipe
If the player is close, swipes its body twice, dealing 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Aftershocks of the Apocalypse

Returns to the center of the arena by performing Emerging Strike, then leaps up and down several times, causing an expanding area of the ground to be affected by Dendro and rapidly deal 10% ATK as Dendro DoT, as well as forming 3 Shields of Revival's Hymn.

lore: An aquatic creature that hunts by firing watery projectiles. Although it looks like a hat, it actually eats from its underside, so attempting to wear it is strongly disadvised. In the words of someone who once did this: "That wasn't very clever, was it?"
attacks: Bubble Shot
Fires a bubble that travels to the player's location and explodes after a delay, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Bubble Shot
Fires a slow-moving bubble that travels towards the player. It will explode upon coming in contact with the player or after traveling for a period of time, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Bubble Mayhem
Creates many bubbles around itself and starts charging. They will explode upon coming in contact with the player or after the jellyfish finishes charging, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: Reviled far and wide as a heretic, The Doctor — Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers — has seized the authority of the three moons and now ascends the long steps toward the divine throne of the "new world." All should have belonged to us. But reason cast out all that exceeded its limits, leaving humanity blind to its true nature. Life and death bound us into mortal shells, shackling every spark of aspiration. Time and space closed in last of all, fencing the mind into meek obedience, so no one would dare imagine breaking free. From that point on, false gods governed the world, each one declaring their own truth as the sole, unassailable gospel — though none deserved the mantle they so loudly coveted. There is no inherent structure to life's flow — order was merely imposed upon it. Strip away every shackle laid across this world, and the essence of all things will at last come into view. And that revelation... is the first light of the new world. "How much longer will you continue to suffer this stagnant, obsolescent world?"
attacks: Return of the False Moon
If The Doctor survives a single instance of DMG exceeding 20% of his Max HP, he will increase all RES by 150% for ~3.5s, and quickly recover all of the HP lost to this instance of DMG.
Moonwither Realm

The Doctor will periodically create 3 Moonwither Realms around the arena. As a Moonwither Realm spawns, The Doctor will command a Moon Replica Shade to unleash a flurry of attacks at its location, dealing 200% Level Multiplier ×4 as Cryo DMG.
Authority of the Three Moons

The Doctor will periodically command the authority bestowed by the marrow of the three moons, setting forth one of the following effects for ~6s:Iridescent Moon: Characters may not face The Doctor.Frost Moon: Characters may not move long distances.Eternal…
Moonfall Impact
This attack is used immediately as the boss fight begins, and repeated once every ~150s.
Falling Remnants
Summons 5 Ancient Moon's Remnants to fall from the sky in succession, each dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG over a large, marked area.
Replica Attack
If the player is far away, summons 2 Moon Replica Shades to attack the player, each dealing 20% ATK ×3 as Cryo DMG.
Deluge

Summons a torrential downpour across the arena, with each raindrop dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG. After some time, reverses the direction of the rain to charge up a massive concentrated blast around The Doctor, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Voltage Discharge
Summons 6 laser beams that move outward from The Doctor in multiple directions, each dealing 20% ATK as Electro DMG on contact.
Sequential Incision

Quickly shifts to the right, leaving 5 emitters in his wake, which each fire a water beam at the player in quick succession, each dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG. Follows up with Tidal Trident if the player is close, or Bolt Smash if the player is far away.
Tidal Trident
Fires a charged beam of water in front, followed by two beams of water fired in a "V" shape. Each beam deals 60% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Bolt Strike
Summons a single bolt above the player to strike down, dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG. If initiated on its own, follows up with Tidal Trident.
Tri-Elemental Combo
Summons a single bolt to strike down at the player, dealing 20% ATK as Electro DMG and releasing 3 laser beams that travel outward, dealing 20% ATK as Electro DMG on contact.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. They look very similar to humanity but seem to have lost both their intellect and spirituality. Their presence on the continent has been recorded for over a thousand years, and yet they have neither history nor civilization. Since the pitch-black calamity from five hundred years ago, they have begun to spread in large numbers across the land. They are not very strong, and they lack organization, but they nonetheless bring sizable trouble to humans every once in a while.
attacks: Punch
Approaches and swings its fist at the player, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Rock Throw
Digs a small rock out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. These hilichurls wield flaming clubs and charge with reckless abandon to chase intruding adventurers off. Most wildfires in the grasslands or forests are not actually caused by a certain special Knight, but due to the actions of these hilichurls.
attacks: Hit and Run

Wildly swings its club around and charges straight towards the player. At the end of the charge, performs an extra powerful swing. While ignited, each of the charging swings and the final swing deal 10% ATK and 100% ATK as Pyro DMG, respectively.
Torch Strike
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 125% ATK as Pyro DMG when ignited and 100% ATK as Physical DMG when extinguished.
Reignition
Some time after its club is extinguished, the Hilichurl Berserker will reignite it.
Burning Damage Immunity
The Hilichurl Berserker is immune to damage dealt by the Burning Elemental Reaction (but not the reaction itself) and damage from burning grass.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Ill-tempered warriors for their tribes, they are simple-minded believers in the power of brute force. If their muscles grow strong enough and their strength great enough, then one day they too shall raise up a great shield and become a mitachurl... Or will they?
attacks: Wooden Club
The Hilichurl Fighter's Wooden Club is a object. It can be ignited and slowly burned away using Pyro.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Jump and Hit
Charges and swings its club at the player powerfully, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back.
Swing That Club
Performs 3 consecutive swings at the player, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK, 125% ATK with each swing as Physical DMG.
Punch
Approaches and swings its fist at the player, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used if the Hilichurl Fighter's club is destroyed.
Rock Throw
Digs a small rock out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used if the Hilichurl Fighter's club is destroyed.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. These sneaky fellows are skilled in the use of Pyro Slimes, using them as weapons to attack intruders. Skilled grenadiers may be able to destroy four wooden dummies in a single throw.
attacks: Punch
Approaches and swings its fist at the player, dealing 37.5% ATK as Physical DMG.
Pyro Slime Throw
Digs a Pyro Slime out of the ground, ignites it and throws it at the player, dealing AoE DMG. Staggering the Grenadier during this attack will knock the Pyro Slime out of its hands.
Burning Damage Immunity
The Hilichurl Grenadier is immune to damage dealt by the Burning Elemental Reaction (but not the reaction itself) and damage from burning grass.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Hilichurl Shooters who wield simple crossbows. Hilichurls do not, in truth, possess the craftsmanship needed to build crossbows. As such, it is commonly believed that there is an organization that controls the hilichurls from behind the scenes and furnishes them with equipment and material supplies. The Abyss Mages that often accompany these hilichurls are especially suspicious.
attacks: Shooting
Fires an arrow at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: In the mist-shrouded valley of firewood, dwells a tyrant cursed by ancient bloodlines. Who can withstand its golden flames, and who will soothe its fiery wrath?
attacks: Shockwave
Raises then slams both of its wings, dealing 55% ATK as Pyro DMG around itself.
Wing Swipe
Attacks with one of its wings, dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG around itself, immediately followed by Shockwave.
Charge

Charges at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit, then follows with two quick wing slashes, each dealing 45% ATK as Pyro DMG. If the first wing slash hits the player, the DMG of the second wing slash is halved according to the Damage Sequence.
Sweep and Charge

Sweeps the ground around itself with one wing, then drills forward at the player, dealing 50% ATK, 55% ATK as Pyro DMG. Repeated hits dealt by the charge have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Golden Flame Transformation

Enters the Golden Flame form, gaining a Pyro shield and immunity to all DMG. The transformation expires after 45 seconds, but destroying the shield will cause Holawaqa Ngoubou to exit this form early.

lore: A stingray that can release blades of water. Among the Fontemer Aberrants, there are certain strange "Xenochromatic" lifeforms. It is said that these are not actually living creatures, but rather spirits from the ocean that have neither taken physical form nor swallowed bait. They are said to bestow blessings upon those accepted by the Fontemer as well as those that are able to control it. Of course, those that have a deeper understanding of natural philosophy would discount such groundless speculation.
attacks: Crescent Tide
Flings a water blade at the player with its tail, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Crescent Tide
Flings a water blade at the player with its tail, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Moonedge Blade
The duo form a visible connection between each other while charging up, then each flings a more powerful water blade at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
HP Lock
If one of the rays is still standing, the HP of the other ray will not be able to drop below 1%. The rays will only be defeated when both drop to 1% HP.

lore: Abyss creatures that utilize Hydro energy in battle. Stories circulate among adventurers that Abyss Mages are at the lowest rung of the Abyss Order's hierarchy and that they roam the various lands to scheme fell deeds of destruction. Though they also often make fun of these Abyss Mages, saying that the most harm they can do is to cause rheumatism or a common cold, their power is not to be underestimated.
tips: Uses a Hydro Ward to protect itself. Perhaps you can break down its defenses with Cryo or other Elemental Attacks that react with Hydro.
attacks: Hydro Shield
