Upon initiating combat, the Hydro Abyss Mage immediately gains a Hydro Shield, protecting it from damage. The shield takes damage from certain Elemental Reactions and suffers additional damage based on the strength of the attacks it receives.
Water Ball
Shoots a water projectile at the target, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG
Special Attack - Bubbling Offering
Releases a homing Mist Bubble that deals 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on impact and traps the target inside. These bubbles can also trap other small enemies if they come in contact.
Teleportation

If the target is too far from the mage, it clutches its mask and teleports directly in front of the target, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG at its location upon reappearance. The mage can also teleport away from the player to avoid attacks when vulnerable.
Rite of Mortal Water

If the mage is left alone after its shield is destroyed, summons a large amount of bubbles around it which deal 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on impact and traps the target inside. During this attack, the mage's Interruption Resistance is increased.
Enhancement
Certain enhanced Hydro Abyss Mages can be found in certain Domains, Spiral Abyss, overworld events and challenges. There are 3 possible types of enhancements: Attack, Shield, and Teleportation.

lore: Little creatures that can ever so slightly manipulate Hydro. They and other such creatures are known collectively as Cicins, and they truly adore the rare and wonderful Mist Grass plant. It is by exploiting this relationship that the Fatui Mages have sought to commandeer Cicins in battle.
attacks: Hydro Bolt
Fires a bolt at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: Hilichurl wanderers unaffiliated with any specific tribe. They can often be found roving the wilds as if in voluntary exile. They may also lend their aid to other hilichurls or hilichurl tribes for various reasons and go their separate ways afterward. They seem to possess a higher level of intelligence than commonplace hilichurls.
tips: A mysterious hilichurl warrior that can manipulate Hydro to a certain degree. Such hilichurls will use Hydro Slimes in battle to launch Mist Bubbles. Burst these Hydro Slimes to cause their effects to rebound on the Rogues.
attacks: Single Slash
Swings its scythe once, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Double Slash
Swings its scythe twice, dealing 80% ATK, 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Charging Slash
If the player is far away, charges at the player and swings its scythe once, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Stab
Adjusts the blade of its scythe and stabs the player, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Slime Throw
Throws 3 Hydro Slimes at the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Bubble Cannon

Summons a Hydro Slime and pokes it repeatedly to launch 3 bubbles at the player, which will trap the player and deal 50% ATK as Hydro DMG upon contact. Afterwards, kicks the Hydro Slime at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.

lore: Code Name: He. A high-purity Hydro entity. Hypostases have strong rejection properties, and will mercilessly expel any that test them. Its rejection behavior even extends to natural elements.
tips: Protects itself with a cubical shell that is elementally inert. Attacks are only effective when its elemental core is exposed. When HP is low, it splits into three crystalline "water droplets" that will move towards its core. Destroy these water droplets in time to prevent the revival of the Hydro Hypostasis.
attacks: Bubble Support

Draws in water and then jiggles around in a bubble before exploding, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG launching two smaller bubbles towards different directions which transform into slime-like 'Water Droplets' which can be destroyed.
Twisting Vortex

Transforms into a twisting serpentine form that spirals around vertically before diving into the ground dealing 33.3% ATK as Hydro DMG, and causes bubbles to rise from the ground all around for a while after.
Dolphin Dive
Dives into the ground before turning into a pod of Dolphins, which leap towards the player in a curved trajectory, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Rainstorm Maelstrom
Transforms into a twister while summoning three rainy fields that deal 33.3% ATK as Hydro DoT.
Rolling Waves

Dives into the ground before transforming into a single large cube while calling rolling waves from the edges of the arena to roll in towards it, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG on contact, before causing a large splash at the end dealing 100% ATK Hydro DMG.
Dolphin Show

Forms a ring-shaped array with its shell pieces, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG before continuously summoning dolphins to emerge from the ground inside and around the array, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG on appearance and 16.6% ATK as Hydro DMG on landing.
Wave Slam
Transforms into a ray and slaps the ground releasing bursts of water in a line ahead. The initial slap deals 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG, and the subsequent bursts deal 33.3% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Droplet Aid

When HP is low (approx. 5%), dives into the ground to warp to the center of the arena and summon three large 'Water Droplets' which will slowly head towards the boss. If the droplets are not defeated in time, they will touch the boss and heal it.
Bubble Support

The exploding droplet's shield durability is increased and even further increased in Extreme difficulty. Its explosion AoE is increased.The healing droplet's shield durability is increased in Extreme difficulty.
Dolphin Dive
This attack will be used 3 times in a row
Rainstorm Maelstrom
Summons 5 rainy fields instead of 3.
Wave Slam
Produces 3 lines of explosions instead of 1.
Droplet Aid
The droplets' shield durability is increased in Extreme difficulty.

lore: A wizened, mumbling hilichurl, one that chants of the power of Hydro. Hilichurls especially gifted in commanding the elements who often reach the zenith of their skill in their twilight years. What sort of life would lead to such simple creatures being able to summon water and rains?
attacks: Tidal Impact
Summons water that bursts from the ground at the player's location, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Prayer for Rain
Summons rain that applies the Wet status to any players or allies within its AoE, while also healing its allies within the AoE by up to ~60% of their max HP. This ability does not deal DMG.
Staff Strike
If the player is within melee range, swings its staff at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back. The Samachurl also falls in the process due to the staff's weight.

lore: A small monster created by the sedimentation of Hydro dispersed throughout nature. Legend has it that some people would use Hydro Slimes as an emergency water source, packing them in preparation for travels through dry regions or deep domains. But due to the high concentration of Hydro within these slimes, direct ingestion is, in fact, harmful to the human body.
attacks: Wet Application
When attacked, the Hydro Slime applies the Wet Status for 10 seconds to all players and enemies in a 1m radius.
Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Drowning Immunity
Hydro Slimes can hop on the surface of water, and are incapable of drowning.

lore: A monster birthed from a high concentration of Hydro that can float in the air. On moonlit nights, Hydro Specters will give off a ghostly glow as they float by the riverbank. Their furtive forms are often mistaken by passers-by for wandering spirits, which has made them mainstays in quite a few folktales.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury
Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated.
Water Spit
Shoots a slow homing bubble that deals 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Splash Burst
Spins before summoning a splash at the location of the player, dealing 80% ATK as AoE Hydro DMG. Any enemies in the AoE will be healed by 40% of their Max HP.
Squeeze Out
Squeezes itself out, before releasing a splash around itself dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack will only occur at max fury and will be the only attack it uses in that state.
Final Burst

Explodes after a short pause when defeated, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. If at max Fury, DMG is increased to 120% ATK, and if enemies are nearby, the explosion will also release bubbles that track nearby enemies and heal them by 20% of their Max HP.

lore: A humanoid monster formed from the agglomeration of water.
tips: The gigantic combined form of many water droplets. During the challenge, small Half-Tulpas will constantly appear and fight against their opponents. The Hydro Tulpa will absorb these Half-Tulpas into itself to grow stronger. You can use attacks or Elemental Reactions to disrupt this absorption process.
attacks: Fist Strike
Attacks with its fist, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Spear Toss
Throws a water-formed spear at the player, dealing 60% ATK (90% ATK while enhanced) as Hydro DMG.
Hammer Whirl
Swings a water-formed hammer 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 62.5% ATK, 65% ATK (90% ATK, 92.5% ATK, 95% ATK while enhanced) as Hydro DMG.
Sword Combo
Swings a water-formed sword, then attacks its arm, dealing 60% ATK, 65% ATK (90% ATK, 95% ATK while enhanced) as Hydro DMG.
Triple Lancestrike
Forms 3 lances which strike down near itself, each dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. Many smaller lances will also strike down across the arena, each dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Absorb Half-Tulpa

During battle, a Half-Tulpa will spawn every 12.5s. The Hydro Tulpa will periodically absorb a Half-Tulpa to enter an enhanced state for one attack (two attacks if in the Spiral Abyss): AoE and DMG dealt are increased, and RES to all DMG is increased by 45%.
Torrential Flurry

If the Hydro Tulpa is not in enhanced state, it will deploy a Shield equal 8.85% of its Max HP and enter a charging state as it prepares to launch Torrential Flurry. If it is successfully unleashed, the current active character will be immediately defeated.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Hilichurls display a strong sense of adaptability to their surroundings. In icy environments, they come up with ways and means to fashion this hard ice into shields to protect themselves.
attacks: Frozen Shield

The Ice Shield Hilichurl Guard is equipped with a Cryo shield, which blocks incoming DMG from the direction that it is facing. This shield is vulnerable to Pyro, Electro and Blunt Attacks, and weakest to Pyro.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Jump and Hit
Charges and swings its club at the player powerfully, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back.
Swing That Club
Performs 3 consecutive swings at the player, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK, 125% ATK with each swing as Physical DMG.

lore: A muscular hilichurl that uses solid ice as a shield, wielding it in battle. Reason normally dictates that large creatures that see a lot of action should burn through a great number of calories to sustain themselves. As such, the present-day El Musk has proposed the "Mitachurl Index." This index correlates the percentage of mitachurls within the hilichurl population to the stability and success of hilichurl foraging activity.
tips: A mitachurl that uses a Cryo shield to protect itself. Its shield will regenerate in Subzero Climate. Attack with Pyro or other elements that can react with Cryo to crush its defenses.
attacks: Hoarfrost Greatshield

The Ice Shieldwall Mitachurl is equipped with a Cryo shield, which blocks incoming DMG from the direction that it is facing. This shield is vulnerable to Pyro, Electro and Poise Damage, and weakest to Pyro.
Shield Charge

Charges towards the player with its shield, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players in its path. At the end of the charge, swings its shield at the player, dealing an additional 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charge
When without its shield, charges towards the player character with brute force, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players in its path.
Smack
If the player strays too close, swings its shield or delivers a punch with its fist, dealing 100% ATK or 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cryo Slime Throw
If the player is at a different elevation, digs a Cryo Slime out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: Artificed Dancers developed by the Fontaine Research Institute. Bossuet originally intended for Artificed Dancers to be works of art that transcended the era of mechanical reproduction. But after Bossuet was forced to resign, the project was taken over by Maillardet, who had his own unique understanding of what he wanted to achieve. As a result, while their features were perfected during the course of its development, the Artificed Dancers gradually strayed from Bossuet's original vision.
tips: Next up are fantastical performances to be delivered by clockwork meka Coppelia and Coppelius, brought to you by Maillardet of the Fontaine Research Institute. Before you begin the challenge, you must speak with Maillardet and select the play you are challenging. The eventual resources claimed from the Ley Line Blossom after completing the challenge will also differ based on your selection.

Dirge of Coppelia: The protagonist is Coppelia, a lady of the clockwork meka. At the climax of the performance, Coppelia will halt at the center of the dance floor and expose her artificed clockwork component charged with ousia, thereby drastically increasing the efficiency of her exertions and summoning countless whirlwinds of dirge.

Nemesis of Coppelius: The protagonist is Coppelius, a noble of the clockwork meka. At the climax of the performance, Coppelius will halt at the center of the dance floor and expose his artificed clockwork component charged with pneuma, thereby drastically increasing the efficiency of his exertions, granting him a Ward, and generating three retributive Frosthearts.
attacks: Double Spin
Coppelia and Coppelius each performs a melee attack with their fan and cape, dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG and Cryo DMG.
Stationary Lift
Coppelius skates in a small circle, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG and leaving a trail of ice shards. The ice shards detonate shortly after, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Glacial Flourish
Coppelius raises his cane before tapping it on the ground, sending out a trail of ice, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Shard Spray
Coppelius spins his cane to shoot forward many icicles, each dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Coppelia's Climax
Coppelia and Coppelius move to the center of the arena and initiate Climax.
Double Spin
Coppelia and Coppelius each performs a melee attack with their fan and cape, dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG and Cryo DMG.
Death Spiral
Coppelius spins Coppelia around himself, dealing 30% ATK × 5 as Anemo DMG.
Throw Jump

Coppelius throws Coppelia airborne, who deals 60% ATK as Anemo DMG upon landing before returning to Coppelius while rapidly spinning, dealing 15% ATK as Anemo DMG every 0.3s to players that come in contact.
Salchow Jump
Coppelia shoots 3 orbs at the player with her fan, each dealing 75% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Coppelius's Climax
Coppelia and Coppelius move to the center of the arena and initiate Climax.

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Cryo, resulting in its present form. It is said that this entity is closest to the original form of a Frostnight Scion. It will use icy mists and crystals to set up redoubtable walls, but perhaps it does this only to separate the flawless primeval light from the world that lies beneath the moon. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Cryo Aura
While not in the Gloomveiled state, the Frostnight Scion has an immutable Cryo aura.
Frozen Immunity
The Frostnight Scion cannot be Frozen.
Swipe
Performs a swipe at the player with its ring of crystals, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG. While in the Gloomveiled state, performs another swipe, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Ice Ball
Forms and launches an ice ball at the player if far away, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG upon impact.
Stomp
Stomps the ground in front of it with its two front legs, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Gloomveil

Periodically enters a Gloomveiled state, increasing its RES to all DMG except Cryo by 50%, enhancing its attacks, and gaining the ability to relocate by disappearing and reappearing, but also losing its immunity to Cryo (Cryo RES in this state is 100%).
Back Kick

Performs a kick with its hind legs, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack may be used immediately after it enters the Gloomveiled state, and cannot be used more than once per instance of this state.
Frost Skirt

Conjures an ice ball above its body and slowly approaches the player. Teleports next to them while summoning a ring of icicles around the ice ball before firing the icicles outward at the ground, each one dealing 60% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: Able to use their plumage for leaping, Iktomisaurs are also the only type of Saurian to have grasped how to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state. According to legend, their ancestors did not have a physical form, and instead could drift like spirits between reality and the spiritual realm, manifesting themselves through the darkness of night. Some also say that the first Iktomisaur to emerge from the Night Kingdom was not actually a true Saurian, but rather a unique race distinct from ordinary Saurians.
attacks: Updraft
Creates a temporary Wind Current that allows it to become airborne. The Iktomisaurus can still attack while airborne. The updraft can also be used by the player.
Frosty Wind
Sends forward one projectile, dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Chilling Blast
Marks a circle at the player's location and deals 100% ATK as Cryo DMG after a short delay.
Torches

Three torches are lit around the arena. When near a torch, the player will receive Pyro application, and their Charged Attack deals an additional instance of Pyro DMG equal to 200% of the character's ATK and applies 1U of Pyro.
Updraft
Becomes airborne. The Iktomisaurus can still attack while airborne.
Frosty Wind
Sends forward two projectiles, each dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Chilling Blast
Marks multiple circular areas around the player's location and deals 100% ATK as Cryo DMG in each area after a short delay.
Obsidian Storm

Teleports to the middle of the arena before creating an updraft to become airborne, gaining a shield and freezing all torches in ice. Tornadoes will spawn around the arena, dealing 20% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit, but cannot reach right below the Iktomisaurus.
Frosthail Execution
On Fearless/Dire difficulty in Stygian Onslaught, Obsidian Storm is replace by Frosthail Execution.

lore: A young Iktomisaur with a keen sense of perception. It has yet to grow its full plumage and may even appear a little slow on the uptake. It is said that among the Saurians that now live, Iktomisaurs not only have the longest lifespans, but spend the longest time as juveniles too. They possess the capacity to communicate with the Night Kingdom or Wayob, though it may take many years before the young Saurians can fully comprehend this.
attacks: Chilling Blast
Marks a circle at the player's location and deals 100% ATK as Cryo DMG after a short delay. This attack will sometimes fail, paralyzing the Iktomisaurus Chick for a few seconds.

lore: A powerful warrior from the Night-Wind, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. Without exception, it is said that tribal warriors who win the acknowledgment of the Iktomisaurs must possess extraordinarily keen senses and formidable mental strength. They can even use their power to make slight alterations to the trajectory of the projectiles that they fire from their cannons.
attacks: Melee Combo
Performs 2 melee strikes with her cannon, dealing 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cannon Shot
Fires 2 cannonballs in succession at the player, each dealing 45% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while not enhanced.
Enhanced State

Charges to deal 60% ATK as Cryo DMG around herself and enter an enhanced state, increasing her ATK by 20% and enabling stronger attacks, as well as to drift swiftly to relocate. The enhanced state will not expire.
Enhanced Cannon Shot
Fires 3 cannonballs in quick succession at the player, each dealing 45% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while enhanced.
Airstrike
Fires a large cannonball into the sky, which lands at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while enhanced.
Elemental Mastery
The Local Legend has 800 Elemental Mastery. She will:
Icicle Rain

Fires a large cannonball which splits into a number of icicles, which home towards the player, each dealing 35% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is used twice in quick succession if used independently, or once as a follow-up of Explosive Dodge.
Parry

When the Local Legend is not performing an attack, she may block incoming attacks with her cannon. When she successfully blocks 3 attacks, she will blink away, and may follow up with Explosive Dodge or the second strike of Melee Combo.
Explosive Dodge
Upon blocking 3 attacks during Parry, blinks away and leaves an explosive barrel at the original location, which detonates shortly after being struck, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Fusion Nova
Returns to the center of the arena, continuously spawning explosive barrels and creating AoE blasts similar to Airstrikes near players or around the arena. Each AoE blast deals 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A powerful warrior from the Night-Wind, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. Tribal warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind do not typically excel when it comes to conventional strength. Their ability to manipulate weapons with ease comes instead from years of mental training. Thus, compared to combat prowess in itself, warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind place greater value on the gift of "Spiritspeaking." Drawing upon the power of special graffiti and willpower alone, it is said that the most exceptional of Spiritspeakers can lift boulders as tall as people.
attacks: Melee Combo
Swings his saw up to 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG. After the third attack, briefly powers his saw, dealing 5% ATK × 3 as Physical DMG.
Enhanced State

Charges to deal 60% ATK as Cryo DMG around himself and enter an enhanced state, increasing his ATK by 20% and enabling stronger attacks, as well as to drift swiftly to relocate. The enhanced state will not expire.
Sawblade
Slings a spinning disc forward, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit. This attack is only used while enhanced.

immortal_construct.special: The Remnant Body of the Eternal Flamefeather
lore: A byproduct created by the alchemist Koshchei during his creation of the individual known as the Firebird. Perhaps this was the gloomy alchemist's habit: whenever one experimental subject from a batch succeeded, all the others would be abandoned or disposed of as he pleased. This derivative creation should have fused with some form of power and reached completion. Now, however, it can only wander endlessly through the mountain gorges as an incomplete, mindless beast.
tips: A nigh-immortal life form created through bio-alchemy. The Immortal Construct burns its life to enter the "Lifeflare" state, in which it gains several HP shields at one time. Any DMG dealt by it while in this state will restore its HP. When the number of HP-restoring shields goes below a certain number or after Lifeflare lasts for a set time, the Immortal Construct will attempt to unleash "Scorching Radiance." To stop it, you must break all of its HP shields. The Immortal Construct will be unable to recover any HP when affected by Stellar Glimmer reactions, no matter what it does...
attacks: Wing Sweep

Sweeps at the player with one of its wings when the player stands on its side or behind it, dealing 25% ATK as Physical DMG. The damage increases while under the Lifeflare state, dealing 65% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Wing Sweep Combo

Sweeps with its right wing, followed by its left wing, and finally with both wings, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK and 70% ATK as Physical DMG, respectively. The double-wing attack has a longer wind-up time and a short camera change.
Flyby
If the player is far enough away, charges at them with its wings spread, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. Only performs this attack when it has entered theLifeflare state
Swipe
Swipes at the player with its claws, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Lifeflare

Roars and enters the Lifeflare state, consuming 18% of its Max HP to do so. It generates a multi-layered Ward divided into nine segments that fills up over 2 seconds, each segment of Ward is equal to 2% of its Max HP.
Scorching Radiance
If the Immortal Construct remains in its Lifeflare state for a prolonged period, it charges itself with Pyro energy before releasing it across the entire arena, dealing 150% ATK as Pyro DMG.

iniquitous_baptist.special: The Guide to the Dark Paradise
lore: A monster from the Abyss that wields multiple types of Elemental Power and has gained extra limbs from its "evolution."

"The nature of the 'Abyss' is essentially irreconcilable with the elements. However, even the elements of gods can be entrapped and distorted before they are subsumed to become tools of the abyssal will. Just judging from outcomes and practical use, "Abyssal powers" seem little different from elemental items, from ones as paltry as the Treasure Hoarders' elemental containers to those as powerful as Visions..." —Notes left behind in Hangeh Afrasiyab by someone.
tips: A creature of the Abyss Order that can manipulate multiple elements at once and use Wards of the corresponding elements to defend against damage. In battle, it will create Elemental Rings, through which it will channel a powerful attack. Use Reactions to destroy all the Rings to prevent the oncoming catastrophe.
attacks: Elemental Rings

Conjures nodes that charge up and form elemental rings, which explode and each deal 200% ATK as DMG of their respective elemental type if allowed to fully charge. This is indicated with a marker that rotates clockwise.
Dark Frost Icicles

Conjures 4 icicles and fires them at the player one by one, each dealing 78% ATK as Cryo DMG. If this attack deals DMG to the player, 80 Stamina will be drained. Successive hits within 3 seconds of the first one will only drain 25 Stamina.
Icy Blades
Shoots 2 to 4 ice blades at the player followed by a double blade, dealing 50% ATK with each ice blade and 70% ATK with the double blade as Cryo DMG.
Shattering Blast
If the player is close to the Iniquitous Baptist, causes an explosion around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Abyssal Light
Fires 3 orbs at the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG. If this attack deals DMG to the player, drains 20 Energy from each party member.
Violet Beam
Fires a charged laser beam at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Lances of Retribution
Throws 2 lances consecutively at the player, each dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Teleport
If the player is close to the Iniquitous Baptist, teleports away from the player.
Surging Tide

Shoots 2 to 6 water blades at the player followed by a double blade, dealing 50% ATK with each water blade and 70% ATK with the double blade as Hydro DMG. If this attack deals DMG to the player, extends ongoing cooldowns of all party members by 6 seconds.
Orbs of Cleansing
Conjures 4 water bombs which home toward the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Searing Precept
Summons a total of 7 bursts of flame from the ground in 3 waves, each dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG and applying the Brand of the Abyssal Flame status to players damaged.
Orbs of Incineration
Conjures 4 fire bombs which home toward the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: Over many long years, this large fungal beast has morphed into a unique form. Its intelligence has already reached and perhaps has even surpassed real animals, and it will actively hunt prey to obtain sustenance. Its tail has a lovely jade plumage that seems very similar to that of the ancient sacred beast that the Spantamad school reveres. As far as the logic of mimesis is concerned, it seems quite likely that the two beings once walked the earth together.
tips: An evolved Fungus. When it is hit by Electro attacks and Catalyze reactions, it will accumulate Activation. When it is hit by Pyro attacks, it will lose Activation progress. When it accumulates sufficient Activation, it will enter an Activated state. An activated Jadeplume Terrorshroom will unleash more fearsome attacks until it becomes exhausted. When it is not Activated, the Jadeplume Terrorshroom can be put into a Burning state via the use of Pyro, which will cause it to become Scorched. It will then spread spores around to create Fungi in an attempt to escape this status.
attacks: Majestic Dance

Performs a 3-part combo consisting of a sweeping bite, a head slam, and a jumping slam, dealing 80% ATK, 80% ATK, 100% ATK as Dendro DMG. The Jadeplume Terrorshroom will also imbue itself with a Dendro aura during the jumping slam.
Barrage

Briefly imbues itself with a Dendro aura before performing two tail swipes and a front flip, launching 5 homing projectiles with each attack. Each projectile deals 30% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit. This attack can be chained up to 3 times.
Volatile Spore Cloud
Imbues itself with a Dendro aura, creates a large spore cloud around itself and ignites it with sparks from its beak, causing an explosion that deals 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Radical Vitality

The Jadeplume Terrorshroom's Fury bar will fill by 2% when hit by an Electro attack, fill by 15% when a Quicken, Aggravate, or Spread reaction is triggered on it, and reduce by 34% when hit by a Pyro attack.
Feather Spreading
Imbues itself with a Dendro aura and scatters countless spores into the air that home towards the player, each dealing 45% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.
Furious Charge
Imbues itself with a Dendro aura and charges at the player twice, dealing 120% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.
Rapid Pecks
Aimlessly swings its beak 4 times, dealing 120% ATK as Dendro DMG with each swing.
Proliferating Spores
If the Burning reaction is inflicted upon the Jadeplume Terrorshroom while it is not in the activated state, it will become Scorched. It will then shoot 3 spores that land in front of it.

lore: A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds. Among the many fae of Snezhnaya, Leshies are a very unusual kind, rarely appearing in cities. They may well be the longest-lived among all fae, and few members of other long-lived races have ever witnessed a Leshy's life from beginning to end. Of course, most people would likely struggle even to distinguish one Leshy from another.

Samurai who have fallen into banditry. They possess highly advanced martial art skills but found no use for them for various reasons. Out of desperation, they have fallen onto the path of evil. They use paper seals, created from a Kamuna art that has been lost for centuries, to infuse their blades with the power of lightning.
attacks: DMG Reduction
Shortly after being aggravated, the Kairagi gains a 80% Damage Reduction, which reduces the Damage Bonus of incoming attacks by 80%.
Three Point Slash

The Kairagi slashes at the player three times, dealing 46.6% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG with each slash. When the blade is infused with Electro, there is a possibility that the final strike may be substituted for a Iai: Stormbreath instead.
Sword Charge

The Kairagi will point its blade towards the player and charge towards them once, dealing 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG. This attack also destroys all player-created Geo Constructs in its path.
Iai: Stormbreath
The Kairagi performs a spin attack, dealing 66.6% ATK * 2 as Physical DMG or Electro DMG.
Leaping Strike

The Kairagi will jump towards the player's location and perform a downwards strike, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG or Electro DMG. In the Final Frenzy state, it is possible for the Kairagi to perform a two point slash after this attack.
Dodge
When the Kairagi is attacked, jumps backwards away from the source.
Kamuna Talisman: Electro

The Kairagi infuses its blade with Electro and performs a ground slam, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. This Electro infusion will last for 30 seconds and will cause all other attacks to be imbued with Electro as well.
Taunt
Clenches and raises their fist to taunt their opponents. They will not perform this move if they have activated Final Frenzy.
Block

The Kairagi enters a stance with its blade held downwards, pointed diagonally, during which it will block all incoming attacks from the direction they're facing. If attacked enough, the block will break.
Final Frenzy

When an ally Kairagi dies in battle, the other Kairagi will attempt to avenge their fallen comrade. The Kairagi imbues itself with a dark-purple aura, heals itself for 50% of its Max HP, and infuses its blade with Electro.
Blade Waves
Swings their blade up to 5 times, launching waves at the player, each dealing 30% ATK as Electro DMG. Perfect Parrying these waves will deflect them to deal DMG to the Kairagi instead.
Counterattack
If continuously attacked while Blocking, performs a downward slash, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. They practiced martial arts since they were young, but lost the opportunity to serve the people due to certain reasons and turned from the righteous path. Their blade's edges are not cold like ordinary steel, but instead burn with a bitter flame. They seem to have used paper seals, created from a lost Kamuna art, to set their blades afire.
attacks: DMG Reduction
Shortly after being aggravated, the Kairagi gains a 80% Damage Reduction, which reduces the Damage Bonus of incoming attacks by 80%.
Three Point Slash

The Kairagi slashes at the player three times, dealing 46.6% ATK as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG with each slash. When the blade is infused with Pyro, there is a possibility that the final strike may be substituted for a Iai: Fiery Wind instead.
Sword Charge

The Kairagi will point its blade towards the player and charge towards them once, dealing 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG. This attack also destroys all player-created Geo Constructs in its path.
Iai: Fiery Wind
The Kairagi performs a spin attack, dealing 66.6% ATK * 2 as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG.
Leaping Strike

The Kairagi will jump towards the player's location and perform a downwards strike, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. This also leaves behind a burning mark in the area struck, which deals 20% ATK as Pyro DoT until it dissipates.
Dodge
When the Kairagi is attacked, jumps backwards away from the source.
Kamuna Talisman: Pyro

The Kairagi infuses its blade with Pyro and performs a downward slash, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. This Pyro infusion will last for 30 seconds and will cause all other attacks to be imbued with Pyro as well.
Block

The Kairagi enters a stance with its blade held downwards, pointed diagonally, during which it will block all incoming attacks from the direction they're facing. If attacked enough, the block will break.
Final Frenzy

When an ally Kairagi dies in battle, the other Kairagi will attempt to avenge their fallen comrade. The Kairagi imbues itself with a fiery-orange aura, heals itself for 50% of its Max HP, and infuses its blade with Pyro.
Kamuna Talisman: Pyro
Upon entering battle, the Kairagi obtains a buff for that converts their attacks to Pyro. This buff will be removed if hit by a blade wave from the player's Honed Technique "Ferocious Combo Lashes".
Iai: Fiery Wind
The Kairagi performs a spin attack, dealing 66.6% ATK * 2 as Physical DMG or Pyro DMG.
Sword Charge

Dodges backwards, then points its blade towards the player and charge towards them once, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack is only used while Kamuna Talisman: Pyros Pyro conversion is active. This attack is only used in Hard and Pro difficulties.
Leaping Strike Combo

Performs the following combo: # Dodges backwards. # Jumps towards the player's location and perform a downwards strike, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. # Performs 2 slashes, each dealing 46.6% ATK as Pyro DMG,. # Performs Iai: Fiery Wind.
Ultimate Technique: Downward Slash
The Kairagi performs a downward slash, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. This also reactivates Kamuna Talisman: Pyros Pyro conversion. Parrying this attack will trigger a counterattack.
Three Point Slash
The Kairagi slashes at the player three times, dealing 46.6% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used while Kamuna Talisman: Pyros Pyro conversion is not active.
Leaping Strike
Jumps towards the player's location and perform a downwards strike, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used while Kamuna Talisman: Pyros Pyro conversion is not active.

lore: A kuuvahki mechanism of peculiar make, made from scrap metal and mechanical bearings, that bears a partial resemblance — as per its creator's proclivities, apparently — to a "duck." Its output and resistance to damage are comparable to the Fatui's most cutting-edge warfighting weaponry... But even so, it remains simply a toy duck that can punch its opponents very, very hard. A creator's preferences will always do much to determine a creation's appearance, as clay lacks the authority to question its creator's choice of molds. The world beneath the moon has long been sculpted into a form that people take for granted, but in the eyes of its original inhabitants, that form must surely be like a peculiar duck, shaped by its creator's bizarre predilections. Of course, the blue-haired maid would never say any such thing to the mistress of the Krumkake Craftshop — after all, ducks are adorable, especially compared to the world's present aspect.
tips: A duck-shaped combat machine built from scrap metal and powered by kuuvahki. It is programmed with a variety of strategies. Once combat progresses to a certain point, it will enter Duckstruction Mode, becoming more aggressive, generating a Ward for itself, and summoning floating Stamping Devices to harass you. When this happens, you must first deal with the Stamping Devices. Deal DMG with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions, or destroy them directly, to fry their circuits and cause them to attack Knuckle Duckle's Ward instead...
attacks: Blunt Strike

Smashes the area in front of it with its hammer, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG. If the player moves behind Knuckle Duckle, it additionally performs spinning slash and a belly ram, dealing 60% ATK, 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Cleave
If the player is a moderate distance from Knuckle Duckle, raises its saw blade, rushes towards the player, and cleaves down, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG.
Body Slam
Retracts its head, arms and legs before bouncing into the air, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG, then smashes down at the player's location, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG.
Spinning Slash
Slashes the surrounding area with its saw blade, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG.
Duckstruction Mode

After some time has passed (or immediately upon entering combat in the Spiral Abyss), uses Body Slam to reposition to the centre of the arena and unleash a flurry of fist strikes around itself, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Back Swipe
If the player is behind Knuckle Duckle, performs a strong swipe with its fist, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG and turning to face the player. Only used in Duckstruction Mode.
Rapid Punch Charge

Readies its four punching gloves and charges across in a straight line while rapidly jabbing in front of it, dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG. When hitting repeatedly within 3 seconds, DMG is sequentially reduced to 80%, 60%, 40%, 20%, 10% of the original.
Spinning Charge

Spins its four arms and charges across in a straight line, dealing 30% ATK as Electro DMG. If this attack hits the player or reaches the edge of the arena, leaps into the air and slams down, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. Only used in Duckstruction Mode.

lore: A young Koholasaurus with the ability to swim through water and liquid phlogiston. Their skin and flippers are still soft and tender, to the point that they can't even tolerate hot environments for long periods like adults. However, one day, they will grow into the form that can swim freely through the water.
attacks: Aquashot
Fires a projectile from its mouth, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack can be used both on land and in water.

lore: A Saurian with thick, strong flippers and a long tail that can swim in water and liquid phlogiston. According to legend, more ancient dragons were even more able to adapt to their environments, and when the largest dragon in the ocean of the age floated on the surface, it could even be mistaken for an island. It is said that today's Koholasaurus are the descendants of that great sea dragon, and in their broad backs the colossal forms of those ancient sea beasts may yet be glimpsed.
attacks: Tail Whirl
Attacks with its tail, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used on land.
Aquashot
Fires a projectile from its mouth, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack can be used both on land and in water.
Torrential Charge
Charges forward, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG in its path. This attack is only used in water.

lore: A powerful warrior from the source of the springs, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. A warrior who can temporarily harness the power of the waves to shuttle back and forth. It is said that one must undergo three states of training to master this skill: First, to adapt. Second, to submit. Finally, to drive. Mastering this method of movement is merely the entry-level requirement to become a Saurian-Crowned Warrior of the People of the Springs, and the greatest among these Warriors can even use this skill to sail on land.
attacks: Wavedash
Very quickly dashes to the side before and after performing certain attacks.
Melee Combo
Performs 2 melee strikes with her cannon, dealing 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Rapid Fire
Fires a total of 12 water bullets, each dealing 10% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Cannon Shot
Loads ammo into her cannon, then fires 3 large water balls in succession at the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Reefsplitter
Surfs atop her cannon to move swiftly, charging at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG upon contact.

lore: A powerful warrior from the source of the springs, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. A warrior who can temporarily harness the power of the waves to shuttle back and forth. According to legend, the tribe's heroes can take advantage of exceptional speed to move across the waves with no need of any tool. Today, the tribe believes this to be a sophisticated, complex art used to drive the waves, with the way one moves being at its heart.
attacks: Melee Combo
Strikes up to twice with her slingshot, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Scattershot

Mounts her slingshot and fires 6 small projectiles at once, each dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG. The mounting time will be faster if the Koholasaurus Warrior: Waveshuttler rolls to the side before the attack.
Waterball Sling
Mounts her slingshot and fires up to 9 projectiles in succession, each dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack will end early if the player approaches her.
Waveshuttler
Surfs atop her slingshot to move swiftly, charging at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG upon contact.
Cryo Spray Can

This attack is enabled upon reaching 85% of her Max HP. Throws a spray can at the ground, dealing 40% ATK as Cryo DMG on impact. After a delay, a circular field forms around the spraycan, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG once.
Shattering Ice
If the player is Frozen by her attacks, immediately leaps at the player and slams down, dealing 90% ATK as Hydro DMG. If this attack triggers Shatter, the DMG dealt by shatter is increased by 500%.

lore: The ancient king of the Yumkasaurs slumbers beneath the canyon, wagering its centuries-old pride, awaiting young warriors of the tribe to rise and challenge it.
attacks: Spit
Spits a single projectile at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Stomp
Stomps with one of its feet, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG. This is sometimes followed by Tail Smash.
Tail Smash
Rolls and slams its tail on the ground, dealing 65% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Hanging Drop
Uses its tongue to swing itself above the player and suspends mid-air. After a delay, releases its tongue and slams down to the ground, dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Swinging Slam
Uses its tongue to swing itself towards the player, slamming down to the ground, causing two expanding shockwaves, each dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Belly Spin
Rapidly spins on top of its belly while moving in a straight line, repeatedly dealing 35% ATK as Dendro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Single Flamegranate Spit
Summons a Flamegranate on the ground, then uses its tongue to devour it. Afterwards, spits out an ignited Flamegranate, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Triple Flamegranate Spit
Summons 3 Flamegranates on the ground, then uses its tongue to devour them.

lore: Signora, the Eighth of the Fatui Harbingers. Unlike other Fatui who use the authority granted by Delusions, her Delusion is meant to shackle a flame that will devour everything. As opposed to a weapon used to kill, it might be more fitting to consider this a tool of imprisonment. And it was the embers of that flame, which had accumulated over many long years, that would break through the frosty seal of the Delusion and apply a warped rouge upon her.

The crimson dawn was reflected in her pupils, and at last, she unfolded her flaming wings and flew towards the light. "But that light is not the dawn, dear Rosalyne. That is a sea of flame that will consume everything." A voice spoke to her amidst the light.
Yet it mattered not, for she knew in her heart that the flames had devoured her long ago.
attacks: Frosted Floor
Most of Signora's attacks will cause Frosted Floor: the floor will become patched with ice, dealing 6.25% ATK as Cryo DoT. Destroying a Heart of Flame will remove nearby frosted floor.
Pain for Pain

Upon receiving a single instance of DMG that exceeds 30% of Signora's Max HP, the DMG above the threshold is nullified. Additionally, she deals 125% ATK as Cryo DMG around her and fully fills the Sheer Cold gauge of all players.
Ice Shards and Frozen Wheel

Fires five ice shards in a tight spread followed by an ice wheel that curves towards the player, both dealing 37.5% ATK as Cryo DMG to characters they hit. This attack is always immediately used at the beginning of the fight.
Frostblade Hailstorm
Rains down ice in a small area, dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG and leaving Frosted Floor in the area struck.
Ice Flower
Imbues three ice flowers which will explode after a short period of time, each dealing 37.5% ATK as Cryo DMG and leaving Frosted Floor.
Biting Shards
Signora launches 5 icy spears that home in on the player character one after another, dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG on hit.
Snowfall Strike
Signora releases a burst of frost around her, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. If the player is too far away, she will teleport close to them before releasing the burst.
The Tsaritsa's Benevolence

Signora conjures six icy spears that surround the player character before converging on them, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG and leaving Frosted Floor. This attack is used if the fight has taken too long.
The Frozen Void

Signora marks the player character with a large ice spear before striking it towards the player, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG. The spear will then explode after 4 seconds, dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG and leaving Frosted Floor within the explosion's AoE.
Carmine Chrysalis

Upon reaching 20% HP, La Signora relocates at the center of the arena in order to encase herself inside a large ice cocoon. During this phase, Signora will gain a Frozen shield, while Sheer Cold accumulation is doubled and and her moveset will change.
Sheer Cold Accumulation
Signora's attacks will increase the Sheer Cold gauge on hit. Weak attacks increase Sheer Cold by 2%, strong attacks increase Sheer Cold by 5%, and Frosted Floors DMG increases Sheer Cold by 2.5%.
Embered Earth
Most of her attacks will cause Embered Earth: the floor will become molten for a short period of time, dealing 6.25% ATK as Pyro DoT. Destroying an Eye of Frost will remove nearby Embered Earth.
Pain for Pain

Upon receiving a single instance of DMG that exceeds 20% of Signora's Max HP, the DMG above the threshold is nullified. Additionally, she deals 125% ATK as Pyro DMG around her and fully fills the Blazing Heat gauge of all players.
Decimating Lash
Uses a fiery whip to lash out the player, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack comes in four variations:
Warp
Cloaks herself in her flames before moving to a different position, dealing 37.5% ATK as Pyro DMG on contact and leaving Embered Earth on her trail.
Fireball

Signora hurls a large rolling dark fireball against the player, dealing 62.5% ATK as Pyro DMG upon contact and leaving Embered Earth along its path. This is usually done as a follow up to either The Witch's Wrath or Hellfire Onslaught.
The Witch's Wrath
Signora unfurls her wings and rains down waves of molten rocks, each dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG and leaving Embered Earth.
Hellfire Onslaught
Signora will unleash her wings to summon a flock of small crimson lotus moths in front of her, dealing 25% ATK as Pyro DMG and leaving Embered Earth.
Crimson Lotus Moth
Signora summons a Crimson Lotus Moth that homes to the player character, dealing 37.5% ATK as Pyro DMG on contact.
Whirling Blaze

Signora spins herself to transform into a blazing tornado that moves around the arena, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG upon contact. The tornado will also unleash 4 mini-tornadoes around it every ~3 seconds, each dealing 37.5% ATK as Pyro DMG upon contact.
Blazing Heat Accumulation

Signora's attacks will increase the Blazing Heat gauge on hit. Weak attacks increase Blazing Heat by 2%, strong attacks increase Blazing Heat by 5%, and Embered Earths DMG increases Blazing Heat by 2.5%.

lore: A monster created by the coalescing of Anemo dispersed throughout nature. Owing to being comprised of a greater concentration of Anemo, their flotation abilities are stronger than that of Anemo Slimes. The hilichurls living out in the wilds have made use of this special characteristic, creating special vehicles that use Large Anemo Slimes as a form of locomotion to transport goods from unknown sources.
attacks: Puff Blow
If the player is within melee range, quickly puffs up to deal 50% ATK as Anemo DMG around itself.
Bump
If the player is out of melee range, briefly inflates and shoots itself towards the player, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Wind Blasts
Jumps into the air, inflates and shoots up to 4 Anemo projectiles at the player while floating mid-air, each dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Inflated
If the Large Anemo Slime takes DMG while inflated, it will be instantly defeated regardless of the amount of DMG dealt. However, it is still immune to Anemo DMG in this state.
Final Burst

When defeated, releases a burst of wind that pushes nearby players and objects away and triggers Anemo-related effects such as reacting with dandelions and Windwheel Asters, as well as create an upward wind current at its location, which can be used to…

lore: A monster created through the coagulation of Cryo in the natural environment. These slimes can use the abundant Cryo energies within themselves to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere and form a protective shell around themselves. They can also utilize a similar principle to freeze the water around them. On some level, this can be considered to be the freest species of slime, as it can cross oceans and seas with ease.
tips: A slime that uses a frozen Cryo Ward to protect itself. If you use Pyro or other reactive elemental attacks, perhaps you can break through its defenses...
attacks: Cryo Shield
The Cryo Slime can generate a Cryo shield to protect them from all incoming DMG. The shield is weakest to Pyro.
Ice Shards
Launches 3 ice shards at the player, each dealing 33.3% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while the Cryo Shield is intact.
Jumping Slam
Jumps high into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG. This attack is only used while the Cryo Shield is intact.
Frigid Spray + Regeneration

If the Cryo Shield is destroyed, retreats and forms an ice mist that deals 10% ATK as Cryo DoT. After the mist cloud is created, it will retreat into the middle of the cloud, waiting for its shield to regenerate.
Drowning Immunity
The Large Cryo Slime constantly freezes surfaces of water below them, making them unable to drown.

lore: A slime that has undergone ecological changes due to abundant Dendro in its environment. There are some who see it as something similar to the Whopperflowers, hiding its true form to trick and hunt its prey, and some regard it as a slime that has been parasitized by some special plant. From this point of view, might some cultures also see these slimes as having some special medicinal value?
attacks: Burning Weakness + Extinguish
When the large red flower on top of the Large Dendro Slime is intact, it will be inflicted with the Dendro status at all times. Pyro can be applied to the slime to cause Burning.
Ambush Leap
Upon spotting the player, the Large Dendro Slime will burrow into the ground, only leaving its large red flower visible. If Burning is inflicted upon it, it will be forced out of the burrowed state.
Dendro Slime Summon

Spreads 3 seeds that grow into Dendro Slimes. These summoned slimes do not yield any drops and will disappear after the parent slime is killed. A maximum of 6 summoned Dendro Slimes can exist at a time.
Poison Field
Creates a field around itself which deals 10% ATK as Dendro DoT to players within it and continuously heals enemies within it (excluding itself).
Toxic Seeds
Shoots 3 seeds which pop into lingering toxic clouds, applying a poison status to any player that passes through them, inflicting the Dendro status and dealing 10% ATK as Dendro DoT.
Ram
Rams into the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Jumping Slam
Jumps high into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A monster created by the coalescing of Electro dispersed throughout nature. Due to the abundant Electro within its form, it will deliver an electric shock to its surroundings from time to time. At present, some have attempted to harness this energy to aid in production activities. Perhaps some new science will be born from this...?
attacks: Electricity
When electricity is present on a Large Electro Slime (indicated when its "antenna" is glowing), it will be inflicted with Electro at all times, and its attacks will deal Electro DMG.
Ram
Rams into the player, dealing 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG if electricity is present or Physical DMG if electricity is not present.
Jumping Slam
Leaps high into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG if electricity is present or 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG if electricity is not present.

lore: Monsters created through the buildup of Geo within the earth. They can harden the energy within their bodies into a carapace of stone that protects them and prevents damage. The legend of a "Golden Geo Slime King" once circulated among the Treasure Hoarders. They believed that since gemstones and ores have Geo energy in them, Geo Slimes, which also contain Geo energy, may also be a type of gemstone or ore.
tips: A slime that uses a sturdy Geo Ward to protect itself. If you use heavy Geo attacks, a claymore, or strong explosions, you should be able to break through its defenses...
attacks: Geo Shield
The Geo Slime can generate a Geo shield to protect them from all incoming DMG. This shield is weakest to Blunt Attacks.
Rock Spit
Spews a rock at the player which has a moderate range, dealing 33.3% ATK as Geo DMG.
Jumping Slam

While the Geo Shield is intact, jumps high into the air before marking the impact area and slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.If attacked while the Geo Shield is destroyed, performs a low jump with extremely limited range,…
Regeneration
If the Geo Shield is destroyed, retreats from the player. The shield will regenerate after a period of time.

lore: A monster created by the sedimentation of Hydro dispersed throughout nature. A larger and more powerful Hydro Slime that can create bubbles to entrap its enemies. It is said that they can grow to truly staggering sizes if given an energy-rich environment. Eyewitnesses have supposedly seen Hydro Slimes as large as a small mound in Wolvendom.
attacks: Wet Application
When attacked, the Hydro Slime applies the Wet Status for 10 seconds to all players and enemies in a 2m radius.
Ram
Rams into the player, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Jumping Slam
Jumps high into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Bubble Spit
Launches a Gurgling Bubble in a high arc at the target.

lore: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas. The nature of a Breacher Primus defies known categories: they are not animals, plants, Shroom-Kin, nor Elementals. The debate among scholars of Sumeru never formally reached a consensus on just what it is, until it was finally banned as a research topic. The reason is that based on the current system of knowledge, this problem is like "the definitions prescribed by language and the true nature of things," and it is impossible to have a meaningful, final answer.
tips: A strange life form that shares nothing in common with any other land-dwelling creature. In battle, it will enter a stressed state and unleash a fierce Lushmissile while under the protection of a Dendro Ward. If the Ward is broken during this period, it will cause the life form to fall into a paralyzed state. Aside from the usual methods of using Elemental Reactions, attacks imbued with ousia or pneuma can also efficiently pierce the defenses of the Breacher Primus.
attacks: Melee Combo
Performs 2 or 3 melee attacks, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Single Shot
Fires a projectile at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Abyssal Barrage
Summons a black hole from which it fires many pellets, each dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stressed State

Periodically enters a stressed state, during which it will gain a Dendro shield and fire waves of Lushmissiles at the player, with each Lushmissile dealing 75% ATK as Dendro DMG. The shield can be broken using Elemental Reactions and is weakest to Electro.

lore: A monster created by the sedimentation of Pyro dispersed throughout nature. Though its intelligence has not increased with its size, it is very hot. During dry seasons, it can cause wildfires. It will spit forth blazing fireballs when angered, and will turn dark when it is feeling down. A most expressive slime, indeed.
attacks: Ignited State
While in the ignited state, the Large Pyro Slime will be inflicted with the Pyro status indefinitely. Triggering certain Elemental Reactions on a Large Pyro Slime will extinguish it.
Ram
Rams into the player, dealing 33.3% ATK as Pyro DMG while ignited or Physical DMG while extinguished.
Jumping Slam

While ignited, jumps high into the air before marking the impact area and slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.While extinguished, performs a low jump with extremely limited range, dealing 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG upon…
Fireballs
Spews 3 consecutive fireballs at the player, dealing 25% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit. Extinguishing the Large Pyro Slime during this attack will interrupt it.
Final Burst
When defeated in the ignited state, explodes after a short delay, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Reignition
While extinguished, retreats away from the player until it reignites after a period of time.

lore: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas. Melusines perceive Breacher Primuses as harmless creatures, and many even find them completely adorable. The visual perception of Melusines is very different from humans.
tips: A strange life form that shares nothing in common with any other land-dwelling creature. In battle, it will enter a stressed state and unleash a fierce Stonefall attack while under the protection of a Geo Ward. If the Ward is broken during this period, it will cause the life form to fall into a paralyzed state. Aside from the usual methods of using Elemental Reactions, attacks imbued with ousia or pneuma can also efficiently pierce the defenses of the Breacher Primus.
attacks: Melee Combo
Performs 2 or 3 melee attacks, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Single Shot
Fires a projectile at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Elastic Smash
Transforms into a and leaps forward 1 to 4 times, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stressed State

Periodically enters a stressed state, during which it will gain a Geo shield and unleashes Stonefalls, repeatedly smashing down and causing quakes that deal 100% ATK as Geo DMG. The shield is weakest to Blunt Attacks.

lava_dragon_statue.special: Stone-Hearted Final Form of Flowing Flame
lore: A monster that can continuously generate heat to sustain its activities. Legends say these monsters with lava at their cores are the products of a distinct line of research to the Source Mechanisms that followed them — research into whether the primal flame could be used to create a new race based on humans. This research undoubtedly failed, for once the reaver arrived with their throne from beyond the skies, all that the primal flame could birth were hollow shells whose nominal lifeforce granted them no more consciousness than a stone.
tips: A creature with two forms that is capable of continuously generating heat. When in its "Geohuman" form, you can use Pyro attacks to cause it to enter its "Molten Dragon" form. At this point, if you continue to use Pyro attacks, it will enter an Overburn state... However, if you manage to cool it down, it will revert back to its "Geohuman" form...
attacks: Dual Form
The Lava Dragon Statue starts in its Geohuman form. A Fury bar will fill when attacked by Pyro. When the bar fully fills, it will transform into its Molten Dragon form.
Arm Swipe
Swipes its left arm once in either direction, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG.
Smash and Slam
Smashes at the player with its left arm, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG, then launches into the air and slams down, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Lava Burst
Swipes its left arm, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG, then slams the ground with its rear, spilling out a pool of lava, dealing 50% ATK, 30% ATK, 30% ATK, 30% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Spin
If the player is far away, continuously spins and approaches the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG with each spin.
Eruption

If the player is far away, charges and fires 4 lava-infused rocks at the player in quick succession, each dealing 30% ATK as Pyro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Melting Beam
After charging, continuously shoots a beam of lava from its mouth and performs a full sweep around itself by rotating its body, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Molten Combo
Attacks with its two hands in succession, dealing 40% ATK, 60% ATK as Pyro DMG, then causes a lava eruption in a ring-shaped AoE around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Charge
Plants its hands onto the ground and charges at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.

lore: A Volkodlak of the canine clans that usually appears somewhat lazy. Among the many Volkodlak clans, the canine clans have always enjoyed a better reputation. Loyal, friendly, and usually mild-mannered. Though they will turn ferocious when those they have sworn to serve, or friends they know well, are placed in danger, striking down anyone they deem enemies. It is said that during a war long ago, their clan fought His Majesty the Tsar to the last in defense of their own king, and for this, earned His Majesty's favor.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Rubble
Shovels the ground in front of it and hurls the debris at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Heavy Strike
Raises its right pickaxe before slamming it down, dealing 65% ATK as Physical DMG.
Spinning Strike
Performs a spin to hit the player with its pickaxe before clumsily falling down, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Weapon Frenzy
Imbues its pickaxes with Hydro energy before performing four sets of rapid strikes (two strikes per set), dealing 65% ATK, 100% ATK as Hydro DMG respectively.

lore: A Volkodlak that usually conceals its slender body beneath a cloak and moves in secrecy. It is said that long ago, the artisans of the Golden City, who held the authority of creation, fashioned bodies for fae for many different purposes. This type of Volkodlak was originally created to test the limits of reproductive capability. Yet after the calamity that reduced that golden realm to ruins, the long-eared clan survived to the present day thanks to their great numbers. Now, they are masters of their own bodies. Agile enough to move deftly even across snow, they have become a threat that those crossing the snowy plains must handle with care.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Slash
Slashes the player with its right blade, dealing 55% ATK as Physical DMG.
Leaping Strike
Leaps at the player and slashes with the blades on its legs, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cleaver Throw
Throws the cleaver from its right hand, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Spinning Strike
Imbues its blades with Anemo energy before spinning around and following the player, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG on contact. Repeated hits are reduced accordingly to the Damage Sequence.

lore: A fell dragon, congealed from the power of pitch-black darkness.
attacks: Attrition
Some of the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire's attacks (indicated by dark purple color) inflict stacks of Attrition on hit. The amount of stacks inflicted depends on the attack.
Void Ward

During some attacks, the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire or its summoned objects will gain a Void Ward which grants immunity to DMG until destroyed. Depending on the ability, the Void Ward will have different amounts of durability.
Scorched Ground

Most of the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire's attacks will scorch the area struck. Depending on the type of attack that scorches the ground, it will inflict the following effects once every 0.5s to characters within the area:
Single Slash
Phase 1 only. Lunges towards the player and slashes once, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG and scorching the ground.
Double Slash
Phase 1 only. Slashes twice in an arc in front of itself, dealing 30% ATK, 30% ATK as Pyro DMG and leaving the ground burnt.
Downward Cleave
Phase 1 only. Raises its sword high and cleaves downwards, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG and scorching the ground.
Abyssal Orbs

Phase 1 only. Forms 4 large orbs of abyssal flame and sends them flying towards the player in succession. Upon impact, an orb deals 40% ATK as Physical DMG, inflicts 10 stacks of Attrition, and scorches the ground. Always followed by Downward Cleave.
Wave Blast

Phase 1 only. Inserts its sword into the ground and gains a Void Ward with 50 durability. Repeatedly releases waves of flames that expand outwards, dealing 20% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit. Afterwards, launches a large orb of abyssal flame at the player.
Summon Tenebrous Mimiflora
Phase 1 only. Engulfs the arena in a dark fog which greatly reduces visibility and summons 3 Tenebrous Mimiflora around the arena.
Severing Primal Fire
Summons abyssal flames to rain down in random locations across the arena, each dealing 15% ATK as Physical DMG and inflicting 5 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Dual Sword Blast
Phase 2 only. Plunges its dual swords into the ground and causes a quake in a straight line forward.
Dual Sword Slash
Phase 2 only. Slashes first with its Pyro sword, then with its abyssal sword, then both swords at the same time.
Darkscale Shower
Phase 2 only. Fires a barrage of scales that land in front of itself, each dealing 15% ATK as Physical DMG and inflicting 5 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Cloudform
Phase 2 only. Performs 2 lunging slashes, first with its abyssal sword, dealing 25% ATK as Physical DMG and inflicting 20 stacks of Attrition, then with its Pyro sword, dealing 45% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Annihilate

Phase 2 only. Gains a Void Ward with 40 durability and begins channeling immense abyssal energy. When charging completes, releases a massive blast across the arena, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG and inflicting 30 stacks of Attrition.
Starscourge

Phase 2 only. Spawns a vortex that pulls the player towards the center of the arena while dealing 10% ATK as Physical DMG every 0.5s. Afterwards, spawns 3 Nightsoul Totems around the player, forming a circular area that the player cannot exit.

lord_of_the_hidden_depths_whisperer_of_n.special: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
lore: An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy. Even invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?
tips: Lord of the swarm of monsters that surged through the Rift of Hidden Depths. Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares will deploy the Deepdark Shield in combat, summoning several Fishers of Hidden Depths. The shield(s) can only be broken by Elemental Attacks or reaction DMG. Lunar Reaction DMG is especially effective at breaking the shield(s). Additionally, defeating a summoned Fisher of Hidden Depths will also deal damage to its shield.
attacks: Tail Flurry
Launches a flurry of whipping strikes with its three tails, dealing 25% ATK × 3 as Electro DMG.
Tail Sweep
Sweeps the area in front of it with its tail, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG.
Ranged Combo
If far away from the player, may opt to attack with a three combo ranged attack.
Plunge
Opens a rift above and dives into it before targeting the player's location in a large AoE, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Emerging Strike
Opens a rift from behind, and dives into it before striking at the players location, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG.
Deepdark Strike

Roars and teleports to the center of the arena, generating a Deepdark Shield equal to 45% of its Max HP for itself and summoning four Fishers of Hidden Depths to assist it in battle while charging up. These Fishers will not generate Deepdark Shields.

lore: This is the form that the puppet that inherited the Raiden Shogun's authority takes when she is opposing those who threaten Eternity. As the Raiden Shogun's assistant in pursuing eternity, she has never doubted, never felt fear, never given anything less than her best, never been disturbed by idle thoughts. She once heard about how Ei had shouldered a similar duty when Makoto was also present, suffering much agonizing loss in the process. When the two shadows overlapped once more, however, she could only see the countless fine fractures in what should have been "her" eternal will. Since fate is destined for cyclicality, she must fulfill her promise and declare war on "her."

Mine is the most supreme and noble form. Power over the realm has been vested within me, and I am the essence of all that is the "Raiden Shogun." "Naturally, I have also inherited the pain of Ei's countless losses and her will to attain Eternity. "Resolve, valor, love, hate... They will all twist in the river of time. "But the 'rules' will never change."
attacks: Ominous Destiny
The Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto will accumulate Ominous Destiny. Ominous Destiny has a max value of 900. When Ominous Destiny reaches max, she will enter her Baleful Shadowlord state.
Shield
When attacked by the player using melee attacks, raises a shield around her that blocks all incoming melee DMG.
Stun Recovery
When recovering from a stunned state, deals 8.3% ATK Electro DMG around her.
Follow-Up

If the player is behind the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto shortly after she performs Slash Combo 1, Slash Combo 3, Cross-Slash, Lightning Summon, Lightning Blade, or Stun Recovery, swiftly turns around to perform an additional attack.
Thunderbolt
Deals 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG in front of her and switches to the Musou Isshin Stance. Afterwards, periodically summons thunderbolts that strike the ground, dealing 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Eyes of Stillness

Deals 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG in front of her and switches to the Engulfing Lightning Stance. Afterwards, periodically summons multiple eyes around the arena that unleash a flurry of slashes shortly after appearing, dealing 5.6% ATK × 4 as Electro DMG.
Slash Combo 1

Performs six consecutive strikes, dealing 8.3% ATK, 8.3% ATK, 16.6% ATK, 8.3% ATK, 8.3% ATK, 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG. This may be used at the beginning of the fight if the player approaches close to her.
Slash Combo 2

Dashes at the player, performs a circular slash, and quickly dash to the player behind the player to perform another slash. The circular slash deals 8.3% ATK × 2, the dash and the slash deals 16.6% ATK, 33.3% ATK respectively as Electro DMG.
Cross-Slash
Dashes towards the player and slashes twice in a cross pattern. The initial dash, the first slash and the second slash deal 16.6% ATK, 8.3% ATK, and 58.3% ATK respectively as Electro DMG.
Unbending Lightning
Launches three discs followed by a horizontal blade at the player. The discs and the horizontal blade each deal 33.3% ATK and 50% ATK respectively as Electro DMG on contact.
Illusions

Separates herself into four illusions that periodically slash at the player, dealing Electro DMG and launching lightning blades that deal Electro DMG on contact. Hitting an illusion three times will destroy it.
Musou no Hitotachi

The Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto pushes nearby players away from her, while Electro seeds descend around the arena, each dealing 66.6% ATK as Electro DMG upon landing creating a field that deals 12.5% ATK as Electro DoT.
Slash Combo 3
Performs three consecutive slashes around her. After the last slash, summons lightning in a large area around her. Each hit deals 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Slash Combo 4

Spins her polearm before dashing at the player and performing four consecutive strikes, dealing 16.6% ATK, 8.3% ATK, 16.6% ATK, 25% ATK as Electro DMG. The initial slash of this combo cannot be dodged using dash i-frames.
Lightning Summon

Spins her polearm and summons lightning in a large area around her, dealing 66.6% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack cannot be dodged using dash i-frames. This attack is always used when the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto teleports to the player's right side.
Lightning Blade

Performs an upward slash, dealing 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG and launching a fast vertical blade forward that deals 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG to characters in its path. This attack is often used as a follow-up to Slash Combo 3 but can also be used individually.
Magatsu Electroculi
Summons a Magatsu Electroculus at the center of the arena. If not destroyed after a period of time, the Magatsu Electroculus explodes violently, dealing 116.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Magatsu Electroculi (Enhanced)
Summons three Magatsu Electroculi around the arena while pushing nearby players away from her, dealing 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Baleful Shadowlord Form

When Ominous Destiny reaches max, the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto enters the Baleful Shadowlord form, gaining stronger attacks as well as an Electro shield that greatly increases her RES. This shield will be drained by 8 GU (~8.3%) every 10 seconds.
Energy Drain
While the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto is in the Baleful Shadowlord form, active characters will lose 20 Energy every 5 seconds.
Energy Generation

While the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto is in the Baleful Shadowlord form, triggering Elemental Reactions on her will generate 3 Non-Elemental Energy Particles. This generation has a cooldown of 1.5s.
Slash Combo 1

If the player is in front of the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto, performs two horizontal slashes and shoots a bolt at the ground in front of her, dealing 16.6% ATK, 25% ATK, 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Slash Combo 2
If the player is behind the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto, swiftly turns and performs a slash.
Downward Slash
Marks a large area in front of her as she charges her blade, dealing 8.3% ATK as Electro DoT around her, before performing a downward slash, dealing 116.6% ATK as Electro DMG.
Lightning Blade (Enhanced)
Slashes twice, dealing 25% ATK × 2 as Electro DMG and launching forward five vertical lightning blades, and one horizontal blade at a slower speed.
Single Slash
Readies her blade in a sheathed position, before performing a single slash that deals 50% ATK as Electro DMG around her.
Slash Flurry

If the player is far away, readies her blade in a sheathed position, before dashing at the player and performing a flurry of slashes in front of her, dealing 16.6% ATK, 8.3% ATK × 2, 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG.
Clap
Summons a pair of hands that follows the player before crushing in, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Puppet's Shadow
Launches a shadow that follows the player, dealing 8.3% ATK repeatedly as Electro DMG on contact.
Baleful Vajra's Destructive Waves
Summons three totems at the center of the arena that deal 25% ATK as Electro DMG upon landing. The bolts that landed will periodically release waves of Electro energy that expand outwards.
"The Final Calamity"
Covers herself within her palms and blinks away, completely draining all party members' Energy and Special Energy, leaving Flowers of Remembrance in the form of an orb.
