lore: A disciplined mechanical swordsman. Doesn't seem to have the ability nor will to speak, but instead only seeks to communicate with crossed swords. It is said that this machine was made using the memories of the first-generation master of a certain sword school. However, it malfunctioned, lost control, and was ultimately discarded. Some sing that the machine's spirit still lingers in the place where its fate was ended. They also say that the vicious mask that serves as its guard was inspired by a famous oni from that era.
attacks: Oushi no Omote
Summons an oni mask to protect it from ranged attacks if it is not performing one of its other attacks if the player is 7 m or farther away.
Pushing Mask
Summons a large oni mask in front of it before pushing it forward to deal 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Exploding Mask
Summons a large oni mask at the player's position that swirls uncontrollably before exploding, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Dash
Performs up to 5 short dashes, creating afterimages behind itself to approach the player.
Taunt
The Maguu Kenki will clench and raise its fist to taunt its opponent if they are far away from it after an attack. It is vulnerable to attacks while in this state.
Ichimonji
Slashes at the player three times, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG with each slash.
Iai: Shadowrush
Enters Iai stance and rushes toward the player while drawing its sword, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Pseudo Tengu Sweeper
Enters Iai stance and charges for a while before quickly slashing around itself once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Dual Sword Burst
Summons an additional sword, charging up before slamming the ground for a wide AoE, dealing 80% ATK as both Anemo DMG and Cryo DMG.
Blustering Blade

Performs a slash, sending a wind blade towards the player's current location, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG. The single-slash version of this attack is only used to follow up Iai: Shadowrush or Shadowsword: Ichimonji when certain conditions are met.
Iai: Shadowrush (Enhanced)
Enters Iai stance and rushes toward the player while drawing its sword, dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Shadowsword: Ichimonji

Maguu Kenki and a Shadowsword each performs up to 3 consecutive sword slashes at the player. With each slash, the Maguu Kenki deals 50% ATK as Anemo DMG while the Shadowsword deals 30% ATK as Anemo DMG or Cryo DMG.
Shadowsword: Pseudo Tengu Sweeper
Variant 1: Enters Iai stance and charges, dragging the player into its area of effect, before quickly slashing around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Shadowsword: Blustering Blade

Teleports and leaves an Anemo Shadowsword in its original location. The Shadowsword performs a single Blustering Blade slash before Maguu Kenki performs 3 or 4 Blustering Blade slashes in quick succession at the player.
Oushi no Omote

When attacked, summons an oni mask to protect itself. This ability will be disabled for 15 seconds if hit by the player's Perfect Parry counterattack. This ability can only defend against 1 hit per 0.2s.
Blustering Blade

Performs a slash, sending a wind blade towards the player's current location, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG. This attack is repeated 1/3/5 times in quick succession in Normal/Hard/Pro difficulties respectively.
Iai: Shadowrush
Enters Iai stance and rushes toward the player while drawing its sword, dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Shadowsword: Ichimonji

Maguu Kengou and a Shadowsword each performs up to 3 consecutive sword slashes at the player. With each slash, Maguu Kengou deals 50% ATK as Anemo DMG while the Shadowsword deals 30% ATK as Anemo DMG or Cryo DMG.
Pushing Mask
Summons a large oni mask in front of it before pushing it forward to deal 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Exploding Mask
Summons a large oni mask at the player's position that swirls uncontrollably before exploding, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Dual Sword Burst
Summons an additional sword, charging up before slamming the ground for a wide AoE, dealing 80% ATK as both Anemo DMG and Cryo DMG. This attack is only used in Pro difficulty.
Pseudo Tengu Sweeper
Maguu Kengou has a Fury meter that fills by 1 point when hit by the player's attacks.
Dash
Performs up to 5 short dashes creating afterimages behind itself to approach the player.
Ichimonji
Slashes at the player three times, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG with each slash. This attack is only used after being hit by the player's Perfect Parry counterattack.
Taunt
Clenches and raises its fist to taunt its opponent. This ability is only used in Normal and Hard difficulties.
Stunned
After being hit by a blade wave from the player's Honed Technique "Ferocious Combo Lashes", becomes stunned for 8 seconds.

millennial_pearl_seahorse.special: Nameless Lord of the Great Lake
lore: One of the two sovereigns standing at the apex of the Fontemer Aberrants. Poets and authors often proclaim it to be proud and noble due to its solitary tendencies, but the true reason behind such adulatory descriptions is its elegant and slender body. As such, it is a "Pearl Seahorse," while the suzerain of the Armored Crabs is an "Emperor." In the legends and rumors of Fontaine, a brutal war was once waged among the Aberrants of the Fontemer, leaving only the "Millennial Pearl Seahorse" and "Emperor of Fire and Iron" splitting the great lake into two courts, one ruling over the north, the other the south. In the "Song of Dobharcu," the writer describes the outcome of the war: the great Hunter's Ray known as the Stormlord stirred huge waves in its death throes, causing what is now known by the people as the "first diluvian period"... Of course, all of this is nothing more than the romantic imaginations of people who are unwilling to accept the bland realities of the world. For the Fontemer Aberrants are in fact just simple aquatic animals, and they have no grand courts nor fallen kingdoms, nor do they possess words meant to exalt or curse.
tips: A lonesome lord of seahorses that has gained the form of a fantastical beast and has surpassed almost all other Fontemer Aberrants. The Xenomare Pearl beneath its head is a crystallization of Electro that will allow it to use more powerful elemental attacks and possess stronger defensive abilities. Other than using Elemental Reactions to destroy the Xenomare Pearl, you can also destroy the Resonant Coral Orbs it creates while guiding Fontemer Hoarthunder to deal effective DMG to said Pearl.

A lonesome lord of seahorses that has gained the form of a fantastical beast and has surpassed almost all other Fontemer Aberrants. The Xenomare Pearl beneath its head is a crystallization of Electro that will allow it to use more powerful elemental attacks and possess stronger defensive abilities. Other than using Elemental Reactions to destroy the Xenomare Pearl, you can also destroy the Resonant Coral Orbs it creates while guiding Fontemer Hoarthunder to deal effective DMG to said Pearl.
attacks: Xenomare Pearl

The Millennial Pearl Seahorse holds a Xenomare Pearl in front of its legs that grants it 60% RES increase to all DMG and enables it to use stronger attacks. The pearl is Electro-infused and can be destroyed using Elemental Reactions.
Earthshock Descent

Leaps twice into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 95% ATK as Electro DMG, then raises its front legs to cause another shockwave, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG and leaving the ground electrified.
Lock On

Marks the player with a circle of swimming fish, then deals 50% ATK as Electro DMG within the circle and leaves a small area of the ground electrified. Electrified ground deals 6% ATK as Electro DMG every 0.5s to players standing on it.
Unihorn Thrust

Charges at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG and electrifying the ground in its path. Electrified ground deals 6% ATK as Electro DMG every 0.5s to players standing on it. This attack is only used when the Xenomare Pearl is intact.
Swirling School of Fish
Conjures a great number of fish-shaped missiles which home in at the player, each dealing 35% ATK as Electro DMG on hit. This attack is only used when the Xenomare Pearl is intact.
Tail Swipe

Performs a 3-part melee attacks by swiping its tail, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 50% ATK as Electro DMG. If the second hit hits the player, the third hit's DMG will be halved. The first hit or the second and third hits of the combo can sometimes be omitted.
Fontemer Hoarthunder

After the Xenomare Pearl's durability is decreased below 7GU (or 4.2GU if the pearl has already been destroyed once), the Millennial Pearl Seahorse ascends high into the air and summons 3 Resonant Coral Orbs.
Single Swipe
Swipes its tail once, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when the Xenomare Pearl is destroyed.
Double Swipe

Swipes its tail twice, dealing 50% ATK, 40% ATK as Physical DMG. If the player is hit by the first hit, the second hit's DMG will be halved. This attack is only used when the Xenomare Pearl is destroyed.
Charge
Charges at the player, dealing 65% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used when the Xenomare Pearl is destroyed.
Regeneration
The Millennial Pearl Seahorse recovers its pearl, and releases a shockwave around itself, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG. A pearl recovered this way will only have 60% of its original durability.

lore: A Fatui mage who can command a Hydro Mirror in battle. Her posture is highly dignified, as if she is one who worships a god. The Hydro Mirror she manipulates lures those enchanted by her to willingly fall for her illusion. Nothing seems to escape her ears. No one knows what those covered eyes have seen, nor what kind of obsession might be reflected in them...
tips: A Fatui Maiden who wields a water mirror in combat. Some attacks apply the Refraction status to character. When nearby characters are affected by Refraction, she enters the Polarization state, in which she is stronger.
attacks: Polarization State
When hit by certain attacks of the Mirror Maiden, a Refraction status will be applied to the player, and the Mirror Maiden will enter the Polarization State.
Mirror Portal
Summon a mirror behind her that closes up around them causing her to disappear, then another mirror appears that the Mirror Maiden emerges from.
Influx Blast

Summons 3 water wheels from the skies that spin and burst dealing 62.5% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack applies the Refraction status onto the player. The attack is replaced by Ripple Rain when the Mirror Maiden is in Polarization state.
Explosive Splash

Summons an Explosive Splash around herself if the player attacks her in melee range, dealing 93.75% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack applies the Refraction status onto the player. This attack no longer occurs after the Mirror Maiden is in Polarization state.
Water Ball

Shoots up to two consecutive Hydro Bullets at the player, each dealing 62.5% ATK as Hydro DMG; if the Maiden is in Polarization state, 3 homing bullets will be shot at once, each dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Ripple Rain
Shoots water into the air that then falls down causing 3 splashes that each deal 62.5% ATK as Hydro DMG. This attack is only used when the Mirror Maiden is in Polarization state.
Water Prison

Summons temporary small mirror shards around the player, dealing 12.5% ATK as Hydro DMG and trapping the player inside, the player may still move and attack while in the cage but cannot escape without special means.
Rippled Reflection

Summons 3 Hydro Bullets that orbit around them and one that orbits around the player, then many mirrors will be summoned around a player which reflect a laser many times in the area dealing 16.25% ATK * 8 as Hydro DMG, then a burst of water erupts dealing…

lore: A monster created by the coalescing of Electro dispersed throughout nature. Electro Slimes can undergo mutations to become bright yellow. Due to the abundant Electro within its form, it will deliver an electric shock to its surroundings from time to time, and it can even cause nearby Electro Slimes to release electric arcs. This arc lightning will not bounce between purple Electro Slimes, which shows that Electro Slimes have two different polarities. One wonders if some great new science could emerge from the study of such phenomena...
attacks: Discharge

Periodically discharges a current between nearby Electro Slimes and Large Electro Slime, forcing all of them to use their Shock attack simultaneously. The Mutant Electro Slime cannot use this ability on another Mutant Electro Slime.
Ram
Rams into the player, dealing 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG.
Electricity
When electricity is present on a Mutant Electro Slime (indicated when its "antenna" is glowing), it will be inflicted with Electro at all times, and its attacks will deal Electro DMG.
Ram
Rams into the player, dealing 33.3% ATK as Electro DMG if electricity is present or Physical DMG if electricity is not present.
Jumping Slam
Leaps high into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG if electricity is present or 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG if electricity is not present.

lore: A clockwork meka designed to dig up and transport soil. Due to the inherent ability of the local water and soil to store and transmit ousia and pneuma, clockwork meka powered by the annihilation of these energies are highly favored in Fontaine. This also explains why adventurers may come across Ousia and Pneuma Blocks from time to time.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Nimble Harvester Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Drift
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Rams the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charge
Charges at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Dirt Throw
Launches dirt at the player, dealing 90% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.

lore: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization. They not only possess highly advanced sword skills, but can also carry out flame powder attacks using the elements. Objectively speaking, perhaps this method of winning goes against the path of a martial artist. Sometimes they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.
attacks: Interruption Resistance
While performing any attacks, the Nobushi's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Sword Slash
Performs a single upward or downard slash at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Iai: Thrust

Readies their weapon on the hilt before dash-slashing at the player, dealing 150% ATK as Physical DMG. This move is always accompanied by the signature glint on the hilt, shared between all variations of Nobushi as they prepare to unsheathe.
Blaze Bloom
Jumps backwards and tosses out flame powder to cause several explosions at their original location, dealing 37.5% ATK * 2 as Pyro DMG and staggering the player.
Taunt
Spin their katanas to taunt their opponents. They are left open while doing this.

lore: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization. Having pursued the path of a martial artist for a long time, they possess highly advanced sword skills but no longer use them for good. Sometimes, they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.
attacks: Interruption Resistance
While performing any attacks, the Nobushi's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Sword Slash
Performs a single upward or downard slash at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Iai: Thrust

Readies their weapon on the hilt before dash-slashing at the player, dealing 150% ATK as Physical DMG. This move is always accompanied by the signature glint on the hilt, shared between all variations of Nobushi as they prepare to unsheathe.
Taunt
Spin their katanas to taunt their opponents. They are left open while doing this.

lore: Samurai who have fallen into banditry. Though they are called the Nobushi, they do not have a centralized organization. They possess highly-advanced sword skills and also use crossbows to ambush opponents, using any means to win. Those who have abandoned the title of a martial artist often abandon their dignity as well. Sometimes they even collude with the Treasure Hoarders or Fatui out of a greed for wealth — or simply to survive.
attacks: Interruption Resistance
While performing any attacks, the Nobushi's Interruption Resistance is greatly increased.
Sword Slash
Performs a single upward or downard slash at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Iai: Thrust

Readies their weapon on the hilt before dash-slashing at the player, dealing 150% ATK as Physical DMG. This move is always accompanied by the signature glint on the hilt, shared between all variations of Nobushi as they prepare to unsheathe.
Mechanical Thunderbow
Draws a crossbow and fires 3 bolts at the player if they are too far from the Kikouban, dealing 68.75% ATK as Electro DMG with each shot.
Taunt
Spin their katanas to taunt their opponents. They are left open while doing this.

lore: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a specialized hover pack and explosive charges, and tasked with performing breaching operations. As troops with immense breakthrough potential, bombardiers are often sent to the most dire of battlefields, making them the troops who gain meritorious promotions most quickly. It is said that Oprichniki officers overwhelmingly come from the ranks of the bombardiers.
attacks: Bomb
Throws a bomb at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Kuuvahki Bomb

After a small charge up, throws a kuuvahki-infused bomb that tracks the player and deals 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. The player can use kuuvahki to interrupt the attack, stumbling the Bombardier and disarming them.
Roundhouse Kick
Performs a spinning kick, doing 10% ATK as Physical DMG and causing moderate knockback. Only used while disarmed.

lore: An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in close combat using a giant blade. Whether it be in the war against the dark calamity or against those ignoramuses who dare stand against the Tsaritsa's ideals, those who breach at the tip of the spear suffer the greatest casualties. As such, those who survive multiple battles are naturally the elite of the elite. There will always be those willing to become the fire and sword of the empire, just as there will always be those who chafe against the injustice of fate and the inequity of the Old World.
tips: A member of the Fatui's elite Oprichniki forces tasked with maintaining the line of battle. They wield powerful, modified weapons that harness the power of kuuvahki. Because of this, you might be able to effectively target them with kuuvahki-based attacks while they're charging up their weapons to unleash powerful attacks...
attacks: Slash
Performs a single slash attack, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Shotgun
Using his blade's built-in shotgun, fires three volleys of fire bullets at the player, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK as Pyro DMG with each bullet in each volley respectively.
Thrust Combo
Charges up before thrusting at the player, dealing 50% ATK and follows up by jumping into the air and thrusts into the ground, dealing 90% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Kuuvahki Fireblade
Infuses his blade with kuuvahki before performing a long combo consisting of four slashes, a slam, and a spinning sweep, dealing 40% ATK, 50% ATK, 40% ATK, 50% ATK, 70% ATK, 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Experimental Multi-Shield
After some time has passed (or immediately upon entering combat in Spiral Abyss/Stygian Onslaught), generates a multi-layered dome shield around himself while charging up for a powerful attack.
Thundering Suite

While Experimental Multi-Shield is active, up to 9 waves of three bolts of lightning will strike randomly across the arena, indicated with a medium-sized AoE at the target area, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG. One of these will target the player's position.

lore: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a man-portable grenade launcher that can perform close-range bombardment. Though the Oprichniki has large-scale, fully-functional fire support attachments, the commanding staff still advocates for large numbers of grenadiers to be maintained. After all, no big gun can compare in surety at the very front lines of combat to a grenade launcher you can direct at will.
attacks: Grenade
Fires a grenade at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Kuuvahki Grenades

Infuses her grenade launcher with kuuvahki and fires six grenades at an arc in rapid succession, dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG with each one. The player can use kuuvahki to interrupt the attack, stumbling the Grenadier and disarming them.
Punch
Punches twice, dealing 10% ATK, 10% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used while disarmed.

lore: An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who uses a heavy cannon to tear enemy formations apart while using a mighty shield to defend their comrades. Bitter battles have dyed the shield frost white, while coatings of blood have tinted its edges black. Oprichniki officers know that empty words will never bring back those who have fallen in sacrifice — only a bombardment akin to a hailstorm can shake this defiled Old World.
tips: A member of the Fatui's elite Oprichniki forces tasked with maintaining the line of battle. They wield powerful, modified weapons that harness the power of kuuvahki. Because of this, you might be able to effectively target them with kuuvahki-based attacks while they're charging up their weapons to unleash powerful attacks...
attacks: Bazooka Slam
If close to the cannoneer, he will slam his bazooka onto the ground, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG in a small area around him.
Melee Combo
Swipes at the player with his cannon before slamming it into the ground, dealing 60% ATK, 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Cannon Shot
If away from the cannoneer, fires a single projectile from his cannon, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Kuuvahki Shield Cannon

Transforms his cannon into a shield with kuuvahki, slowly walking towards their target while firing a single projectile from the barrel up to nine times, with each projectile dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a gunblade and tasked to hold the line as the resilient backbone of the Oprichniki forces. According to Snezhnayan infantry manuals, the primary duties of line troops are merely to aim, shoot, and charge. Even should the individual soldier's combat power not prove exceptional, soldiers of the line in tight formation remain a key foundation of the Snezhnayan military machine.
attacks: Bayonet Slash
Performs a swing and a thrust with their gunblade, dealing 40% ATK, 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Ice Shot
Fires a frost bullet at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Kuuvahki Rapid Fire

Infuses their gunblade with kuuvahki and fires six shots in rapid succession, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG with each shot. The player can use kuuvahki to interrupt the attack, stumbling the Line Trooper and disarming them.
Roundhouse Kick
Performs a spinning kick, doing 10% ATK as Physical DMG and causing moderate knockback. Only used while disarmed.
Punch
Punches twice, dealing 10% ATK, 10% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used while disarmed.

lore: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a staff-like device and tasked with providing emergency medical support to their comrades in arms. In truth, these medics have largely only taken crash-course training, and as such, their healing abilities are limited. In practice, they tend to adopt more efficient methods of supporting their allies — mixing in with the different units and charging at the enemy lines.
attacks: Water Blast
Fires a water ball at the player that curves toward them, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Kuuvahki Healing
Infuses their staff with kuuvahki and charges for an extended period of time. If not interrupted, heals all nearby Oprichniki units for 20% of their Max HP and increases their ATK by 20% for 12s.
Roundhouse Kick
Performs a spinning kick, doing 10% ATK as Physical DMG and causing moderate knockback. Only used while disarmed.
Punch
Punches twice, dealing 10% ATK, 10% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used while disarmed.

lore: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a heavy shield and tasked to fight at the very front to protect their comrades. Many understand that in the long war between Snezhnaya and the dark calamity, only the side that holds out with greater resolution can outlast the other and emerge victorious. The ultimate resolution of the Oprichniki is, undoubtedly, the shield that protects their forces — so long as this shield does not fall, there is always hope for victory.
attacks: Charge
Charges at the player with his shield in front, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Kuuvahki Shield
Infuses his shield with kuuvahki and holds it in front of him to defend while slowly approaching the player. After a short moment, he will swing his shield, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Punch
Performs a punch with his left hand, dealing 10% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used while disarmed.
Charged Punch
Lunges towards the player and punches with his right hand, dealing 10% ATK as Physical DMG and causing moderate knockback. Only used while disarmed.

lore: An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in using twin guns in combat. Unlike their Skirmisher cousins, Oprichniki officers almost all hail from the Snezhnayan Royal Military Academy, whether due to the privilege of noble birth or the rare talent to escape a common background. After all, neither is truly different from the other within the Tsaritsa's beneficent, loving ideals. Traditionally, only fae could become elite Gvardiya, but today, this glorious role and title has been given to Oprichniki officers — a more equal division for the construction of a new world.
tips: A member of the Fatui's elite Oprichniki forces tasked with maintaining the line of battle. They wield powerful, modified weapons that harness the power of kuuvahki. Because of this, you might be able to effectively target them with kuuvahki-based attacks while they're charging up their weapons to unleash powerful attacks...
attacks: Close Range Combo
Fires a short barrage of bullets at the player from the left gun, then the right gun, then from both guns while spreading them apart, each bullet dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Bullet Shower
Fires a shower of bullets into the air that rains down upon an AoE, each one dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Explosive Shot
Jumps back and fires an explosive shot at the ground in front of her, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Kuuvahki Thunderblitz
Infuses both of her guns with kuuvahki and fires a continuous barrage of bullets at the player while slowly walking towards them, with each bullet dealing 80% ATK as Electro DMG.

lore: A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with engineering tools and highly adept in close-range combat. To meet the demands of battlefield operations, the Fatui Oprichniki established vanguard units, tasked with clearing the path of obstacles for advancing forces. As for exactly what counts as an obstacle, that hardly matters. Be it an impassable ravine or a formidable foe standing in their way, they will remove it without hesitation — whatever it takes to ensure the banner of the Pale Star marches on.
attacks: Melee Attack
Performs up to two swings with their wrench, dealing 40% ATK, 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Kuuvahki Slam
Infuses their wrench with kuuvahki and slams it at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG. The player can use kuuvahki to interrupt the attack, stumbling the Vanguard and disarming them.
Roundhouse Kick
Performs a spinning kick, doing 10% ATK as Physical DMG and causing moderate knockback. Only used while disarmed.
Punch
Performs a punch with their left hand, dealing 10% ATK as Physical DMG. Only used while disarmed.
Charged Punch
Lunges towards the player and punches with their right hand, dealing 10% ATK as Physical DMG and causing moderate knockback. Only used while disarmed.

lore: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas. In Fontaine, the earliest recorded observations of a Breacher Primus appeared shortly after the cataclysm. Records from the time show instances of Breacher Primuses both attacking and protecting humans.
tips: A strange life form that shares nothing in common with any other land-dwelling creature. In battle, it will enter a stressed state and unleash a fierce Lushmissile while under the protection of a Dendro Ward. If the Ward is broken during this period, it will cause the life form to fall into a paralyzed state. Aside from the usual methods of using Elemental Reactions, attacks imbued with ousia or pneuma can also efficiently pierce the defenses of the Breacher Primus.
attacks: Single Shot
Fires a projectile at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Melee Attack
Performs a melee attack at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stressed State

Periodically enters a stressed state, during which it will gain a Dendro shield and fire waves of Lushmissiles at the player, with each Lushmissile dealing 75% ATK as Dendro DMG. The shield is weakest to Electro.

lore: A strange, alien machine. They say that it is a war machine left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Composed of several different parts, it can adapt to its combat environment and employ a variety of attacks. This machine, comprised of cubic shapes, is on some level very much like the elemental hypostases.
tips: A mysterious ruin machine that can reconfigure itself into various forms. In battle, the Perpetual Mechanical Array will enter the Absolute Defense state, in which it splits and summons several different kinds of Ruin Sentinels. After defeating the enhanced Ruin Sentinels, Absolute Defense state will be removed and it will enter a weakened state.
attacks: Rocket Blast
Transforms into a rocket and targets the player's position before slamming down, dealing 91.6% ATK as Physical DMG.
Orbital Strike
Targets the player's current position with a reticle that focuses before striking down, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cube Roll

Only uses this move at long ranges. Transforms into a Cube and rolls repeatedly with high speed. When it catches up to the player, releases a shockwave with the final roll, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Sword Slash
Only uses this move at Melee ranges. Transforms into a giant sword and slashes Right to Left, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Blade Spin
Only uses this move at Melee ranges. Transforms into a giant spinning blade and does a zig-zag pattern before slashing Left to Right, dealing 58.3% ATK as Physical DMG.
Energy Cannon
Charges up for a short time before firing a beam of pure energy that deals 33.3% ATK as Physical DoT to those touching the beam. The beam follows the player.
Defensive Mode

Assumes a defensive stance and launches four cubes that transform into Ruin Sentinels. Only one highlighted Ruin Sentinel can be damaged, and defeating it will paralyze the Perpetual Mechanical Array and lower its base resistances by 50%.

lore: A moving statue shaped like a warrior who will swing their sword at all who dare trespass upon the area under their guardianship. It is unclear if it is a soul or magic that powers them. They say that legions of golems once conquered the nations that called the high sea home, and this might have been amongst their number. The great towers and palaces that now sleep beneath the waves once bore witness to the fate of those who stand in the path of the wheel of fate.
tips: An ancient golem infused with will that uses its resilient marble body in battle. Use methods suited to dealing with Geo to effectively defeat its defenses.
attacks: Geo Shield

The Praetorian Golem is protected by a Geo shield that increases its RES to all DMG by 50%. The shield is weakest against Blunt Attacks. If the shield is destroyed, the Praetorian Golem will become paralyzed for ~8 seconds before regaining its shield.
Double Swing
Swings its greatsword twice, dealing 50% ATK, 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Triple Swing
Performs three spinning slashes, dealing 60% ATK, 80% ATK, 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Downward Cleave
Charges towards the player if far away. Cleaves down with its greatsword, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Heatblade
Slashes downward to launch a vertical blade at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Heated Field

Inserts its greatsword into the ground and creates a field at the player's location. The field detonates 8 times, dealing 40% ATK for the first 7 detonations and 80% ATK for the final detonation as Pyro DMG.

precursor_s_secret_source_matrix_of_over.special: Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
lore: An ancient machine trapped amongst the lunar ruins. Even the sturdiest and most reliable machines will be conquered by the passing of long years, losing the purpose bestowed upon them by their creators. Now, this entity only attacks and eliminates anything that dares set foot on the ground it defends. In the records of a long-lost ancient civilization, these out-of-control machines were once called "Ur-Namrasit-Tilimtu-Babbar," or "the one who brings light to the darkness." With a yearning for the boundless sea of stars, the leaders of the "pioneers" engraved their most earnest words in golden sigils, hoping that their successors, with the help of these assistants, would be able to keep the light that illuminates the universe shining bright. Alas, the light did not arise for anyone, and the machine that was given the title of "overseer" did not manage to wait for the one it should have served. Now, stranded in these ruins, it is but the last, out-of-control remnant of a long-lost ideal.
tips: A Secret Source mechanism that can operate amidst the starry sea, far away from the Ley Lines. In combat, the Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network uses Archaeolune Energy to initiate a Convergence Field and gathers Hydro to enhance its workings. Freeze it at this time and then use Shatter, Melt, and other Elemental Reactions to break up the ice and halt the Convergence Field's operation.
attacks: Ground Slam
Briefly ascends before slamming down to the ground, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Cannon Fire
Fires 2 water orbs in succession, dealing 70% ATK, 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Bombardment
Fires 5 water orbs into the air which then launch toward the player's general direction, each dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG upon landing.
Roll
Imbues itself with Hydro and rolls forward, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Convergence Field
Initiates a Convergence Field, gaining an immutable Hydro aura and a 65% increase to all RES. Within the Convergence Field, gravity is reduced and animation speed is reduced by 45% when jumping.
Suppression Field
Initiates a Suppression Field, gaining an immutable Hydro aura and a 200% increase to all RES. Within the Convergence Field, gravity is reduced and animation speed is reduced by 45% when jumping.

lore: The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord. The master of the sands once took to studying taboo knowledge in an effort to create a dream paradise, and these machines may or may not have been the fruits of that research. Today, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.
tips: These ancient machines, which come from the desert, are quite distinct from the Ruin Machines. In combat, these Primal Constructs will fire their components out while their cores enter an "invisible" state that hides them and increases their RES. Use Catalyze reactions to strike these cores or use Electro attacks on them during such times as the fired components have been destroyed and need to recover to cancel this invisibility and cause the cores to be immobilized due to excessive overclocking.
attacks: Prospect
Sweeps the area in front of it with two laser beams, which deal 50% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.
Invisible State
Leaves 2 parts on the field and becomes invisible, gaining +50% All RES. The parts periodically fire a laser beam, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord. These machines were not first built to be temple guards or palace defenders, but instead to rebirth the paradise that the foolish desert ruler dreamed of. Today, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.
tips: These ancient machines, which come from the desert, are quite distinct from the Ruin Machines. In combat, these Primal Constructs will fire their components out while their cores enter an "invisible" state that hides them and increases their RES. Use Catalyze reactions to strike these cores or use Electro attacks on them during such times as the fired components have been destroyed and need to recover to cancel this invisibility and cause the cores to be immobilized due to excessive overclocking.
attacks: Repulse
Generates a force shield that pushes forward, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.
Invisible State
Leaves 2 parts on the field and becomes invisible, gaining +50% All RES. The parts chase the player and deal 50% ATK as Physical DMG on contact.

lore: The guardians of the lost ancient desert ruins have power enough to punish any who would presume to disturb the pure dreams of their lord. The lord of the blazing sun who once ruled this desert once promised his people a utopia on the other side of existence, though it ultimately turned out to be a mirage made of folly. Today, that utopia is long gone, and the dreams and oaths, forgotten by the world, are now only found in the mantras inscribed upon these machines.
tips: These ancient machines, which come from the desert, are quite distinct from the Ruin Machines. In combat, these Primal Constructs will fire their components out while their cores enter an "invisible" state that hides them and increases their RES. Use Catalyze reactions to strike these cores or use Electro attacks on them during such times as the fired components have been destroyed and need to recover to cancel this invisibility and cause the cores to be immobilized due to excessive overclocking.
attacks: Reshape
Fires a bolt that strikes down at the player's location and drills into the ground, dealing 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Invisible State
Leaves 2 parts on the field and becomes invisible, gaining +50% All RES. The parts deal 50% ATK as Physical DMG when they land.

lore: After many years, the awesomely powerful Primo Geovishaps grow accustomed to changes in their elemental environment. Folktales hold that after the great "draconic calamity" that led to the ruination of Tianqiu Valley, the overlord of the Geovishaps and Primo Geovishaps was imprisoned deep beneath the earth, and so too did they burrow into deep and unseen places, awaiting their chance to rise once more...
tips: A Primo Geovishap awoken from a centuries-long slumber that can absorb different kinds of elemental power to unleash a Primordial Shower infused with Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, or Electro. If this attack hits a character protected by a shield, the Primo Geovishap will take some DMG in return. If the shield's elemental type is Geo or it matches that of the Primordial Shower, the amount of reflected DMG will be increased...
attacks: Elemental-Infused Stones
Certain attacks will produce stones that detonate after a few seconds delay, creating different effects based on their element:
Left Claw
Claws at the player, inserting its left claw into the ground, dealing 35% ATK as Geo DMG both on impact and when it pulls its claw out of the ground.
Right Claw
Claws in front of itself once with its right claw, dealing 40% ATK as Geo DMG.
Whirlwind

Looks behind itself, then performs a quick spinning attack, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack is heavily prioritized if any players are behind the Primo Geovishap. This attack ignores dash i-frames.
Combo Slash
Attack forward twice, and ends with a slam towards the player. Each attack deals 40% ATK, 50% ATK, and 62.5% ATK respectively as Geo DMG.
Burrow

Targets outside Primo Geovishap's melee reach will cause it to submerge underground and dig towards the enemy, creating Elemental-Infused Stones as it travels. It will also deal 25% ATK as Geo DMG to characters on contact as it bores through the ground.
Scattered Rocks
Raises up its tail and scatter a number of Elemental-Infused Stones around the arena.
Elemental Breath

Unleash a breath of pure elemental power, whilst arcing the attack in a cone-like area in front of itself, rapidly dealing 40% ATK as DMG of the currently infused element. DMG from repeated hits may be reduced by its Damage Sequence.
Primeval Spring
Spawns a barrage of Elemental-Infused Stones around itself. The attack itself deals no damage and can only be used once Primo Geovishap reaches critical health (20% Max HP).
Primordial Shower

Unleashes a blast of pure elemental power in a huge AoE around it, dealing 100% ATK as DMG of the currently infused element. DMG is greatly reduced to 25% ATK when protected by a shield (independent from shield multipliers). This attack ignores dash i-frames.

lore: A vishap that dwells deep beneath the oceans. They were once the dominant race in the depths — and indeed, dragons were the overlords of the whole world in an even earlier age. But their former Seven Sovereigns were defeated by a power from the heavens, withering one by one.
tips: A predator that lies in wait within the pitch-dark watery depths. It appears to have adapted to some unknown power out in the deep seas, such that it can use elements other than Hydro... When it faces strong foes, it will use its powerful Cleansing Shower. Characters hit by this attack will lose a certain amount of Elemental Energy. If they do not have sufficient Elemental Energy, they will lose HP.
attacks: Cleansing Shower

Forms an orb within their mouth and launches it at the player. On hit, the orb deals 50% ATK as Hydro DMG and drains 10 Energy from the active character. If the active character has less than 10 Energy, inflicts HP Loss.
Spinning Sweep
Curls up and quickly spins, dealing 30% ATK * 2 as Hydro DMG.
Waterwheels
Forms 3 wheels of water at the tip of its tail before launching them at the player in a wide spread, dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG along their paths.
Spike Field

Plugs its tail into the ground, creating a large field around it within which water splashes from the ground at random locations, dealing 60% ATK as Hydro DMG. The player will be targeted by one of these once every 2 seconds if within the field.
Slash Combo
If the player is within melee range, performs 2 horizontal slashes followed by a downward smash, dealing 30% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK respectively as Physical DMG with each hit.
Cleansing Shower
Launches 3 orbs. On hit, an orb deals 20% ATK as Hydro DMG and drains 30 Energy from the active character. If the active character has less than 30 Energy, inflicts HP Loss.
Cleansing Burst
Launches 6 orbs in quick succession. On hit, an orb deals 20% ATK as Hydro DMG and drains 20 Energy from the active character. If the active character has less than 20 Energy, inflicts HP Loss.
Purification Field
Gains a Hydro shield and summons a field with a 6.5m radius around itself, increasing all RES by 80%.
Spinning Sweep
Curls up and quickly spins, dealing 50% ATK * 2 as Hydro DMG.
Slash Combo
If the player is within melee range, performs 2 horizontal slashes followed by a downward smash, dealing 40% ATK, 60% ATK, 100% ATK respectively as Hydro DMG with each hit.
Cleansing Shower

Forms an orb within their mouth and launches it at the player. On hit, the orb deals 50% ATK as Hydro DMG and drains 10 Energy from the active character. If the active character has less than 10 Energy, inflicts HP Loss.
Spinning Sweep
Curls up and quickly spins, dealing 30% ATK * 2 as Hydro DMG.
Slash Combo
If the player is within melee range, performs 2 horizontal slashes followed by a downward smash, dealing 30% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK respectively as Physical DMG with each hit.

lore: An Experimental Field Generator that once embodied the lofty ideals of an engineer. It brought calamity before these hopes could be realized. Nowadays, the exquisite mechanical construct quietly bides its time in the center of the ruined hall, waiting for the gravity field to take effect once more — a moment when it will no longer be seen as a mere memento of disgrace.
attacks: Laser Sweep
Activates 2 emitters that rotate while continuously firing laser beams. The laser beams deal 50% ATK as Physical DMG to targets that come in contact.
Carpet Bombing

Ascends high into the air and flies towards the player while dropping a great number of bombs, each dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG. At the end of the bombing sequence, smashes down to the ground, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Missile Barrage
Locks onto the player and fires a barrage of homing missiles, each dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.
Gravity Reduction Field
Teleports to the center of the arena and covers the entire arena in a Gravity Reduction Field. Characters in this field will gain greatly increased jumping height.
Gravity Ripple

This is always the first and last attack to be used by the Experimental Field Generator while the Gravity Reduction Field is active. Periodically sends out a shockwave that expands outwards and can be jumped over, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Enhanced Attack 2

Consecutively detonates multiple explosions around itself, each dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG and spawns several rocks midair. The rocks then fire themselves at the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Enhanced Attack 3
Marks areas on the ground where rocks emerge from the ground after a short delay, dealing 80% ATK as Geo DMG on hit.
Enhanced Attack 4
Charges and releases a massive explosion, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: Abyss creatures who command the power of Pyro in battle. For unknown reasons, Abyss Mages are able to communicate with the hilichurls, thus enabling them to manipulate their minds easily. They say that Abyss Mages utter a long-forgotten language from which they draw magical power.
tips: Uses a Pyro Ward to protect itself. Perhaps you can break down its defenses with Electro or other Elemental Attacks that react with Pyro.
attacks: Pyro Shield

Upon initiating combat, the Pyro Abyss Mage immediately gains a Pyro Shield, protecting it from damage. The shield takes damage from certain Elemental Reactions and suffers additional damage based on the strength of the attacks it receives.
Flamewave
Shoots a fire projectile at the target, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG. The projectile sticks to terrain and cannot hit airborne targets.
Special Attack: Blazing Visage
Summons three demon heads in a triangle formation to spew fire at the target's location, each dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack is affected by a Damage Sequence.
Teleportation

If the target is too far from the mage, it clutches its mask and teleports directly in front of the target, dealing 66.6% ATK as Pyro DMG at its location upon reappearance. The mage can also teleport away from the player to avoid attacks when vulnerable.
Rite of the Molten Eruption

If the mage is left alone after its shield is destroyed, summons bursts of fire which erupt from the ground around it, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG and launching targets. During this attack, the mage's Interruption Resistance is increased.
Burning Damage Immunity
The Pyro Abyss Mage is immune to damage dealt by the Burning Elemental Reaction (but not the reaction itself) and damage from burning grass.
Enhancement
Certain enhanced Pyro Abyss Mages can be found in certain Domains, Spiral Abyss, overworld events and challenges. There are 3 possible types of enhancements: Attack, Shield, and Teleportation.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. These archers wield simple crossbows, and their arrowheads are coated with a thin layer of flammable material that can set their targets on fire. El Musk of the previous generation believed that this is an innovation by brighter hilichurls who wished to cook their game after hunting it.
attacks: Fire Arrow
Charges as Pyro energy accumulates on their arrowhead, before firing an arrow at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Burning Damage Immunity
The Pyro Hilichurl Shooter is immune to damage dealt by the Burning Elemental Reaction (but not the reaction itself) and damage from burning grass.

lore: Code Name: Ayin. A high-purity Pyro entity. According to researchers, Elemental Hypostases are related to anomalies in local Elemental veins. But whether it is the existence of Elemental Hypostases that have affected Elemental veins or the mutated Elemental Energy that created Elemental Hypostases remains to be confirmed.
tips: Protects itself with a cubical shell that is elementally inert. Has two states: Ignited and Extinguished. In the Ignited state, the Pyro Hypostasis's core is not exposed and it continuously regenerates HP. Only after Extinguishing it with the right elemental reactions will you have an opportunity to strike. In the Extinguished state, the Pyro Hypostasis will generate Fire Seeds in an attempt to re-ignite.
attacks: 3-Hit Combo

Arranges itself as a molten bull that charges at the player before periodically surfacing above ground, then turns into a giant crab that leaps into the player's general location, lastly emerges at the player's general location and explodes, dealing 100%…
Fire Ball

Forms itself into a giant ball that deals 80% ATK as Pyro DMG upon contact while it is stationary, then starts rolling around the arena and curves at the player's location, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Molten Fist
When near player, it levitates high above ground, and plunges back down, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. This creates an expanding Shockwave that deals 100% ATK as Pyro DMG with each explosion.
Serpentine Fireballs
Arranges itself into a Pyro Serpent that fires 3 waves of fireballs at the player's general location. Each fireball deals 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Nuke

Forms a giant ball that cracks open slowly. After some amount of time, it causes a heavy explosion that deals 250% ATK as Pyro DMG over the whole arena. This attack cannot be dodged using dash i-frames.
Missiles
Flies into the air and forms a rhombus with its shell pieces, firing them quickly from top to bottom, each dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG. The core will be exposed during this attack.
Molten Pillars
Creates a barrier of sorts around itself, targeting random areas and sending a pillar at said locations, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG before recalling them, leaving a patch of fire in said area.
Clap
Flies next to the player and forms a large wall, which folds in a "clapping" motion very quickly, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG in front of the wall.
Tinders
Spins around while taking on the form of a rocket, deploying three Tinders to reignite itself.
Molten Fist
This attack will be used 3 times in a row.
Fire Ball
Leaves behind burning residue along its path that lasts for 8 seconds and deals 15% ATK as Pyro DMG every 0.5 seconds.
Healing Tinders
While in the ignited state, 3 healing Tinders will be present. Each healing Tinder will recover 0.2 Gauge Units (Normal to Fearless) or 1 Gauge Unit (Extreme) every second for the Hypostasis' shield.
Tinders
In Extreme difficulty only, the Hypostasis will spawn 5 Tinders instead of 3 while reviving. Their durability will also be tripled.

lore: A giant vine that has absorbed the ancient flame that rages within the ley lines. It is restless as if filled with endless fury. Poets, bards, and even some academics believe that elements also contain emotions and hopes. If this is true, then one can only wonder what emotions cause the Pyro Regisvine to burn eternally, writhing like one longing to be free of the confines of the earth...
tips: Massive elemental plants that grow deep underground. They use their brightly colored flowers to lure in their prey, attacking anyone that treads too closely. Perhaps the fruit that appears like a Pyro core growing near their roots could be an effective means of dealing damage...
attacks: Faceplant

The Regisvine will slam its face into the ground after locking onto the player's current position, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG on impact and sending tremors through the ground in the direction it faceplants, with each explosion dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Rapid Fire
Using its buds, the Regisvine will fire small fireballs at the player in rapid succession, dealing 20% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Fire Seed

After a short charging period, in which the Regisvine gathers Pyro in its buds/arms, the Regisvine hurls a Blazing Seed at the player, dealing 25% ATK as Pyro DMG. The seed can be destroyed using elemental reactions.
Homing Shots
Raises its buds and shoots out a number of small orbs, then launching them at the player. The orbs travel slowly but will home towards their target, dealing 12.5% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Spin
A circle appears around the Regisvine indicating the radius of the attack.
Half Flail
If the player is behind the Pyro Regisvine, smashes its head on the floor and swings 180 degrees around its roots, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Flail

After recovering from the paralyzed state, smashes its head on the floor, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG, and swings 360 degrees around its roots, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG and knocking players away.
Half Flail Combo

Performs the following twice: Smashes its head on the floor and swings 180 degrees around its roots two times consecutively, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK as Pyro DMG on the head smash and the swing respectively. Then follows with Faceplant.
Eruption
The Pyro Regisvine will point its corolla upwards, along with its buds, and cause Pyro energy to erupt from the ground, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG and launching the player upwards.

lore: A small monster created by the sedimentation of Pyro dispersed throughout nature. Its intelligence is very basic, but its uses are just as broad — well, for hilichurls, that is.
attacks: Ignited State
While in the ignited state, the Pyro Slime will be inflicted with the Pyro status indefinitely. Triggering certain Elemental Reactions on a Pyro Slime will extinguish it.
Bump
Bumps into the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG while ignited or Physical DMG while extinguished.
Final Burst
When defeated in the ignited state, explodes after a short delay, dealing 200% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Reignition
While extinguished, retreats away from the player until it reignites after a period of time.

lore: A monster born from highly-concentrated Pyro elements that can float in the air. There was once an Akademiya student who conducted research into their behavior. He believed that Specters were a form of Crystalfly; since they both had powers of flight and both were birthed in areas saturated with elemental energy. He has not graduated yet.
tips: High elemental concentrations have resulted in the creation of this floating creature. When it takes a single grievous hit, it will build Fury. When a Specter hits maximum Fury, it will expand, becoming larger and stronger, and it will explode violently when defeated.
attacks: Fury
Taking high DMG from a single attack will charge Fury. The higher the DMG dealt, the more Fury will be accumulated.
Fire Dance
Loops around in the air to conjure a fireball which it punts at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Sneaky Spitfire
Disappears and reappears behind the player, then spits a spray of fire at them, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Pursuing Flamethrower
Slowly follows the player while periodically spraying fire at them, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack will only occur at max Fury and will be the only attack it uses in that state.
Final Burst

Explodes after a short pause when defeated, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. If at max Fury, DMG is increased to 120% ATK, and leaves behind a small fireball that explodes after another short pause, dealing 240% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A mimetic plant monster that attacks without warning and uses Pyro to hunt its prey. The world of Teyvat plays host to plants infused with the elements. Having gained a measure of intellect, their "nutritional needs" have also greatly increased...
attacks: Burrow
Sinks into the ground and emerges nearby.
Ambush
If the player interacts with a disguised Pyro Whopperflower, bursts from the ground, dealing 200% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Scorching Leaves
If the player is within melee range, flattens while spinning its petals to deal 33.3% ATK * 3 as Pyro DMG around itself.
Normal Attack: Homing Orbs
Shoots out orbs that home toward the player, each dealing 22% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Charged Attack: Roasted Nectar Burst
Closes its petals, consuming one of the "fruits" orbiting around it and creating a Pyro shield, giving it ~10 seconds to charge up its attack.
Recharge
Once all three "fruits" are consumed, the Whopperflower will plunge into the ground and restore all three, creating a visual AoE but will not deal any DMG.

lore: A Saurian with large, supple wings that can glide through the air for long periods. It is said that the ancestors of the Qucusaurs were the closest in form to the mighty winged dragons, and that they could soar through the sky like clouds. According to the storytellers, when the greatest of such dragons spread its wings, the entire sky would be blotted out. Of course, the Qucusaurs we see today no longer possess such forms, but the claws they hide within their downy feather coats remain as sharp as ever.
attacks: Claw Strike
Attacks with its claws, dealing 50% ATK × 2 as Pyro DMG.
Fireball
Shoots a fireball from its mouth, dealing 90% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Diving Charge
Dives down and charges at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.

lore: A young Qucusaur with a light, agile body. Its neck and wings have yet to fully develop, and it still has a long way to go before it can wield gaseous phlogiston. There are stories of older Qucusaurs pushing younglings off cliffs to encourage them to fly. While the truth of such tales is uncertain, as long as it keeps practicing day and night, there can be no doubt that the soft-feathered fledgling will eventually grow strong and resilient.
attacks: Claw Strike
Attacks with its claws, dealing 50% ATK × 2 as Pyro DMG.
Fireball
Shoots a fireball from its mouth, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A powerful warrior from the clifftops, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. Among the many varieties of Saurians, the Qucusaurs stand particularly proud, and this is a trait that is shared by the Qucusaurus Warriors who are able to obtain their recognition. It is said that in the past, tribal warriors would watch these crimson Saurians amuse themselves by tossing flaming stones from great heights; and that it was this that first inspired them to set off projectiles to cause explosive chain reactions. This concept, gradually refined over time, is said to have been the origin of many of the Flower-Feather Clan's firearms.
attacks: Melee Combo
Strikes up to twice with her slingshot, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Ignition Burst
Fires a single fireball, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG. The fireball then splits into 3 small fireballs that deal 50% ATK as Pyro DMG each.
Fireball Sling
Mounts her slingshot and fires up to 6 projectiles in succession, each dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack will end early if the player approaches her.
Blazing Sky
Fires a single large fireball, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A powerful warrior from the clifftops, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. Even in Natlan, the Nation of Pyro, members of the Flower-Feather Clan have a unique approach when it comes to wielding fire and flames. For these tribal warriors, armed as they are with heavy hammers, flames are something that burst forth from violent collisions, symbols of intense passion. When they do battle, the fight usually ends within an instant— and they are always the ones who stand victorious.
attacks: Melee Combo
Swings his hammer up to 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% + 10% ATK as Physical DMG. The combo may sometimes be cut short to immediately follow with Explosive Strike or Heartstar Hammer.
Explosive Strike
Performs an overhead smash, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG and causing an explosion in the impacted area, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. The Qucusaurus Warrior uses the force of the blast to leap back.
Heartstar Hammer
Performs a leaping hammer strike, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Melee Combo

Swings his hammer up to 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% + 10% ATK as Physical DMG. The combo may sometimes be cut short to immediately follow with Explosive Strike, and the 3rd part of the combo may be used on its own.
Explosive Strike
Performs an overhead smash, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG and causing an explosion in the impacted area, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. The Local Legend uses the force of the blast to leap back.
Heartstar Hammer

Performs a leaping hammer strike, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. If a Molten Barb is present, the Local Legend will aim the strike at the Molten Barb, causing it to explode and deal 200% ATK as Pyro DMG over a large area.

lore: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power. Strange lightning once fell upon the land blessed by moonlight, causing once ordinary antelopes to gain the power to wield lightning. They say that some have seen a truly strange sight — antelopes standing on cliffs at the convergence of a storm, attracting bolts of lightning to temper their bodies.
tips: A monster that has undergone a unique evolution due to being drenched in the ancient moon's power for long periods of time. Radiant beasts can wield their innate powers to capture their enemies in a Radiant Cocoon... Once captured, both the amount of DMG taken and the strength of healing received will be affected. However, you can escape from a Radiant Cocoon by being healed to your Max HP, granting you the Disentangled effect which boosts your abilities for a short period of time. Use this opportunity to attack...
attacks: Heavy Swipe
Swipes at the player with its antlers, dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG before retreating backwards.
Combo Attack
Swipes with its antlers and then kicks the player with its hind legs, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK as Electro DMG.
Charge
Charges at the player with its antlers down, dealing 20% ATK as Electro DMG upon contact. If it makes contact with a player, it will perform an upward slash, dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Radiant Cocoon
Releases a kuuvahki energy blast around itself, dealing no DMG but causing all party members to lose HP equal 18% Max HP + 1000 and enveloping them in a Radiant Cocoon.

lore: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power. It is said that in the ancient past, when these borderlands were still shrouded by the pitch-dark shadow, only the charging of the giant rhinos could return the power that makes all things turn... And this was all that was asked of them in return for the moonlight shining down its blessings.
tips: A monster that has undergone a unique evolution due to being drenched in the ancient moon's power for long periods of time. Radiant beasts can wield their innate powers to capture their enemies in a Radiant Cocoon... Once captured, both the amount of DMG taken and the strength of healing received will be affected. However, you can escape from a Radiant Cocoon by being healed to your Max HP, granting you the Disentangled effect which boosts your abilities for a short period of time. Use this opportunity to attack...
attacks: Cleave
Performs an upward cleave with its horn, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG. Often followed up by Stomp.
Stomp
Stomps the ground with its two front legs, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Charge
Charges at the player and performs up to two horn attacks, dealing 60% ATK, 80% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Radiant Cocoon
Releases a kuuvahki energy blast around itself, dealing no DMG but causing all party members to lose HP equal 18% Max HP + 1000 and enveloping them in a Radiant Cocoon.

lore: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power. Legend has it that when a dark calamity wiped out countless lives, the frontier forests fell completely silent. In that stillness, the only sound to break the dead quiet was the howl of the Glacial Wolves calling to the moon. Night after night, their mournful cries echoed across the empty wilderness in the cold moonlight.
tips: A monster that has undergone a unique evolution due to being drenched in the ancient moon's power for long periods of time. Radiant beasts can wield their innate powers to capture their enemies in a Radiant Cocoon... Once captured, both the amount of DMG taken and the strength of healing received will be affected. However, you can escape from a Radiant Cocoon by being healed to your Max HP, granting you the Disentangled effect which boosts your abilities for a short period of time. Use this opportunity to attack...
attacks: Melee Combo
Swipes at the player with its claw, then performs two forward bite attacks, dealing 50% ATK, 40% ATK, 70% ATK as Cryo DMG. The swipe and the two bites may be used individually.
Slam
Leaps into the air and slams down at the player's location, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frost Spray
Releases frost from its mouth in an upward spraying motion in front of it, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Radiant Cocoon
Releases a kuuvahki energy blast around itself, dealing no DMG but causing all party members to lose HP equal 18% Max HP + 1000 and enveloping them in a Radiant Cocoon.

lore: A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power. Legend has it that when the waves of calamity rolled over the land, even those animals who dwelled in the Forsaken Sea were not spared. Those who could not accept the moonlight into themselves vanished like foam, whether great sea serpents who could send waves skyward, or single-eyed monsters who once plotted to consume all things.
tips: A monster that has undergone a unique evolution due to being drenched in the ancient moon's power for long periods of time. Radiant beasts can wield their innate powers to capture their enemies in a Radiant Cocoon... Once captured, both the amount of DMG taken and the strength of healing received will be affected. However, you can escape from a Radiant Cocoon by being healed to your Max HP, granting you the Disentangled effect which boosts your abilities for a short period of time. Use this opportunity to attack...
attacks: Clap
Rushes at the player if far. Performs a clapping motion with two of its tentacles, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Double Slap
Slams the ground with one of its tentacles, then swipes at the player with another, dealing 40% ATK, 60% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Charge
Rapidly spins its tentacles while charging at the player, rapidly dealing 20% ATK as Hydro DMG and finishing with a powerful swipe, dealing 90% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Radiant Cocoon
Releases a kuuvahki energy blast around itself, dealing no DMG but causing all party members to lose HP equal 18% Max HP + 1000 and enveloping them in a Radiant Cocoon.

lore: The moon's ancient power has seeped into these illusory wings, and the butterfly-shaped monster now dances lightly in the moonlight. The principles of evolution state that after the wild yet primeval power was tamed by the heavenly ruler, such a monster should not be able to maintain its shape, becoming smaller and weaker over time. However, the moon's blessing has allowed it to glide through this world while remaining in its prime, displaying the remnants of an older world, when the ancient moon once illuminated the land.
tips: The strongest species, even among radiant beasts, whose "Radiant Cocoon" displays still more obvious effects. Quickly heal your HP to its maximum to escape from a Radiant Cocoon. Radiant beasts possess many mysterious characteristics — rumors even circle that they can change their Elemental Type under the right conditions...
attacks: Kick
Kicks the player twice, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Lunging Kick
Lunges at the player before kicking them, dealing 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Dendroblade
Launches a vertical blade at the player with its feet, dealing 90% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Tail Disk
Slashes at the player with its tail, dealing 60% ATK as Dendro DMG before leaping into the air and slinging its tail at the player as a spinning disk that deals 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Radiant Cocoon

Performs either Dendroblade or Tail Disk before unleashing a powerful kuuvahki energy blast around itself, dealing no DMG but causing all nearby players to lose HP equal to 10% Max HP + 1800 and enveloping them in a Radiant Cocoon.
Radiant Shower
While in the Dendro state, swoops around the arena, creating an energy pulse that deals 50% ATK as Dendro DMG across the entire arena.
Radiant Bombs

While in the Pyro state, flaps its wings, creating an energy pulse that deals 50% ATK as Pyro DMG across the entire arena. Afterwards, enters the Dendro state and launches 2-4 bombs at the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Radiant Expulsion

After using 2 attack combos under Iridescent Radiance, gathers a large amount of elemental energy matching its current state before causing a massive explosion that deals 100% ATK as Dendro DMG or Pyro DMG across the entire arena.

lore: An ancient monster drawn to moonlight, this gecko dwells deep within layers of rock. The gradual accumulation of kuuvahki has crystallized its body into segments as precise as mechanical components. These parts can harden and form stone spikes used to repel intruders. Some scholars believe this unusual lizard's ancestors once roamed the surface. Over the ages, sweeping changes in the world drove them underground, where they have since lived in darkness for countless generations. Though their memory of true moonlight has faded, instinct remains. On nights of the full moon, they are compelled to gnaw on rock and soil suffused with lunar radiance to preserve their bloodline.
tips: A highly unique species among Radiant creatures, it can trap its enemies in a Radiant Cocoon during combat. Quickly heal your HP to its maximum to escape from a Radiant Cocoon. Doing so will also reduce its Geo RES. When it prepares to unleash Voidstep Reverberation, destroy the Moonstone Anchor it leaves behind to terminate the preparation of this Skill and deal massive DMG to it.
attacks: Radiant Cocoon

Upon starting the fight or after Voidstep Reverberation (regardless of whether it was interrupted or not), roars and unleashes a powerful kuuvahki blast around itself, dealing no DMG but causing all nearby players to lose HP equal to 10% Max HP + 1800 and…
Ranged Blast
Raises its tail above its head and discharge a blast of energy, dealing 75% ATK as Geo DMG.
Head Swipe Combo
Swipes its head twice, then slams the ground with its two feet, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK, then 75% ATK as Geo DMG.
Tail Sweep
Readies its tail before performing a spinning sweep, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Radiant Anchors
Raises its tail, and summons numerous anchors next to it and at the player's location in a small AoE, each dealing 35% ATK as Geo DMG.
Voidstep Reverberation

Returns to the center of the arena, dropping a Moonstone Anchor, creating a massive dome and two additional copies of itself. This dome makes use of a multi-layer Ward divided into nine segments; previous segments cannot be depleted until the current one has.
Voidstep Blast
Pauses briefly before launching a blast of energy from its belly, dealing 75% ATK as Geo DMG. Only used during Voidstep Reverberation.

lore: One of the earliest new-type clockwork meka to be made. It is said that during his time at the Institute of Natural Philosophy, the Lord-Artificer Guillotin created machines that could simulate genuine intelligence. Though he never openly admitted it, this rumor nonetheless spurred on subsequent generations of ambitious engineers. Decades ago, one of them announced that they had created a machine that not only possessed basic thinking abilities but could also read human emotions, but in the end the results went unacknowledged.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Recon Log Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Dash
Dashes at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack can still be used when Arkhe is unavailable.
Time Bomb
Fires a bomb at the player that explodes after a delay, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Shock Trap
Fires a trap mechanism at the player that deals 25% ATK × 6 + 50% ATK as Electro DMG over 3 seconds.

lore: A life-form created from condensed Hydro elements of incredible purity. Often attached to bodies of water. It is said that as water bodies become purer, the Hydro elements within grow more abundant, causing the Oceanids to grow more powerful. It is also said by some that Oceanids were once sea creatures from a home far away who carried the fragments of a long-dead god to the many corners of this world. Perhaps they did this so that the love their god held for this world could be spread through the waters to all the land...
tips: A noble elemental lifeform that dwells within bodies of pure water. In combat, it will expend and condense its life force into Hydro Mimics that attack its enemies. Although they are all aligned with Hydro, different elements that react with Hydro are effective against different Hydro Mimics. Defeat these Mimics rapidly to overcome the Oceanid with ease.
attacks: The Myriad Wilds
Sends out 1 or 2 water orbs which each target a random platform. Upon landing, the orb transforms into a group of Hydro Mimics.
Sinking Platform
After clearing two waves of Hydro Mimics, the Oceanid will select two random tiles in the 3×3 grid, dive upon them, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG and sinking them.
Tide and Torrent

If the Hydro Mimics are not defeated in a certain amount of time, the Oceanid creates a whirlpool below the player that follows them, deals 50% ATK as Hydro DoT, and explodes after a while, dealing 200% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Fin Slash
Slashes at the player with her fins in either a vertical or horizontal motion, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Fin Slam
Slams her fin in front of her, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG. If in second phase, generates a Hydro explosion in front of her, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Tail Slam
Slams her tail down on the ground, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. If in second phase, generates three Hydro explosions in front of her, dealing 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Surging Torrents
Creates whirlpools on random spots on the arena that act as obstacles, limiting the player's movements and consecutively dealing 13.3% ATK as Hydro DMG over time.
Hydro Missiles
Fires 2 (first phase) or 4 (second phase) missiles that home in on the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG. The missiles can be destroyed by a player's attack.
Hydro Bombs
Creates 1-2 orbs of water that chase after the player before exploding in a short time, each dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG. The bombs can be destroyed by a player's attack.
The Myriad Wilds
After reaching 75% of her Max HP, retreats from the battlefield and summons Hydro Mimics to attack the player. Unlike the normal Oceanid fight, only Boars, Ferrets, and Crabs will be summoned.
Surge of Vengeance
Moves to the center of the arena and conjure a large ball of Hydro that she will throw to the ground, dealing 133% ATK as Hydro DMG for 2 times that throughout whole arena.
River-Carving Rapids
Rhodeia targets the player with a lock-on before firing a massive stream of water from her eye, consecutively dealing 33.3% ATK as Hydro DMG. Can be avoided using the Fitful Rapids.
Cleansing Shower

Forms an orb within their mouth and launches it at the player. On hit, the orb deals 5% ATK as Cryo DMG and drains 10 Energy from the active character. If the active character has less than 10 Energy, inflicts HP Loss.
Spinning Sweep
Curls up and quickly spins, dealing 30% ATK * 2 as Cryo DMG.
Homing Shards
Launches three shards from its tail that travel in an arching trajectory, dealing 30% ATK as Cryo DMG. Repeated DMG instances have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Slash Combo
If the player is within melee range, performs 2 horizontal slashes followed by a downward smash, dealing 30% ATK, 50% ATK, 80% ATK respectively as Physical DMG with each hit.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Hardy hilichurls who have congregated in a region where Geo energies are abundant. Their impregnable shields have layers of rocky growths on them.
tips: Protects itself using a shield with Geo attributes (unlike the shields wielded by Wooden Shield Hilichurl Guards). Use heavy attacks such as Geo Elemental Attacks, Claymores, and Overloaded to break the shield.
attacks: Geo Shield

The Rock Shield Hilichurl Guard is equipped with a Geo shield, which blocks incoming DMG from the direction that it is facing. This shield can be damaged by Poise Damage, and is weakest to Blunt Attacks.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Jump and Hit
Charges and swings its club at the player powerfully, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back.
Swing That Club
Performs 3 consecutive swings at the player, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK, 125% ATK with each swing as Physical DMG.

lore: A muscular hilichurl that uses a rock as a shield. Fighting and eating meat are the two most important things to hilichurls, because those are what make them grow stronger. All young hilichurls dream of growing up to become a big and strong mitachurl, because that way they can eat more meat, fight more battles, and wield those (almost) impregnable giant rock shields.
tips: Protects itself using a shield with Geo attributes (unlike the shields wielded by Wooden Shieldwall Mitachurls). Use heavy attacks such as Geo Elemental Attacks, Claymores, and Overloaded to break the shield.
