attacks: Craggy Greatshield
The Rock Shieldwall Mitachurl is equipped with a Geo shield, which blocks incoming DMG from the direction that it is facing. This shield is weakest to Blunt Attacks.
Shield Counterattack
Every time the Mitachurl successfully blocks a player's attack within 5m, there is a chance to trigger a counterattack:
Shield Charge

Charges towards the player with its shield, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players in its path. At the end of the charge, swings its shield at the player, dealing an additional 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charge
When without its shield, charges towards the player character with brute force, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players in its path.
Smack
If the player strays too close, swings it shield or delivers a punch with its fist, dealing 100% ATK or 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Geo Slime Throw
If the player is at a different elevation, digs a Geo Slime out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Geo DMG.

rock_cavernous_wayob_manifestation.special: Envoy of Night and Wandering Spirits
lore: The Children of Echoes believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls. The people of Natlan believe that the Wayob dwell in the kingdom of the Lord of the Night, and have no fixed form, instead attaching themselves to anything in order to provide guidance to lost tribespeople. Wayob manifestations are particularly special, and the figure revealed through the totems often has an important purpose. The Children of Echoes believe that their Wayob has the power to shape mountains and valleys, and can control the echoes created when rock meets stone.
tips: The Wayob worshipped by the various tribes of Natlan manifest themselves in the form of these obsidian totems. In battle, the Wayob Manifestation will deploy its Arena: Moment of Trial, creating a Shield for itself and absorbing the Elemental Energy of all characters in the Arena. Characters in the Arena deal greatly increased DMG. If the Shield is broken before the Arena expires, they will also regain a large amount of Energy. However, if they fail to break the Shield, the Manifestation will generate an Elemental Ward based on the value of the remaining Shield.
attacks: Crag Strike
Summons jagged rocks that erupt out of the ground, first in a X-shaped pattern, then in a rectangular area towards the player, dealing 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Geo DMG.
Rotor Spin
Performs a spinning attack, dealing 20% ATK × 3 as Physical DMG.
Shattering Box
Marks a rectangular area, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG after a delay.
Arena: Moment of Trial
Deploys an Arena and gains a non-elemental shield equal to 111.4% of the Wayob Manifestation's Max HP which can be destroyed by dealing DMG.
Parry Challenge
During this challenge, the player can only use the Traveler. The Traveler's Elemental Skill is replaced with Parry, and their Elemental Burst is replaced with Honed Techniques.
Rapid Fire

Fires 11 rock projectiles in a row, each dealing 40% ATK as Geo DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence. If parried, the projectiles will be sent back at the Wayob Manifestation, dealing Geo DMG to it.

lore: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold." They do display certain biological behaviors similar to those of real wolves. Perhaps they feel jealousy towards these their "next of kin," and dream of replacing them someday.
tips: This is the mature form of a Rifthound Whelp... or so it would seem. However, these monsters do not have natural life cycles, and their growth remains a mystery. The Rifthound attacks can apply stacks of the "Corrosion" status, which will cause all characters in the party to continually lose HP. Additionally, when they take elemental damage from their respective element, Rifthounds will enter an Elemental Devourer state that will allow them to fight more fiercely at the cost of lessened RES to that particular element.
attacks: Corrosion
All of the Rockfond Rifthound's attacks apply Corrosion on hit.
Devouring Bite
Backs away and readies itself to lunge at the player and bite, dealing 90% ATK as Geo DMG.
Corrosive Claws
Swipes at the player twice with its claws, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG with each swipe.
Crystal Cracker
If the player is far away, the Rifthound generates a rock in its mouth before launching it towards the player, dealing 95% ATK Geo DMG.
Tail Swipe
Teleports behind the player and swipes with its tail, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Elemental Devourer
Gains 20% Fury whenever it takes Geo DMG. When full, the Rifthound gains enhanced attacks at the cost of lower RES]].
Pursuer's Mark
Quickly lunges at the player 2–4 times, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack is only performed while the Rifthound is in the Elemental Devour state.
Roar
When there are Rifthound Whelps nearby, roars to increase the Rifthound Whelps' ATK by 25% for 10 seconds.

lore: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. "Gold" classified them as "Alfisol." They follow the encroaching abyss to devour the elements. Fortunately, there are few of them left now in this world.
tips: A monster from another world that has the power to corrode material. The Rifthound Whelp's attacks can apply stacks of the "Corrosion" status, which will cause all characters in the party to continually lose HP. Additionally, when they take elemental damage from their respective element, Rifthound Whelps will enter an Elemental Devourer state that will allow them to fight more fiercely at the cost of lessened RES to that particular element.
attacks: Corrosion
All of the Rockfond Rifthound Whelp's attacks apply Corrosion on hit.
Bite
Lunges at the player and bites, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG.
Slash
Teleports to the player and slashes with its claw, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Double Slash
At melee range, quickly slashes twice at the player, dealing 65% ATK as Geo DMG with each slash.
Elemental Devourer
Gains 34% Fury whenever it takes Geo DMG. When full, the Rifthound Whelp decreases its attack cooldowns and its RES]].

lore: A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds. With only fragmentary sentience and no ability to speak, Leshies may appear to be the result of the Golden Realm's early experiments. Yet according to records, the truth is the opposite. Only after its artisans had almost fully mastered the authority over life did they create this race of fae. Perhaps there is some true purpose within this that neither the fae nor humans of the present can fully understand.
tips: One of the fae peoples of Snezhnaya. The exceptionally resilient ancient Leshy can root themselves into recovery and enhancement. However, when they are rooted, their hearts will be exposed.Attack the Leshy's heart to disrupt its rooting. Additionally, when the Leshy's rooting is disrupted, any Pyro affecting it will also deal a small amount of damage. When affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction while it's rooted, the Leshy's heart will become more exposed and easier to attack.

lore: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals. Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their forms have greater value in the study of biomimesis. The inspiration for its decentralized design and combat modes seems to have come from honeybee colonies, rendering it able to change forms and to attack from different directions.
attacks: Tri-Shot Blast
The three orbitals each charge an orb that is then shot from the main head, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. The core is exposed during this attack.
Stinger Shot
Using the three orbitals as a scope, the main head fires a long and slender stinger that deals 70% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. While charging, it will protect its core.
Orb Lay
By withdrawing its three orbitals and diverting all power to the head, it pushes itself back while also laying an energized orb. This attack is performed when the player is close to the Ruin Cruiser.
Stinger Bombardment
Mimicking the shape of a flower, the Ruin Cruiser fires multiple stingers into the air before they all bombard the area in front of it four times, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG over a large area.
Deactivated
When the weak spot of the main head is hit twice while it is exposed, the Ruin Cruiser deactivates for a short time where it does not attack back.

lore: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals. Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. The insect-like limbs are more agile than those of humanoid machines. The shield formed by its various components can resist any frontal attack.
attacks: Pincer Stab
Raising itself on its hind legs, the Defender stabs with its two front legs, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. Its core is protected during this attack.
Armored Carapace Array

Projects a shield from its front legs that blocks all damage that comes from the front and cannot be broken by any means. Right before the shield is projected, its core will be exposed, though it will be protected for the rest of the attack's duration.
Leap
Leaping high in the air, the Defender then lands on its target, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG around where it lands. During this whole attack, its core is protected.
Cannon Shot
The Defender charges up energy at its core before firing it, dealing 26.6% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. Its core is exposed during this attack.
Deactivated
After hitting its exposed core twice the Defender slumps down and becomes deactivated for a short time. During this time it will not attack.

lore: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals. Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. The giant crown, composed of several parts, looks like some sort of frightening plant. One wonders what one has to go through in order to design such scary machine.
attacks: Flail
Opening its head, the Destroyer spins its whole head on the ground and flails it across, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG to anything that it hits. Its core is protected during this attack.
Energy Field
Firing a charged beam of pure energy at the ground, the Destroyer creates a large energy field centered on its target that deals 40% ATK as Physical DoT. Its core is exposed during this attack.
Mimicry of the Regisvine
Burrowing into the ground and planting its roots, the core gathers energy and creates a Vacuum Field that sucks the player in while dealing 50% ATK as Physical DoT.
Seed Shot
Using its core, it fires up to 6 small energy orbs, each dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG. Its core is protected during this attack.
Burrow
Digs into the ground before reemerging close to its target. It cannot be damaged when it is burrowing.
Deactivated
After hitting its weak point twice, it goes limp as it is now deactivated. During this short time, it will not attack back.

lore: A horrifying dragon-shaped machine. It is said to be a war machine left behind by a now-destroyed nation. It mimics the appearance of the beings known as Vishaps, with some functional enhancements. Such machines have an even greater ability to "absorb" — or perhaps the right word is "counteract" — elemental powers than the vishaps. From this ability, one can glimpse the scale of the ambition that the civilization that made these machines must have once held...
tips: A ruin machine that can absorb energy and hurl it back as an attack. The Ruin Drake: Earthguard can periodically release a dangerous torrent of energy and increase its own Elemental RES against the previous main type of Elemental DMG it suffered. When it is preparing to unleash this energy torrent or when it is preparing for a special sprint attack, the core on its head will be exposed... Take this opportunity to attack the core, and you may be able to immobilize this creature and undo its Elemental RES boost...
attacks: Close Expulsion
Swings its tail around 360 degrees, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Sudden Charge
If the player is far away, charges at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. If it successfully hits a player, follows up with Close Expulsion.
Melee
Attacks twice with its nose, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG with each attack.
Energy Surge
Charges before scattering a great number of bombs into the air, dealing 100% ATK when they land as Physical DMG or Elemental DMG matching the Ruin Drake's currently absorbed element.
Stomp
When the player is close to the Ruin Drake, stomps with its feet, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Leap
When the player is far from the Ruin Drake, leaps towards the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A horrifying dragon-shaped machine. It is said to be a war machine left behind by a now-destroyed nation. It mimics the appearance of the beings known as Vishaps, with some functional enhancements. Such machines have an even greater ability to "absorb" — or perhaps the right word is "counteract" — elemental powers than the vishaps. How, you wonder, did a civilization that could make such frightening machines of war collapse?
tips: A ruin machine that can absorb energy and hurl it back as an attack. The Ruin Drake: Skywatch can periodically release a dangerous torrent of energy and increase its own Elemental RES against the previous main type of Elemental DMG it suffered. Under various circumstances, the cores all over its body will be exposed. Take this opportunity to attack those cores, and you may be able to immobilize this creature and undo its Elemental RES boost...
attacks: Machine Gun Volley
Fires off a volley in front of it, dealing 60% ATK with each shot as Physical DMG.
Missile Barrage
Locks onto the player and fires a barrage of missiles, each dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Tail Slice
If the player stays too close, performs a vertical spin and slices the ground below with its tail, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Energy Surge
Charges before scattering a great number of bombs into the air, dealing 100% ATK when they land as Physical DMG or Elemental DMG matching the Ruin Drake's currently absorbed element.
Paralysis
During Energy Surge and Missile Barrage, weak spots on the Ruin Drake's head and chest respectively will be exposed. Two additional weak spots on both wings are also exposed at all times.

lore: An ancient humanoid war machine. Their form is similar to that of Ruin Guards, but is more distorted and more powerful. Energy cores have been installed in both its legs, as though to power its overly heavy form.
tips: While performing certain attacks, the Ruin Grader will expose the cores on its head and feet. If you can take advantage of that and promptly attack its cores, defeating it should be much easier.
attacks: Clap

Performs a clapping motion dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to nearby players, then fires a laser beam in front of it at a fixed angle which deals 80% ATK as Physical DMG. The core in its head is exposed for as long as it fires the beam.
Stomp
Stomps one of their feet, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG to close by players. This is then followed up with a shockwave from the same foot, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG in a larger area.
Spin

Spins the upper half of its body and marches towards the player, rapidly dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG over a period of time. The cores in both feet are briefly exposed right before and after the attack.
Charge

If the player stays too far, the Ruin Grader will charge in one direction towards the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. At the end of the charge, performs a shoulder ram to deal 40% ATK as Physical DMG in a slightly larger AoE.
Focused Laser

Fires a laser beam directly at the current character, rapidly dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG. It will adjust the firing angle if its current target moves and will preemptively cancel the attack if the target is outside of its firing arc.
Ruin Mines

Fires three orbs which will try to land in a triangle formation around the player. These orbs stay on the ground for about 9 seconds and deal 16% ATK as Physical DMG on contact. This exposes the core in its head for the duration of this attack.
Brush-Off
Extends both arms out toward the ground and energizes its laser beam, quickly spinning and firing its beam in a moderate AoE around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Paralyzed
When performing certain attacks, some of its weak points will be exposed at its legs or its eye. Attacking exposed weak points will interrupt the Ruin Grader's current attack.

lore: An ancient humanoid war machine. Legend has it that these machines were combat automatons created by a long-destroyed nation. They now wander ruins and ancient detritus, attacking offending travelers. Research indicates that the Ruin Guards and the ruins they operate in do not originate from the same source, suggesting that there may be a difference of as much as several thousand years between them on the timeline. So why then do the Ruin Guards continue staying among these ruins, using their "explosive firepower" to protect the crumbling walls and broken tiles?
tips: The key weak spots are where the core is exposed on the head and the back. Try to hit one of them.
attacks: Paralyzed
Striking the Ruin Guard's exposed weak point twice with attacks that deal more than 80 poise damage will stun the Ruin Guard, leaving it vulnerable for a long period of time.
Stomp and Clap

Raises one of its feet and stomps the ground, dealing 62.5% ATK as Physical DMG. If a player is still within melee range after the stomp, the Ruin Guard may lean down and clap powerfully using its hands, dealing 87.5% ATK as Physical DMG in front of itself.
Punch and Jump Combo

Bringing both fists together before performing, it will do spinning punches twice, dealing 50% ATK and 75% ATK as Physical DMG, before jumping into the air and landing onto the player's location (telegraphed by a red circle) and dealing 100% ATK as…
Spiral Close-In

Begins to spin its upper body and further extend their arms' reach. While spinning, it will slowly march towards the player. This attack lasts for ~7 seconds and rapidly deals 75% ATK as Physical DMG to players caught in the attack.
Suppressive Volley

Players outside of the Ruin Guard's melee range will force the Ruin Guard to quickly swivel their upper body around 180° and become stationary, exposing their core on the back with missile cannons towards the player.

lore: A giant alien-looking war machine. They are said to be remnants from a lost ancient nation. It seems that the creators opted to forgo the low-performing humanoid-design in pursuit of improved combat effectiveness. They are extremely dangerous both in melee and ranged combat. Considering these mere relics possess such extraordinary power, one cannot help but wonder what the civilization that produced them must have looked like at its height.
tips: A formidable mechanical being found in the ruins. When suspended in mid-air, it is highly dangerous — but also exposes the core on its head.
attacks: Blade Slash
Transforms its two left arms into blades and raises them up, then quickly slashes once in front of it with both arms, dealing 15% ATK and 25% ATK as Physical DMG.
Slash Combo

Brandishes its forearms before attacking twice, followed by a spinning slash, ended by one final cross-slash, dealing 15% ATK, 15% ATK, 10% ATK * 2, 20% ATK respectively as Physical DMG with each hit.
Drill Thrust

If the player roams too far, the Ruin Hunter will transform its two right arms into lances and charge for a long while. After 2 seconds, it will instantly charge towards the player, covering a massive distance in the process, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Airborne State

If the player runs too far, is at a different elevation, or after 3 minutes have passed since entering combat, the Ruin Hunter may occasionally enter an airborne state by detaching its limbs which then serve as its propulsion, pushing all nearby players…
Bombardment

All thrusters point skyward and fire a barrage of 8 missiles into the air which shortly after, strike the ground randomly in a grid-like fashion. These missiles each deals 50% ATK as AoE Physical DMG.
Rapid Fire

If the player roams too far, the Ruins Hunter will fire 4 quick volleys of bullets toward its target, each dealing 10% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack can only be performed while the Hunter is airborne.
Focused Beam

If the player roams too far, the Ruins Hunter will shoot multiple homing missiles that each deals 5% ATK as Physical DMG on hit, then charges up for a few seconds to unleash a focused beam attack, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Quad Lasers
All four thrusters face downward and quickly spin before unleashing four simultaneous laser blasts, directly below itself, dealing 50% ATK as AoE Physical DMG.

lore: Various bizarrely-shaped machines that have taken different forms and functions to adapt to different goals. Legend has it that they are war machines left behind by a nation that has already been destroyed. Compared to the more common Ruin Guards, their design has greater value in the study of biomimesis. Exactly why the form and movements of certain deep-sea lifeforms are being imitated is not known. But either way, tangling with them is hardly the best idea.
attacks: Headbutt
Turning its body on the side, it charges up a lunge to headbutt its target, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. Its core is exposed while charging but is protected while it lunges.
Tentacle Spin
The Scout spins its 4 tentacles dealing 30.7% ATK as Physical DMG. Core is protected.
Orb Lay
The Scout quickly charges an energized orb and sets it right below itself. The orb deals 38.4% ATK as Physical DMG to players that come in contact.
Discharge
Planting itself, the Scout charges up before discharging energy around itself, dealing 76.9% ATK as Physical DMG. Its core is protected during this attack.
Deactivated
After having its core hit twice while exposed, it will fall to the ground and deactivate. During this short time the Scout will not attack.

lore: An ancient, bizarrely-shaped autonomous machine. It is said that this was heavy-duty engineering equipment left behind by a nation that has been destroyed. The gear system on its "head" can grind its way through even the hardest bedrock. If this was the case, then carving out tunnels with which the forces of this nation might access the whole continent would have been a thing of great ease.
tips: A bizarrely-shaped Ruin Machine. It will create Oozing Concretions in battle and will attempt to draw power from them under certain circumstances, which will allow it to unleash devastating attacks.

Use the Blooming Light from your Lumenstone Adjuvant to destroy the Oozing Concretions feeding power to the Ruin Serpent to knock it out of this state and cause the energy cores on its body to cease functioning. Once 4 such cores malfunction, the Ruin Serpent will enter a weakened state.
attacks: Energy Drain
At the start of the fight, if the player's Lumenstone Adjuvant is equipped, its stored energy will be reduced to 2.
Oozing Concretions

Burrows into the ground before resurfacing, creating 4 sources of Oozing Concretions at the corners of the arena. Oozing Concretions can be destroyed using the Blooming Light released by the player's Lumenstone Adjuvant.
Steamroll
Rolls its body on the ground in an arc, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG on contact. This attack cannot be evaded with dash i-frames.
Charge and Drill

Charges towards the player and burrows, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG on contact. It then resurfaces and plants its drill into the ground, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG. The charge cannot be evaded with dash i-frames.
Sand Tomb
Burrows and resurfaces, creating a large Vacuum Field that sucks players towards the center while dealing 10% ATK as Physical DoT.
Bomb Barrage

Charges by drawing power from the Oozing Concretions, before shooting a barrage of projectiles at the player, each dealing 40% ATK if two sources were absorbed or 30% ATK if a single source was absorbed as Physical DMG on hit.
Shockwave

Charges by drawing power from the Oozing Concretions, before releasing a massive blast downwards, dealing 200% ATK if two sources were absorbed or 100% ATK if a single source was absorbed as Physical DMG. Gains 300% RES to all DMG while charging.
Paralyzed
During Bomb Barrage and Shockwave, the Ruin Serpent will expose 4 weak points in the form of its glowing segments. A segment will be broken once hit, indicated by smoke and electric spark effects.

lore: A manufacturing machine from the ancient ruins. This type of machine, which can transform into numerous shapes, was used by the masters of the ancient ruins to perform various manufacturing tasks. As long as you learn how to use such a machine, you could build a city colossal beyond imagination, even within extreme environments like the depths of a volcano. In addition, it also seems to be able to be used as a weapon. Though the ancient civilization has long since fallen, this machine, shaped like a giant claw and powered by the golden designs engraved on it, can still engage in battle based upon its preset instructions.
tips: A machine with terrifying destructive capabilities. When characters enter and maintain the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device will start progressing through its Adaptive Countermeasures. Once those are complete, the Configuration Device will start preparing its Boltsphere Cannon. During this time, the Configuration Device will start up its Accretion Mechanism to dig into Solid Phlogiston and collect phlogiston. The Accretion Mechanism will generate an energy field. If you wish to destroy the Mechanism and interrupt the charging of the Boltsphere Cannon, you must first climb the Solid Phlogiston and enter the energy field.
attacks: Adaptive Countermeasures
When characters enter and maintain the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Configuration Device accumulates 15 points of Adaptive Countermeasures.
Triple Airstrike
Fires 3 energy beams into the sky in succession, which strike down at the player's location, each dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Laser Sweep
Activates 2 emitters that rotate while continuously firing laser beams. The laser beams deal 30% ATK as Electro DMG to targets that come in contact.
Tracking Beam
Fires a contiuous laser beam that follows the player, rapidly dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Dragonclaw
Transforms its parts into a claw and strikes down at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG.
Claw and Barrage

Transforms its parts into a claw and performs a sideways swipe, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG, then fires a barrage of bullets at the player, each dealing 30% ATK as Electro DMG. Repeated bullet hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Boltsphere Cannon
When the Adaptive Countermeasures gauge is full or after enough time has passed, the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device will begin charging its Boltsphere Cannon.

lore: An ancient ruin automaton used in object collection. Legend has it that these ancient ruin machines were designed for specialized work functions, primarily conducting experimental work such as capturing and collecting samples, and had only basic combat functionality. According to rumor, these were not built by humans, but are instead creations of a yet more ancient civilization. Today, that civilization has been lost, and all that remains are these strange machines that roam the land.
tips: An ancient mechanical creation that wanders Natlan to this day, though its function is not known. When characters enter and maintain the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker will start progressing through its Adaptive Countermeasures. Once those are complete, the Hunter-Seeker will unleash its special cluster laser. Still, risk and opportunity go hand-in-hand, so perhaps you might take this opportunity to deal immense damage to it...
attacks: Spike Ram
Sends forth a repulsion device, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Skyfire Descent

Shoots a beam of energy into the sky, which descends at the player's location, repeatedly dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG per 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times. If the player stands near the center of the beam, they will take 2 hits at each interval, for up to 10 hits.
Scorch Ray
Fires a fiery beam at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack is always used 3 times consecutively.
Heatclamp Chase
If the player is far away, dashes towards the player and clamps with two parts of its body, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Adaptive Countermeasures
When characters enter and maintain the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Hunter-Seeker accumulates 15 points of Adaptive Countermeasures.

lore: A domination mechanism from the ancient ruins. In ancient times, to oversee the operation of their mega-cities, a mighty race vested part of their power into a form of phlogiston-engineered intelligence. Driven by their mission, and by means of various other mechanisms, the machines upon which it was bestowed once controlled the functioning of myriad cities across the land. Now, long after their ancient civilization's fall through wars with an emerging race, these once-wise contraptions retain only the most basic of commands.
tips: A civilization whose magnificence once marked distant eons built this overseer device to control multiple Secret Source machines. After it enters Sweeper Mode, it will start attacking while generating Flow Momentum. The higher its Flow Momentum, the greater the DMG it will inflict. During this time, you might be able to obstruct the buildup of Flow Momentum by using consecutive Cryo attacks... It is said that after characters enter and maintain the Nightsoul's Blessing state for some time when fighting against it, the Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device will enter a special "Counterstrike Mode" and change its offensive strategy...
attacks: Waterblade Combo
Performs up to 3 attacks: 2 slashes with individual water blades and a cross-slash with two water blades, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 75% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Vortex
Creates a vortex that pulls in players and deals 30% ATK as Hydro DMG continuously. The vortex eventually explodes, dealing 90% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Charge
Extends its wings and charges at the player up to 3 times, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Trap and Bomb
Marks an area around the player, forming a cage after a short delay. Fires a large water orb that lands within the cage, dealing 85% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Sweeper Mode
Moves to the center of the arena, begins firing 2 water beams which deal Hydro DMG upon contact, and gains 32 points of Flow Momentum. Flow Momentum can reach a maximum of 135 points.
Counterstrike Mode

During Sweeper Mode, in addition to Flow Momentum, the Automaton will also accumulate Adaptive Countermeasures, its progress indicated by parts of its body glowing in white. Adaptive Countermeasures has a maximum of 180.

setekh_wenut.special: The Last Prince of the Sands
lore: An eyeless predator that dwells within the depths of the desert and uses sound and vibrations to seek out its prey. Legend has it that in the ancient past before even the concept of time was created, these creatures thrived with their progenitors and offspring in a land of verdant grass and colossal trees, traversing through slick soil like fishes diving through the wet. With the passage of eons, the gifts of heaven have long reduced the soils to sand, rendering a great many creatures extinct. This branch of their genus was able to survive by adapting more toward earth-based living, and became known as the "Wenut." Some desert folk still mistakenly believe that Wenut is the final point of a quicksand eel's life cycle, likely due to superficial similarities between the species' behaviors.
tips: An apex predator deep in the desert that can use the power of Anemo to a certain extent, which allows it to leave the ground when in combat and enter a floating state. While floating, it can fire Windbite Bullets. If these bullets are not destroyed in time, they will be converted into a high-density curtain of such bullets. Attacks from elements that may react with Anemo can destroy Windbite Bullets, which will temporarily decrease the corresponding Elemental RES of the Setekh Wenut. After 2 Windbite Bullets are destroyed in succession, the Setekh Wenut will be brought down from its floating state.
attacks: Sweep
Sweeps the ground in front of it with its body, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Spit
Shoots 3 projectiles at the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Transition to Phase 2
Digs out of the ground, travels an arcing trajectory midair and reenters the ground, exposing itself to attacks, signifying the transition to Phase 2.
Thrust
Drills out of the ground from below the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stream of Gales
Surfaces at the center of the arena and fires countless projectiles in all directions, each dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Stormbreath
Sweeps the arena with a massive surge of Anemo energy, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Pressurized Beam
Fires a beam of Anemo energy that deals 100% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Dig
Digs out of the ground and back in, exposing itself to attacks.
Floating State

Suspends itself midair and conjures 6 Windbite Bullets. After some time, absorbs all Windbite Bullets and fires 3 rounds of projectiles each covering expanding circular areas of the arena. Each projectile deals 100% ATK as Anemo DMG upon landing.

lore: A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it is now nothing but a husk that only bears memories of battle. All shall decay in the end, and this is all that is left of the Black Serpent Knights amidst the merciless march of their sins, curses, and time itself.
tips: An enigmatic, pitch-black archer. It will switch weapons for a certain amount of time, deploying a shield that blocks DMG if its attacks hit characters defended by shields. It will gain an ATK increase during this period at the cost of its HP. The ATK increase that Shadowy Husk: Defender gains in this way can be stacked multiple times.
attacks: Reinforce

If one of the Shadowy Husk: Defender's attacks is fully absorbed by a player's Shield (does not count if the shield breaks as a result of the attack), their bow will reinforce itself with a guard shield that blocks attacks from the front and increases its…
Chilling Bolt
Sets its bow on the ground and aims at the player before shooting an icy arrow that deals 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Frozen Airstrike
Shoots an attack towards the air which then lands on the player dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it no longer has any "intelligence" that it may still be called "human." Yet the desire to destroy the foe and plunge into battle to defend others is etched into this empty suit of armor, even if no one remains to tell it where the enemy is or who or what exactly must be defended.
tips: An enigmatic, pitch-black lancer. Its attacks will release healing waves that will continuously heal HP for itself, nearby Shadowy Husks, and Black Serpent Knights at the cost of its HP if they hit characters defended by shields. This HP recovery effect can be stacked multiple times.
attacks: Heal Aura

If one of the Shadowy Husk: Line Breaker's attacks is fully absorbed by a player's Shield (does not count if the shield breaks as a result of the attack), they will sacrifice 15% of their Current HP and generate healing energy that heals themselves and…
Stab
Generates water on its lance and stabs forward, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Impaling Torrent
Generates water on its lance and charges ahead, dealing 60% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit. At the end of the charge, performs a powerful stab, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Tidal Sweep
Generates water on its lance and swings it around itself, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: A pitch-dark soldier. Once a proud warrior of an ancient underground nation, it has now lost any awareness of memory. But even so, it holds the banner of the royal house aloft into battle. Though it has forgotten its comrades or any royal blessing they might have been given, it will never lay this banner down.
tips: An enigmatic, pitch-black standard-bearer. Its attacks will create Wards for itself, nearby Shadowy Husks, and Black Serpent Knights at the cost of its HP after they hit characters defended by Shields.
attacks: Shield Generation

If one of the Shadowy Husk: Standard Bearer's attacks is fully absorbed by a player's Shield (does not count if the shield breaks as a result of the attack), they will generate a Pyro shield on itself and nearby husks at the cost of 15% of its Current HP.
Fireball
Generates a flaming banner on its spear and draws energy from it to shoot a fireball at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Banner Sweep
Generates a flaming banner on its spear and swings it around itself, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A strange life form that mostly appears in Elynas. Receives a powerful shock from encountering ousia or pneuma energy, and thus Breacher Primuses can be driven away using this relatively nonaggressive and noninvasive means.
tips: A strange life form that shares nothing in common with any other land-dwelling creature. In battle, it will enter a stressed state and unleash a fierce Stonefall attack while under the protection of a Geo Ward. If the Ward is broken during this period, it will cause the life form to fall into a paralyzed state. Aside from the usual methods of using Elemental Reactions, attacks imbued with ousia or pneuma can also efficiently pierce the defenses of the Breacher Primus.
attacks: Single Shot
Fires a projectile at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Melee Attack
Performs a melee attack at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stressed State

Periodically enters a stressed state, during which it will gain a Geo shield and unleashes Stonefalls, repeatedly smashing down and causing quakes that deal 100% ATK as Geo DMG. The shield is weakest to Blunt Attacks.

lore: These elegant and proud mystical beasts only live in mountains shrouded in adeptal energy. Since ancient times, they have been considered a symbol of good fortune, and their preference for living aloof from the material world has been admired by intellectuals for generations. In ancient legends from Chenyu Vale, the leader of the suanni was called the Mountain Lord and was considered to be of the same standing as the adepti. Another theory claims that the Xuanwen Beasts that roam the mountains these days are the descendants of the suanni, but that the thinning of their blood over the years has caused them to devolve into violent creatures. Although this contradicts another theory regarding the origin of Xuanwen Beasts, the few records of the suanni often show them attended by a large number of Xuanwen Beasts. These days, the well-known Wushou Dance in Chenyu Vale came from the movements of the suanni. But since only a handful of people have actually seen such creatures, most can only imagine what they look like. After thousands of years of changes and different artistic interpretations, the Wushou Dance costume head has developed into its current style.
tips: An illuminated beast that dwells deep within the mountains that can use Hydro and Anemo simultaneously in battle. Render it Frozen while it is gathering Hydro-aligned adeptal energy, before using Shatter, Melt, or other Elemental Reactions to break the ice and cause it to enter an immobile state. When it is gathering Anemo-aligned adeptal energy, use attacks from Elements that can react with Anemo to destroy the Spiritwind Pearls summoned during the process to achieve the same advantage.
attacks: Circling Winds, Crashing Waves
Levitates then sweeps its tail, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG in a circular area, then plunges down to the ground, creating a cascading wave in front of it, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Slicing Waves
Performs two backflips in succession, launching 2 large water blades that deal 80% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Splash
Forms a vortex at the player's location, then slams its tail to cause a splash within the vortex, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Golden Scalesurge
Swipes its tail to fire a barrage of scales which home towards the player, each dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Stomp
If the player is close, stomps its right foreleg, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Lunge
Imbues itself with Anemo then Hydro, then lunges forward. This does not deal any DMG. During the lunge, the Solitary Suanni can be Frozen using Cryo.
Spirittide Deluge
Imbues itself with Anemo then Hydro while it gathers adeptal energy, gaining a 200% increase to all RES during this period. While charging, the Solitary Suanni can be Frozen using Cryo.
Spiritwind Storm

Spawns 3 Spiritwind Pearls that orbit around the Solitary Suanni while it gathers adeptal energy, gaining a 200% increase to all RES during this period. Spiritwind Pearls are destroyed if hit by Cryo, Electro, Hydro, or Pyro attacks.

lore: A warrior from the Night-Wind, and a tribal guardian that patrols the misty canyons. Only sentries whose strength has been tested are permitted to daub themselves with such body paint, infused as it is with mysterious powers. This also signifies that these warriors have reached a new phase in their mental training.
attacks: Slash
Slashes twice with his claymore, dealing 90% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cleave
Stabs forward with the butt of his claymore and cleaves down, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Infusion
Casts magic to imbue his claymore with Cryo, then performs 3 slashes, dealing 70% ATK, 85% ATK, 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A warrior from the Night-Wind, and a tribal guardian that patrols the misty canyons. To a certain degree, they can draw upon the power of their body paint to wield their weapons with their willpower.
attacks: Slash
Slashes twice with her sword, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab
Lunges forward and stabs once, dealing 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Infusion
Casts magic to imbue her sword with Cryo, then performs 3 slashes, dealing 70% ATK, 85% ATK, 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A warrior from the Night-Wind, and a tribal guardian that patrols the misty canyons. It is said that their body paint is an art that evolved from the practice of Phlogiston Engraving, and that it takes long years of training to fully master the power contained within.
attacks: Slash
Slashes twice with his sword, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab
Lunges forward and stabs once, dealing 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Infusion
Casts magic to imbue his sword with Cryo, then performs 3 slashes, dealing 70% ATK, 85% ATK, 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: A crab that makes its home in borrowed shells. Armored Crabs are constantly searching for shells that fit their bodies as they grow. A storybook that told the tale of the trials of an Armored Crab searching for a suitable shell was extremely popular in Fontaine for a time. Though the story is filled with childlike wonder, the reaction after proved that, like many fairytales, it touched adults even more deeply.
tips: An aquatic life form that has embarked on a unique evolutionary track due to Fontaine's environmental factors. When under the effects of Pyro, it can unleash fiercer elemental attacks and will possess even stronger defensive capabilities. If you use Elemental Reactions to remove its Elemental Ward, things should be easier to handle.
attacks: Spin to Win
Charges at the player while spinning, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Sternshield Protection
The Sternshield Crab possesses a Pyro shield that grants it 60% RES to all DMG and enhanced attacks. The shield can be destroyed using Elemental Reactions.
Melee
Performs a shield bash and a spinning strike, dealing 50% ATK, 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Volcanic Eruption
Fires 3 consecutive fireballs from its shell, each dealing 30% ATK as Pyro DMG. This attack is only used while shielded.
Leaping Crush
Leaps into the air and slams down at the player's location, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG. This attack is only used while shielded.
Spin to Win
Charges at the player while spinning, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Fish Torpedo
Fires an Angler fish that homes towards the player, dealing 10% ATK to shielded characters or 70% ATK to non-shielded characters as Hydro DMG on hit.
Shield
Periodically gains a shield that nullifies all incoming DMG, then launches a Fish Torpedo.
HP Loss
While not shielded, every time the it is hit by the counterattack of the hold version of the Xenochromatic Armored Crab's ability, it will lose 20% of its Max HP.

lore: A mysterious "lord" of hilichurls that walks between a thousand peaks. This huge hilichurl is referred to as a "lawa" by its brethren. The abundant Geo energies in the environment have become part of their flesh, blood, and skin, which look as if they were chiseled out of mountain rock.
attacks: Punches
Roars and performs a punch with its left arm. It occasionally combos with both arms and slams the ground, dealing 50% ATK and 53.3% ATK as Physical DMG.
Infused Stonehide

Generates a Geo shield and enters the Stone Force State for as long as the shield is active. Under this state, it will use more powerful attacks. This shield will degrade over 90 seconds and can be further damaged with Poise Damage.
Dash
The Stonehide Lawachurl quickly charges at its target after a roar, dealing 66.6% ATK as Physical DMG. The charge is slightly faster if the Stonehide Lawachurl is in its Stone Force State.
Shockwave

Roars and slams both hands into the ground, causing 3 trails of explosions, dealing 33.3% ATK as Geo DMG. This attack can be done 1 or 3 times and is only performed when the Stonehide Lawachurl is in the Stone Force State.
Jumping Slam
Roars and jumps into the air, slamming down at the player's position, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Slime Throw
If the player is at a higher elevation or too far away, the Lawachurl will roar and grab a Large Geo Slime from the ground, throwing it at the player to deal 83.3% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: One of The Four Winds of Mondstadt: Dvalin, the Dragon of the East. With the passage of long years and amid boundless darkness, even the purest gem will become dulled by dust, and even the noble dragon might be corrupted and cankered by hatred. But never forget that dust can be wiped away, and the power of doubt and poison can be shattered.

"Fly freely in the sky. "Just like you did in those days when we met, when I walked upon this land and sang the songs of the wind, "And you soared on high, looking down on the world from above. "Today, the sky is no longer swept by wind and snow. The green grass grows all over the earth, and it is beautiful. "If you too could walk the earth and listen to the songs of shepherds and the scattered sound of wind chimes in the distance, if you could have tasted wine as sweet as honey, you would understand. "How wonderful it would have been if you were as I, witnessing your noble, beautiful form as you soared through the blue sky. "Then you would know that this sky and this earth are both things worth fighting for."
attacks: Fly-By
Dvalin disappears from view, then swoops through the center of the platform, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Dvalin's CleansingCharacter Card: Dvalin (Character Card)
Dvalin lands on the player's side of the platform and unleashes a powerful wind blast onto that side, slowly moving towards the center, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG every 0.5s.
Lacerating Slash
Dvalin swipes his head towards the area the player is standing on, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Tempestuous Barrage
Dvalin shoots two pairs of Pulse Bombs towards the player that explode upon impact, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Caelestinum Finale Termini
Dvalin unleashes a rain of Pulse Bombs that causes the platform the character is standing on and adjacent platforms to become cracked, dealing Anemo DMG every 2s to the character standing on them.
Rending VortexAction Card: Rending Vortex

Dvalin dives down, and appears at the other end of the arena and begins charging for an extended period of time. He then unleashes a gigantic pulse bomb towards the platform that deals 200% ATK as Physical DMG to characters on or close to the ground.
Energy Lightning
Dvalin flies around in the air and applies a permanent condition to every platform. Periodically, energy pulses will strike the ground in marked areas, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Paralyzed

Dvalin possesses a non-elemental shield equivalent to 20% of his Max HP. After this shield sustains enough damage to break, he will be paralyzed on the platform for a long period of time. If the player falls out of bounds, the paralyzed state ends early.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. This mushroom quickly absorbs nutrients through its extended column, and its umbrella-shaped cap turns where the wind's flow carries it.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Stretchy Anemo Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Stretchy Anemo Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Stretch Spin
Stretches itself, charges and spins its head around, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.
Vortex Volley
Fires up to 3 projectiles of Anemo energy at the player, each dealing 60% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. Unlike other Fungi, this creature possesses a cap with a luminous tendril sticking out of it. When in danger, it will release small electric orbs as a form of self-defense.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Stretchy Electro Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Stretchy Electro Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Stretch Spin
Stretches itself, charges and spins its head around, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.
Orb Sling
Throws an orb of Electro energy at the player, each dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG on hit.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. These shrooms' caps have hard outer layers derived from concretions of Geo energy. Its bodily structure is also quite likely to be denser than others of its kind so as to withstand the heavy weight of its cap.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift
When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Stretchy Geo Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Stretchy Geo Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Stretch Spin
Stretches itself, charges and spins its head around, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.
Roll
Rolls towards the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. This creature only looks explosive — it is, in fact, a most gentle soul, so long as you don't get too close...
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Stretchy Pyro Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Stretchy Pyro Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Stretch Spin
Stretches itself, charges and spins its head around, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.
Fungus Befall
Shoots itself up into the air and crashes down at the player's location, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: Referred to internally as the "Type Drzislav," this super heavy-class mechanism was jointly developed by the Armory Palace and the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. This giant all-terrain vehicle was originally designed for civilian use, particularly heavy transport, as evidenced by its equipped drills and cutters. However, later production models were militarized with heavy weapons mounted on them. After all, in this mortal world beneath the moon, even the most perfect and divine designs may stray from their original intent, let alone machines born of mortal hands, crafted from humble intentions and flawed from the very beginning.
tips: A super-heavy war machine capable of regulating its own temperature. After receiving Pyro attacks, the Mechanized Fortress will continuously accumulate heat and enter an Overheating state. At this point, if it continues to heat up, the Mechanized Fortress will automatically activate a Cryo Ward to cool itself down. Interrupting the cooling process could significantly disrupt its operations...
attacks: Slam
Briefly flies up before crashing back onto the ground, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG in a moderate AoE.
Turning Sweep
Sweeps the surrounding area with its buzzsaw, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG, then flies to the player before crashing to the ground, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Buzzsaw
Swings its buzzsaw twice in front of it, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Frost Cannon

Fires two projectiles from its cannon, dealing 80% ATK as Cryo DMG, and leaving the ground frozen, which deals 6% ATK as Cryo DMG every 0.5s. Additionally, upon landing, the projectiles explode into smaller ones, each dealing 40% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Melt Combo 1
Fires with its cannon, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG, then sweeps with its buzzsaw, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Melt Combo 2
Sweeps with its buzzsaw, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG, then fires with its cannon, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Overheated State
The Landrover has a unique Fury gauge with a maximum of 600 points. When attacked with Pyro, the gauge increases by 5 points plus an additional 5 points for every Pyro Gauge Unit applied.

lore: A clockwork meka adapted from the Cal. Scherbius type. Unfortunately, aside from its ability to attack, it has no other capabilities. Clockwork meka based on annihilation energy normally produce their energy by utilizing Repeaters composed of special crystals to refine ousia and pneuma from Fontaine's environment. But outside of Fontaine, they can use pre-prepared Energy Blocks to move over short distances for short periods of time. The difference can be observed from the shape of the crystal components on the meka.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and necessitating the use of emergency power to sustain low-end combat actions.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Suppression Specialist Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe twice will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to use elemental attacks for a period of time.
Short-Range Snap Fire
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Fires its gun once, dealing 40% ATK as Physical DMG.
Launch Grenade
This attack is used when Arkhe is unavailable. Fires a single grenade at the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.
Precision Shot
Fires either 1 or 2 consecutive charged beam at the player, each dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Wildgrass Balls
Fires 3 consecutive grenades at the player, each dealing 70% ATK as Dendro DMG upon landing.
Combined Fire
Slowly walks forward and continuously fires bullets at the player while slowly aiming at them, with each bullet dealing 20% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Spread Fire
Fires waves of 4 missiles which mark small areas on the ground and home towards them, each dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG upon landing.

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Hydro, resulting in its present form. Its clear, glass-like body is composed almost entirely of the purest water droplets. Though gentler than most of its kin, once provoked it can instantly shape the surrounding water into razor-sharp blades capable of piercing any unwary intruder's defenses. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Hydro Aura
While not in the Gloomveiled state, the Frostnight Scion has an immutable Hydro aura.
Tail Swipe

Slams its tail at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG. If in the Gloomveiled state, the slam launches a bubble at the player that continuously bounces forward, dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG with each bounce.

Stomps the ground in front of it with its front legs, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG.

Relocates away from the player and releases three bubbles in the spread in front of it that continuously bounce forward, dealing 30% ATK as Hydro DMG with each bounce. This attack is only used while in the Gloomveiled state.

lore: A warrior from the Canopy, and a tribal guardian that patrols the forest valleys and mountain streams. Many wonder if claymores are too heavy to be wielded by the couriers of the Scions of the Canopy, but perhaps it is precisely because their duties are heavier still that a weapon more capable of deterrence is a necessity.

Stabs forward with the butt of his claymore and cleaves down, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Boomerang
Throws his claymore, which rapidly spins and flies in a straight line on the first throw, then in an arc before returning to him, dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG in its path.

lore: A warrior from the Canopy, and a tribal guardian that patrols the forest valleys and mountain streams. Unlike the warriors of other tribes, these warriors, ever swinging around the mountains using their grappling hooks, are always considering how to defeat their opponents with unexpected attacks.

Slashes twice with her sword, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab

Boomerang

lore: A warrior from the Canopy, and a tribal guardian that patrols the forest valleys and mountain streams. It is said that these sword-wielding tribal warriors stand under trees and cut every leaf that falls over the course of a day in order to hone their fighting skills. But just as leaves fall silently, so are the slashes of these swift couriers soundless.
attacks: Slash

lore: Today, with the Oceanids extirpated from Fontaine, strange elemental life forms have appeared in the waters. The elemental spirits that appeared after the calamity lack the elegance and beauty of the Oceanids, and thus have been called "tainted." Though the toxins dissolved in the water have long since been diluted and cleansed, unless there are still containers of pure water somewhere, Fontaine's waters will never again naturally birth Oceanids.
attacks: Bubble Shot
Fires a projectile at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Enraged State

Periodically enters an enraged state where it will use enhanced attacks and become immune to being Frozen. Freezing the Tainted Hydro Phantasm for more than 8 seconds will also force it to enter this state.
Raging Whirl
Extends an arm and spins rapidly while moving towards the player, dealing 40% ATK as Hydro DMG, then performs a stronger final hit, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Furious Smash
Increases the size of its fists and smashes them down at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Slap
While in the enraged state, if the player is close, transforms an arm into a fish and slaps the player twice, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: Today, with the Oceanids extirpated from Fontaine, strange elemental life forms have appeared in the waters. It is said that in Egeria's era, the Oceanids often lived alongside humans, and lived in the springs of clear waters dotted across the lands, and through this, they connected the waters of the world. But most died with their god, and for the survivors, the world no longer has any god they recognize.
attacks: Bubble Shot
Fires a projectile at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Enraged State

Periodically enters an enraged state where it will use enhanced attacks and become immune to being Frozen. Freezing the Tainted Hydro Phantasm for more than 8 seconds will also force it to enter this state.

While in the enraged state, fires a continuous stream of water that deals 40% ATK as Hydro DMG every 0.5 seconds.
Furious Blast
While in the enraged state, fires a large projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Repel
While in the enraged state, if the player is close, charges then inflates itself to deal 100% ATK as Hydro DMG around itself.

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Dendro, resulting in its present form. This entity has a marvelous resonance with the plant life of the groves. Some say that one of the Moonchanters once made a contract with the wooded lands with their help, thus becoming a friend and companion to all life on this land. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Dendro Aura

lore: A young Tatankasaurus that has not yet mastered full control of its powerful frame, leaving its movements clumsy. Its second set of horns are still growing out, and its back and snout are not quite strong enough to smash through rocks that block the road. Given the time to grow, it will one day be able to roam freely across the fertile plains.
attacks: Melee
Attacks with its head, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG.
Charge
Charges at the character, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG on contact.

lore: A saurian with a hard, bony crest and a powerful body suited to dashing around volcanic landscapes. According to legend, the Tatankasaurus's ancestors were so large they could use their horns to move mountains, but they lacked the agility of their smaller, modern relatives. Perhaps the great power that Tatankasaurs still possess is a gift passed down through their bloodline.
attacks: Stomp
Stomps the ground with its fore legs, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG.
Charge
If the player is far away, charges toward the player, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG on hit. Can be stopped by terrain.

lore: A powerful warrior from a land of plenty, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. It is said that the warriors of the Collective of Plenty like to deal powerful strikes while dashing at their foes — a lesson learned from the Tatankasaurs who share their lands. This is especially true for those warriors who wield heavy weapons, and claim the secret to a successful blow is to swing from the hips.
attacks: Melee Combo

Swings his hammer up to 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% + 10% ATK as Physical DMG. The combo may sometimes be cut short to immediately follow with Triple Smash. If the player is far away, dashes towards the player and starts on the second swing.

Smashes with its hammer 3 times, dealing 50% + 25% ATK, 50% + 25% ATK, 70% + 35% ATK as Electro DMG.
Skybreaker
Charges towards the player and swings its hammer twice, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK as Electro DMG. The DMG of the second strike is halved if the first strike hits the same target.

Among the Collective of Plenty, even those warriors who have painstakingly trained to use long-range weapons are known to be skilled in hand-to-hand combat. Perhaps, to them, ranged weapons are better for bludgeoning than firing projectiles.

lore: Abyssal monsters that have descended to this world from the deep, dark depths of a twisted and alien world, they possess a plant-like appearance. It is said that where the corrosive waves of the dark tide lap, such plant-like dark monsters will grow. But they only bear a superficial resemblance to plants, for it is a form they only adopted to get closer to the tree-like world, that they might extract the necessary concepts from it, and analyze and imitate them. Some raving lunatics who have lost their minds say that those things that extend out like leaves are actually the beginnings of gates to other worlds.
tips: An Abyssal monster that has descended to this world from the deep, dark depths of a twisted and alien world, the Tenebrous Mimiflora can mimic various phenomena, and can deploy a Void Ward in combat. Some of its attacks can cause stackable Attrition that, after a time, will cause your active character to lose HP. Use a specific number of Elemental attacks to destroy this creature's Ward. Nightsoul-aligned Elemental attacks can break through its defenses more effectively.
