Abyssal Spheres
While in its true form, shoots 3 homing projectiles, each dealing 20% ATK as Physical DMG and inflicting 1 stack of Attrition on hit.

lore: A pitch-black monster that has descended from an alien world, it plunges its roots of corruption deep into the home of souls and memory. None knows what it gains from this, nor how it will reveal its chaotic nature and twisted self to this world.
attacks: Mimicry
The Tenebrous Papilla comes in 3 possible variants.
Attrition

Some of the Tenebrous Papilla's attacks inflict stacks of Attrition on hit. The amount of stacks inflicted depends on the attack. For each stack, the active character will lose HP equal to 1% Max HP + 50 after a short delay.
Beseech the Dark

After 40 seconds have passed or upon reaching 70% of its Max HP (or immediately upon entering combat in the Spiral Abyss), returns to the center of the arena and gains a Void Ward which grants it immunity to all DMG.
Grounded Charge

Transforms into the Aeonblight Drake, charges at high speed towards the player, then performs a tail sweep, dealing 75% ATK, 75% ATK as Physical DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 15 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Grounded Combo
Transforms into the Aeonblight Drake, attacks twice with its nose and performs a tail sweep, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Energy Surge
Transforms into the Aeonblight Drake, scattering a great number of bombs into the air, dealing 100% ATK when they land as DMG of a random element.
Feather Spreading

Transforms into the Jadeplume Terrorshroom, scatters countless spores into the air that home towards the player, each dealing 45% ATK as Dendro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 5 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Majestic Dance

Transforms into the Jadeplume Terrorshroom, performs a 2-part combo consisting of a sweeping bite and a head slam, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, as Dendro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 5 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Rapid Pecks
Transforms into the Jadeplume Terrorshroom, aimlessly swings its beak 4 times, dealing 120% ATK as Dendro DMG with each swing.
Spin
Transforms into the Cryo Regisvine, flattens and stretches out its petals and spins, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 15 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Thunderbolt Rain
Transforms into the Electro Regisvine, rapidly summons thunderbolts that mark an area before striking down, each dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG.
Faceplant

Transforms into the Pyro Regisvine, slams its face into the ground after locking onto the player's current position, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG on impact and sending tremors through the ground in the direction it faceplants, with each explosion dealing…
Blustering Blade
Transforms into Maguu Kenki, teleports and leaves an Anemo Shadowsword in its original location.
Dual Sword Burst

Transforms into Maguu Kenki, summons an additional sword, charging up before slamming the ground for a wide AoE, dealing 80% ATK as both Anemo DMG and Cryo DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 15 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Ichimonji
Transforms into Maguu Kenki, slashes at the player three times, dealing 50% ATK as Anemo DMG with each slash.
Combo Slash

Transforms into the Primo Geovishap, attack forward twice, and ends with a slam towards the player. Each attack deals 40% ATK, 50% ATK, and 62.5% ATK respectively as Cryo DMG or Hydro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 10 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Leaping Smash
Transforms into the Primo Geovishap, leaps into the air and slams down at the player's location, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG or Hydro DMG.
Primordial Shower

Transforms into the Primo Geovishap, unleashes a blast of pure elemental power in a huge area around it, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG or Hydro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 15 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Clap

Transforms into the Cryo Hypostasis, flies next to the player and forms a large wall, which folds in a "clapping" motion very quickly, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 15 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Rock-Paper-Scissors Combo

Transforms into the Electro Hypostasis, performs a 3-hit combo consisting of a forward punch, a "cutting" attack as a pair of scissors, and a ground slap with a giant hand, dealing 70% ATK, 70% ATK, and 100% ATK Electro DMG.
Wave Slam

Transforms into the Hydro Hypostasis, slaps the ground to release bursts of water in a line ahead. The initial slap deals 66.6% ATK as Hydro DMG, and the subsequent bursts deal 33.3% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Triple Heatblades
Transforms into the Statue of Marble and Brass, launches 3 vertical blades forward, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Raining Melody

Transforms into the Statue of Marble and Brass, performs with its shield-violin and sword-bow, producing 3 rings of musical notes that fall to the ground, each dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 10 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Fulgent Fortissimo

Transforms into the Statue of Marble and Brass, raises its sword as it gathers immense energy, and performs one massive leaping strike, dealing 200% ATK as Pyro DMG in a straight line and may be enhanced to inflict 30 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Tail Swipe
Transforms into the Millennial Pearl Seahorse, performs a 3-part melee attacks by swiping its tail, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Swirling School of Fish
Transforms into the Millennial Pearl Seahorse, conjures a great number of fish-shaped missiles which home in at the player, each dealing 35% ATK as Electro DMG on hit.
Earthshock Descent

Transforms into the Millennial Pearl Seahorse, leaps twice into the air before slamming down at the player's location, dealing 95% ATK as Electro DMG, then raises its front legs to cause another shockwave, dealing 50% ATK as Electro DMG.
Stomp and Wham

Transforms into Kongamato, stomps with one of its feet then rolls and slams its tail on the ground, dealing 50% ATK, 65% ATK as Dendro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 10 stacks of Attrition on hit.
Belly Spin
Transforms into Kongamato, rapidly spins on top of its belly while moving in a straight line, repeatedly dealing 35% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Triple Flamegranate Spit

Transforms into Kongamato, performs up to 3 attacks in sequence: Two ignited Flamegranates, each dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG and may be enhanced to inflict 10 stacks of Attrition on hit, and a massive energy beam, dealing 250% ATK as Pyro DMG and may be…

lore: A young Tepetlisaurus with the ability to tunnel between rocks and solid phlogiston. They have not yet formed the horns on their forehead, and their digging skills are still developing as well. It is even common to hear about young Tepetlisaurs getting trapped by rocks while practicing their digging. However, one day, they will grow into a form that may travel freely through even the toughest of soils.
attacks: Headbutt
Performs a melee attack, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Burrow Strike
Burrows into the ground and moves towards the player. When it reaches the player, leaps out of the ground and attacks, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: A Saurian with a drill-like horn and strong claws that can tunnel through rocks and solid phlogiston. According to legend, the ancestor of all Tepetlisaurs was a massive drake as large as a mountain, with an exceptionally long lifespan. When it slept, mountains would form along its back, and when it woke, it would shake off the dirt and rocks, leaving behind gems and jade shining amongst its scales. The huge, drill-shaped objects in the Children of Echoes are said to be the remains of that great drake's large drill-horn.
attacks: Melee Combo
Attacks with its drill-horn and optionally follows up with a jumping smash, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Burrow Strike
Burrows into the ground and moves towards the player. Optionally, it will briefly resurfaces to taunt the player before re-entering the ground, dealing 30% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: A powerful warrior from the canyon, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. A warrior who can strike with the power of a rockfall. Legend holds that the Sulfurous Veins were once a more complete and more beautiful mountain range, and it was only when the Black Tide came that the Saurian-Crowned warriors of the Children of Echoes carved the earth itself to guide the tide, giving the Veins their current appearance.
attacks: Melee Combo
Swings his saw up to 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG. After the third attack, briefly powers his saw, dealing 10% ATK × 3 as Physical DMG.
Earthshake Saw
Inserts his saw into the ground, dealing 10% ATK as Geo DMG, then powers his saw to create a shockwave, dealing 70% ATK as Geo DMG.
Rockbreaker Blade
Summons a massive crystal and shatters it with his saw, sending shards forward, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.
Trial of Mobility

Right before certain attacks, a white flash will occur, indicating that the attack can be perfect dodged by dodging right before being hit. Upon triggering a perfect dodge, time will briefly slow down, and the player will gain 1 stack, max 6 stacks.
Shield
Upon reaching 70% of his Max HP, gains a shield that grants immunity to all DMG while active. During this time, counterattacks also cannot interrupt the Local Legend's actions.
Saw Dance

Performs 5 consecutive attacks with its saw, dealing 33% ATK, 33% ATK, 33% ATK, 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Geo DMG. The 1st, 3rd, and 5th attacks can be perfect dodged. This attack replaces Rockbreaker Blade when the shield is active.

lore: A powerful warrior from the canyon, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. A warrior who can strike with the power of a rockfall. Even among the Children of Echoes, who live and breathe rock and crystal, Saurian-Crowned Warriors are masters who understand rock and stone better than any. It is said they can even divine the purity and grain of the interior of raw ore merely by looking at the rough exterior.
attacks: Melee Combo
Swings his hammer up to 3 times, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK, 70% + 10% ATK as Physical DMG. The combo may sometimes be cut short to immediately follow with Earthshatter Hammer.
Earthshatter Hammer
Performs an overhead slam with his hammer, dealing 85% ATK as Geo DMG.
Shard Striker
Summons a massive crystal and shatters it with his hammer, sending shards forward, dealing 100% ATK as Geo DMG.

lore: A soldier-entity born into being through the skills of various members of the Hexenzirkel. Although their technological underpinnings are far from abstruse, and touch not upon the profound wisdom at the universe's core, yet as guards of the gate's final threshold, they are a metaphor in and of themselves. This world may be governed by rules, but for those who manage to cross its verge, such constraints no longer apply.
attacks: King's Slam
The King leaps into the air and slams down up to 3 times, moving orthogonally or diagonally up to 1 tile at a time, dealing 72% ATK as Pyro DMG each time.
King's Quake
The King leaps into the air and slams down with greater force, releasing a blast across a 3×3 area, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Summon Knight
If the player is far away, the King summons 3 Knights that leap and slam down at the tile closest to the player in the L-shaped movement pattern, each dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Summon Rook
The King rides a Rook to quickly retreat. Then, summons 2 Rooks that charge toward the player in a straight line, each dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG. May follow up with Summon Knight.
Summon Bishop
The King summons a Bishop and gains an Electro ward that blocks all incoming DMG.
Summon Pawns
The King gains an elementless ward that blocks all incoming DMG and summons 3 Pawns in the C3–F6 area. A Pawn will attack players within a 3×3 area around itself, dealing 40% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Summon Queen
When the King's HP is reduced to 6.25%, it will summon the Queen before leaving the chessboard. After the Queen is defeated, the King will return in a paralyzed state with greatly reduced RES.
Queen's Slam

The Queen leaps into the air and slams down, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG in the tile it lands on plus the orthogonally or diagonally adjacent tiles. This attack may be used twice in a row, in which case both variants are used.
Queen's Detonation
The Queen charges and releases cascading explosions in all 8 directions, each explosion dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Queen's Twinblade

The Queen extends two large blades from its body and spins, moving 1 tile toward the player and dealing 33% ATK × 3 as Pyro DMG. If the first 2 hits both connect, the 3rd hit's DMG is reduced to 19.8% ATK.
Queen's Spears
The Queen charges and fires a large amount of projectiles at the player, each dealing 55% ATK as Pyro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
King's Cleave
The King cleaves down with his greatsword, dealing 75% ATK as Pyro DMG.
King's Ram

The King rams at the player with his belly, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG, then enters a spin, repeatedly dealing 33% ATK as Pyro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
King's Leap

The King straps a Knight to his back, leaps into the air, and strikes down with his greatsword, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. Then, pulls his greatsword out of the ground, sending a line of 3 Bishop-shaped explosions forward, each dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Queen's Bolts
The Queen summons 4 lightning bolts and sends them striking the area in front of her, each dealing 40% ATK as Electro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Queen's Tide
The Queen summons a number of Pawns, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG upon their emergence. The Pawns then fall back down, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG in a ring-shaped area.
Queen's Smash
The Queen summons a Knight at the player's location and smashes it down, dealing 80% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Boil

The Queen summons a vortex of water that pulls the player toward the center and continuously applies Hydro, while the King uses a Knight to spit fire at the player, repeatedly dealing 30% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Dance
The Queen moves toward the player and swipes with her staff, dealing 75% ATK as Electro DMG. The King leaps up and slams down at the player with a Bishop, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Cannon Fire

The King leaps onto a Rook. The Queen will detonate the Rook, dealing 75% King's ATK as Overloaded Pyro DMG and launching the King into the air. The King will slam down with its greatsword, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Charging for Lethal Blow
While charging, a progress bar will appear next to the HP bar of the King (Vaporizing Skysword) or Queen (Sweeping Tsunami). Progress can be increased or decreased as follows:
Lethal Blow: Vaporizing Skysword
The King and the Queen move to the center of the arena. The King begins charging while the Queen summons rain from the sky, continuously applying Hydro to herself, the King, and the player.
Lethal Blow: Sweeping Tsunami
The Queen moves to the center of the arena. The Queen begins charging, summoning a wall of water around the arena and continuously applying Hydro to the player.
Life Share

When either the King or the Queen is downed, if the remaining party's HP is above 20%, they will transfer 50% of their current HP to the downed party, reviving them. During the revival process, their RES to all DMG is increased by 300%.
Berserk
When either the King or the Queen is downed, If the remaining party's HP is below 20%, they will permanently enter a berserk state.

lore: Amidst the snow and ice dwells an ancient king waiting to be awakened by its ice-entombed brethren. In the distant past beyond memory, a certain legend circulated among hunters out in the wild: when the land sealed by ice returns to life and when an uninvited guest disturbs the deep, frozen silence, the lord and leader of the snowboars unto greatness will awaken from slumber, shake off the ice that shackles it, and bring judgment upon those disrespectful interlopers.
attacks: Charge

Charges towards the player up to three (Normal State) or four (Berserker State) times, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on hit. The Great Snowboar King will be stunned if it charges into a wall in its normal state.
Royal Family

Summons four small Snowboars, who will dig snow from the ground along with the Great Snowboar King and launch one or multiple snowballs at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG and temporarily obscuring the player's vision on hit.
Berserker State
Enters Berserker State after it charges into a wall three times, increasing its ATK by 30% and enabling it to use The King's Rage.
The King's Rage
Jumps up and down repeatedly, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG when slamming down, and causing snowballs to fall from the sky, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.

lore: The Knave, Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers.
attacks: Bond of Life
Some of The Knave's attacks will consume 1.5% of her Max HP to unleash. This HP consumption cannot bring The Knave below ~10% of her Max HP.
Ranged Immunity
While The Knave is not performing an attack and the player is far away from her, she will dodge (Above 70% HP) or block (After reaching 70% HP) all incoming attacks.
Slash and Hook
Performs a horizontal slash followed by a hooking pull with her scythe, dealing 20% ATK, 20% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Scythewheel
Launches her scythe in the form of a vertical spinning wheel at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG repeatedly when contacting the player.
Dashcleave
Dashes quickly at the player and slashes once, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG. Upon reaching 70% of her Max HP, she may follow up with a hooking pull, dealing 80% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Reaper Dive
Flies high into the air and dives towards the player, slicing with her scythe to deal 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. Upon reaching 70% of her Max HP, follows up with a wing slash, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Fall of Darkness, Rise of Destruction
Enabled upon reaching 70% of her Max HP. Applies a Bond of Life to all players in the arena. Additionally, she gains 20% DMG Reduction during this ability.
Purgatorial Dance
Leaps onto a hanging thread and launches 2 phantoms at the player, each dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit.
Bloodtide Banquet
After a short charge up, leaps high whilst throwing down multiple sharp threads that detonate after a while, dealing 70% ATK on hit and 100% ATK on detonation as Pyro DMG across a large area.
Agile Leapslash
Enabled upon reaching 70% of her Max HP. Leaps left and right in the air, then towards the player, slicing with her scythe to deal 80% ATK as Pyro DMG. Then follows up with Scythewheel.
Sundering Convergence

Enabled upon reaching 70% of her Max HP. Marks 2 crosses on the ground. 2 blades will slash through the marked ground after a delay, dealing 50% ATK as Pyro DMG twice. DMG dealt by repeated hits is reduced by the Damage Sequence.
Dual Scythe Combo
Spins and throws her secondary scythe at the player and follows up with consecutive slash attacks, dealing 12.5% ATK, 30% ATK, 40% ATK, 40% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Dual Scythewheel

Launches both scythes at the player in the form of spinning wheels, then dashes forward to attack with its spider legs, dealing 70% ATK, 70% ATK + 50% ATK as Pyro DMG. May immediately chain into the 3rd attack of Dual Scythe Combo.
Turning Slash

If the player is behind The Knave in close proximity, slashes with both scythes to turn around, dealing 50% ATK ×2 as Pyro DMG. Immediately chains into Dual Scythe Combo if the player is close or Dual Scythewheel if the player is far.
Bloodbeam
Charges and fires a massive laser beam at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG. Can be chained up to 3 times.
Destruction Upon Destruction

Flies high into the air, launches 2 waves of 3 homing projectiles at the player, each dealing 15% ATK as Pyro DMG on hit, then scatters 6 orbs around the edge of the arena, before finally plunging down at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Bloodtide Banquet

Applies Bond of Life to all players in the arena, then performs one of two attacks:Version 1: Strikes the ground with her fist, causing Balemoon Bloodfire to spike from the ground to deal 75% ATK, 75% ATK, 100% ATK as Pyro DMG in a circle-shaped area, a…

lore: A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being. Though enthroned in the pillar hall high in the heavens, it will in the end fall into the mortal world once it opens its eye... To act in the interest of one's private desire rather than in obedience to the will of the one above is a sin no less grave than the destruction of the world itself. Yet, if even the messenger tasked with delivering the edicts of the lord of all gods cannot discern the will of that capricious being, the difference between "reverently upholding the sacred law" and "wanton acts of blasphemy" then becomes as vaporous as ether itself. The watcher does not know why [[Asmoday
attacks: Descend
Upon entering battle, the boss's spear will fly out of an open portal into the ground, dealing 20% ATK as Geo DMG.
Spear Slam
Levitates its spear above its head before crashing it on the player, dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG.
Spear Thrust
Retreats backwards before readying its spear on its left arm and launching it at the player in a straight line, dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG.
Double Lunge
Performs two lunging thrusts, dealing 41% ATK, 47% ATK as Geo DMG.
Double Slash
Swipes twice at the player, dealing 32% ATK, 34% ATK as Geo DMG.
Forced Teleport
If the player is far away from the Watcher, it will envelop the player in cubes and teleport them next to it.
Leaping Slam
If the player is far away from the Watcher, it may instead leap into the air and dive bomb the player's location in a moderate AoE, dealing 60% ATK as Geo DMG.
Supreme Overseer

Spins its spear around it, dealing 40% ATK as Geo DMG to characters that contact it before entering the Supreme Overseer state with a Fury bar. In this state, the Watcher will monitor any Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo hits taken.
Phenomena's Delirium

After completing two instances of Supreme Overseer, teleports to the center of the arena and summons two Elemental Stars based on the elements recorded during Supreme Overseer to prepare Phenomena's Delirium.

lore: An abnormal Electro elemental life form. Although it might appear similar to an Oceanid, it does not possess her intelligence or memories. That which drives the Thunder Manifestation is a much more primal fury. It is said that these life forms will only descend like lightning upon places that play host to great lingering resentment, such as the fragmented Amakumo Peak, where the storm clouds ever roil. As long as the grudges of the land do not fade, so will the roaring thunder persist.
tips: An elemental life form created as the avatar of thunderous indignation. It uses lightning attacks and its Strike Probes to lock on to its foes. If a locked-on target is present, the Thunder Manifestation will enter an enraged state and prioritize the annihilation of that target.
attacks: Lightning Probes
Flies into the air and releases 5 Lightning Strike Probes around the arena, dealing 16.6% ATK as Electro DMG on landing. They begin pulsing after the Thunder Manifestation uses Close-Range Detection.
Close-Range Detection
Releases a pulse around itself, dealing 83.3% ATK as Electro DMG. If a player is hit by this attack, the Thunder Manifestation immediately locks onto them and enters its enraged state.
Random Strikes
If the player is far from the Thunder Manifestation, flies up and calls forth 2 waves of 8 lightning bolts that strike in a circle around the arena, each dealing 43.3% ATK as Electro DMG.
Slicing Storm

If the player is close to the Thunder Manifestation, curls up and rotates its wings, spinning in place and slicing targets in its way, rapidly dealing 27.7% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack is affected by the Damage Sequence.
Shockwave

After sustaining 10 hits, releases a shockwave around itself that deals 27.7% ATK as Electro DMG around it. When it reaches 74% HP, it will instead release an even larger shockwave that deals 27.7% ATK as Electro DMG across the entire arena.
Blink
Teleports to any point of the arena instantly.
Slicing Storm
Curls up and rotates its wings, spinning forward and slicing targets in its way, rapidly dealing 27.7% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack is affected by the Damage Sequence.
Thunderous Wingslash
Quickly raises one of its wings and smacks at its target, dealing 55.5% ATK as Electro DMG. Only triggered if in melee range.
Strifeful Lightning
Summons two walls of lightning to the target's sides which quickly close in on them, rapidly dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG on contact. This attack is affected by the Damage Sequence.
Sundering Plumes
Forms five sets of electric feathers, and releases them against the target, dealing 28.8% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack is affected by the Damage Sequence.
Dive Bomb
Flies and repositions itself near the border of the arena, then it dives forward in a straight line twice, dealing 83.3% ATK as Electro DMG.
Torrential Descent
Flies up and calls forth 3 waves of 3 lightning bolts to descend upon the target, striking in a line and dealing 43.3% ATK as Electro DMG.
Homing Thunder Cage

Charges up and marks the target with a thunder circle for a short duration. The circle will then stop and activate, creating a spinning electric cage that homes in on the target, dealing 27.7% ATK as Electro DoT if touched or inside of.

lore: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold." Once upon a time, they ran riot across the continent, but they went extinct for a time due to resistance and mass hunts. Recently, however, they have re-emerged. The pack of black wolves that now threaten Springvale and Wolvendom are such creatures.
tips: This is the mature form of a Rifthound Whelp... or so it would seem. However, these monsters do not have natural life cycles, and their growth remains a mystery. The Rifthound attacks can apply stacks of the "Corrosion" status, which will cause all characters in the party to continually lose HP. Additionally, when they take elemental damage from their respective element, Rifthounds will enter an Elemental Devourer state that will allow them to fight more fiercely at the cost of lessened RES to that particular element.
attacks: Corrosion
All of the Thundercraven Rifthound's attacks apply Corrosion on hit.
Devouring Bite
Backs away and readies itself to lunge at the player and bite, dealing 90% ATK as Electro DMG.
Cankering Claws
Swipes at the player twice with its claws, dealing 85% ATK Electro DMG with each swipe.
Corrosive Electro Glaive
If the player is far away, the Rifthound generates a spinning electro crystal glaive on its tail before launching it towards them, dealing 95% ATK Electro DMG on hit.
Tail Swipe
Teleports behind the player and swipes with its tail, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Elemental Devourer
Gains 20% Fury whenever it takes Electro DMG. (Not including DMG from Electro-Charged) When full, the Rifthound gains enhanced attacks at the cost of lower RES]].
Pursuer's Mark
Quickly lunges at the player 2–4 times, dealing 85% ATK as Electro DMG on hit. This attack is only performed while the Rifthound is in the Elemental Devourer state.
Roar
When there are Rifthound Whelps nearby, roars to increase the Rifthound Whelps' ATK by 25% for 10 seconds.

lore: A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. "Gold" classified them as "Alfisol." In times long gone, when giant monstrous beasts descended, large swarms of these hounds would go before them to deliquesce the borders of the world and open the way.
tips: A monster from another world that has the power to corrode material. The Rifthound Whelp's attacks can apply stacks of the "Corrosion" status, which will cause all characters in the party to continually lose HP. Additionally, when they take elemental damage from their respective element, Rifthound Whelps will enter an Elemental Devourer state that will allow them to fight more fiercely at the cost of lessened RES to that particular element.
attacks: Corrosion
All of the Thundercraven Rifthound Whelp's attacks apply Corrosion on hit.
Bite
Lunges at the player and bites, dealing 85% ATK as Electro DMG.
Slash
Teleports to the player and slashes with its claw, dealing 100% ATK as Electro DMG.
Double Slash
At melee range, quickly slashes twice at the player, dealing 65% ATK as Electro DMG with each slash.
Elemental Devourer
Gains 34% Fury whenever it takes Electro DMG. (Not including DMG from Electro-Charged) When full, the Rifthound Whelp decreases its attack cooldowns and its RES]].

lore: A mysterious "lord" of hilichurls that strides through the thunderstorm. This huge hilichurl is referred to as "Lawa" by its brethren. Its giant body is so saturated with Electro energy that Elemental Energy seeps through the cracks in its body in the form of Electro Crystal growths.
attacks: Punches
Roars and performs a punch with its left arm. It occasionally combos with both arms and slams the ground, dealing 37.5% ATK and 40% ATK as Electro DMG.
Infused Thunderhelm

Generates an Electro shield and enters the Thunder Force State for as long as the shield is active. Under this state, it will use more powerful attacks. This shield will degrade over 90 seconds and can be further damaged using Elemental Reactions.
Thunder Berserker

When in its Thunder Force State, the Thunderhelm Lawachurl may roar and proceed to use its attacks in much quicker succession. Starting with Upa Shato, then following up with Surprise Dash, and finishing up with 2 instances of Shockwave.
Dash

The Thunderhelm Lawachurl charges at its target, dealing damage along its path. The windup time and damage are different depending on the variant used and these attacks are only performed when the Thunderhelm Lawachurl is in the Thunder Force State.
Charged Punch
Charges and swings its fist at the player with great force, dealing 37.5% ATK as Electro DMG. This attack is only performed when the Thunderhelm Lawachurl is in the Thunder Force State.
Shockwave

Roars and slams both hands into the ground twice, creating a shockwave and dealing 50% ATK and 62.5% ATK respectively as Electro DMG with each slam. This attack is only performed when the Thunderhelm Lawachurl is in the Thunder Force State.
Jumping Slam
Roars and jumps into the air, slamming down at the player's position, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Slime Throw

If the player is at a higher elevation or too far away, the Lawachurl will roar and grab a Large Electro Slime or Mutant Electro Slime from the ground, throwing it at the player, dealing 62.5% ATK as Electro DMG.
Electro Shards

While in the Thunder Force State, the Thunderhelm Lawachurl's attacks will leave Electro shards on the ground. These shards are Electro objects that can be destroyed by Elemental Reactions, and are weakest to Pyro, Cryo, and Dendro.

thundering_wayob_manifestation.special: Envoy of Night and Wandering Spirits
lore: The Collective of Plenty believe in and worship the Wayob, which manifests upon the land with the power of totems and Nightsouls. According to tribal legend, the Wayob has taken on countless forms. In the dim, pre-dawn darkness, where faces were hidden in shadows, the Wayob would wrestle with the mightiest tribal warriors, with neither side prevailing. The Collective of Plenty believe their Wayob has the power to control thunder and speed, and can bestow abundant harvests upon the land.
tips: The Wayob worshipped by the various tribes of Natlan manifest themselves in the form of these obsidian totems. In battle, the Wayob Manifestation will deploy its Arena: Moment of Trial, creating a Shield for itself and absorbing the Elemental Energy of all characters in the Arena. Characters in the Arena deal greatly increased DMG. If the Shield is broken before the Arena expires, they will also regain a large amount of Energy. However, if they fail to break the Shield, the Manifestation will generate an Elemental Ward based on the value of the remaining Shield.
attacks: Ball Lightning

Summons 5 orbs that revolve around itself, repeatedly dealing 10% ATK as Electro DMG upon contact. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence. The orbs eventually explode, dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG.
Rotor Spin
Performs a spinning attack, dealing 20% ATK × 3 as Electro DMG. Additionally, summons 6 lightning strikes around the edge of the spin's area, each dealing 30% ATK as Electro DMG.
Cascading Thunderbolts
Causes a cascading wave of lightning strikes in front of itself, dealing 30% ATK as Electro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Blink
If the player is far away, teleports toward the player.
Arena: Moment of Trial
Deploys an Arena and gains a non-elemental shield equal to 111.4% of the Wayob Manifestation's Max HP which can be destroyed by dealing DMG.
Ward
Upon absorbing a Duskgrace Orb, restores durablity to an Electro Ward that further reduces DMG taken.
Duskgrace Storm
Teleports to the center of the arena, then transforms into a ball of energy that repeatedly deals 30% ATK as Electro DMG upon contact.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. This person was originally a miner — one who, even with the allowance they were provided with after the closure of the Chasm, ended up with the Treasure Hoarders for various reasons.
attacks: Swing
Swings their hammer once at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.
Double Swing
Performs 2 swings with their hammer, The attack speed is different depending on the variant used.
Charged Double Swing
Performs 2 slower but more powerful swings with wider reach, each dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. Cryo Potioneers are quite the welcome sight amongst the Treasure Hoarders due to their elixirs having the ability to rapidly cool things down. Even out in the wild where there are no Mist Flowers to be found, they can have some cold liquor to make merry with.
attacks: Molotov Throw

Throws a bottle of Cryo potion at the player's location. The shattered potion leaves behind elemental residue of its contents, dealing 70% ATK as Cryo DMG on impact and 30% ATK as Cryo DoT until it dissipates.
Kick
If the player is within melee range, performs a spinning kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "Potioneer" is the nickname given to members of the Treasure Hoarder organization who know how to brew up dangerous chemicals. "What? Did you think this treasure has 'Adventurers' Guild' written all over it or something?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Potioneer during a confrontation with adventurers
attacks: Molotov Throw

Throws a bottle of Electro potion at the player's location. The shattered potion leaves behind elemental residue of its contents, dealing 70% ATK as Electro DMG on impact and 30% ATK as Electro DoT until it dissipates.
Kick
If the player is within melee range, performs a spinning kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "They say that we stand on the shoulders of giants. That means digging up the accumulated wealth of our forebears, taking them with us, and... uh, returning them to the economic cycle! What a noble endeavor, am I right?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Gravedigger, while delving deep into a ruin.
attacks: Dirt Throw
Shovels some dirt into their spade before throwing it at the player, dealing no DMG but temporarily obscuring the player's vision on hit.
Smack
If the player is within melee range, swings their spade at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. These members do physical work and are lower on the pecking order. They are often laughed at for their physique — but when the gang comes under attack, they get a chance to show their unexpectedly high strength and agility.
attacks: Kick
Performs a single spinning kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Kick
Performs 3 consecutive spinning kicks, each dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. The last kick covers a wider range and causes heavy knockback.
Dropkick
Dropkicks the player, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.
Taunt
Quickly shuffling his feets position before hand gesturing the player to come. The taunt is quick but it still leaves him vulnerable.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. They say that some Treasure Hoarder Potioneers used to be charlatans who would wander villages, towns, and cities, hawking their special blends of elixirs, holy waters, and the like. These cure-alls certainly seem to serve better in combat than they ever did in chicanery.
attacks: Molotov Throw

Throws a bottle of Hydro potion at the player's location. The shattered potion leaves behind elemental residue of its contents, dealing 70% ATK as Hydro DMG on impact and 30% ATK as Hydro DoT until it dissipates.
Kick
If the player is within melee range, performs a spinning kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. Though they are called "marksmen," this name has an undercurrent of mockery to it, as they use crossbows instead of bows, which require a long period of training to use. It must be said that even hilichurls know how to operate a crossbow. Just point the wider end at the enemy, pull the trigger, and bam — that's all there is to it.
attacks: Crossbow Shot
Shoots a bolt from their crossbow at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. Passionate about battle and muscles, they are quite picky about food and will often boast of the benefits of having a fine musculature, leading to some dissatisfaction from their fellow Treasure Hoarders.
attacks: Punch
Performs up to 2 punches with their left hand, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG. Punching twice can sometimes lead to Charged Punch as a follow-up.
Charged Punch
Lunges towards the player and punches with their right hand, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. Risk-takers who utilize their knowledge of chemistry to mix volatile and flammable brews that aid in their comrades' dastardly deeds.
attacks: Molotov Throw

Throws a bottle of Pyro potion at the player's location. The shattered potion leaves behind elemental residue of its contents, dealing 70% ATK as Pyro DMG on impact and 30% ATK as Pyro DoT until it dissipates.
Kick
If the player is within melee range, performs a spinning kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. Theirs is the legwork and the tailing of targets. They usually wind up in criminal circles due to poverty or lack of education, but they don't seem to have gotten any richer after choosing a life of crime...
attacks: Throwing Knife
Aims and throws a small knife at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Roundhouse Kick
If the player is within melee range, performs a spinning kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG and causing heavy knockback.

lore: A member of the decentralized criminal organization that has footprints all over the continent and even deep within unknown domains. "Stealing? What do you mean, stealing? It's re-discovery, I tell you — the return of treasure to those who appreciate it! Makes everyone happy, to boot! How great is that, eh?" —A certain Treasure Hoarder Seaman, in response to a question posed by a doubtful recruit
attacks: Oar Swing
Slowly swings their oar at the player, dealing 120% ATK as Physical DMG.
Rapid Swing Charge
Becomes visibly angry before charging at the player, swinging their oars wildly, rapidly dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG with each hit and 200% ATK as Physical DMG with the final swing.

lore: This type of clockwork meka was designed to search out, repel, and if need be exterminate aquatic life forms that pose a threat to underwater equipment. Ever since the first diluvian period, the Fontaine Research Institute has been preoccupied with the thought that there might be a second one. Some had the idea of taking back the ruins lost to the waves and building an underwater city, whereas others looked up to the untouchable sky islands overhead with the intention of building a metropolis in the clouds. Underwater Patrol Meks were conceived by the former, but judging from the results, it is the latter that have gained the upper hand in recent years.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and its combat capabilities.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Underwater Patrol Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to attack for a long period of time.
Wind Shot
Launches a projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Torpedo
Launches a homing projectile at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG on hit.

lore: A clockwork meka designed for underwater surveying. In the absence of significant breakthroughs in dynamics research, kinematics research has had the most significant impact on clockwork meka design. For machines designed to perform specific tasks, biomimesis has sometimes provided the most convenient solutions.
tips: A machine created from the union between Fontaine's intricate device and special energy technologies. Based on whether it's imbued with ousia or pneuma energy, the machine will operate differently in battle. When either energy is annihilated upon being attacked by its opposite, an Overloaded state will be induced, causing the machine to lose energy and its combat capabilities.
attacks: Arkhe-Powered

Underwater Survey Meks are powered by either or and will use different attacks depending on their Arkhe alignment. Hitting it with the opposite Arkhe will cause it to lose Arkhe and become unable to attack for a period of time.
Bubble Shot
Fires a bubble at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.
Ram
Charges at the player, dealing 100% ATK as Hydro DMG.

lore: "Homu, homu, mimi domu!"
attacks: Briefcase Smack
When in melee range, smacks the player with its briefcase, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back.
Rapid Throw
Throws 3 projectiles in the form of Primogems and Cabbages at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Doll Toss
When out of melee range, digs a Homu doll out of its briefcase to throw it at the player, dealing 100% ATK as AoE Physical DMG.
Summon Help
During the Mimi Tomo event, it could call its comrades to assist it in battle, which included the following enemies:

lore: An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Anemo, resulting in its present form. The flowing wind has spun an extra pair of wings for it. As it almost never leaves footprints on the ground, it's also known as the one who walks with the wind. In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.
tips: An elemental lifeform that has gained an extremely high elemental affinity over long years of exposure to the moonlight. In battle, Frostnight Scions can convert themselves to enter a Gloomveiled state. While in this state, Frostnight Scions become more powerful. Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.
attacks: Slash
Performs a slash with its left wing, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG. If in the Gloomveiled state, may perform another slash and a cross slash with both wings, dealing 80% ATK, 80% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Flying Slam
Flies into the air and slams down onto the player, dealing 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Stomp
Stomps the ground in front of it with its front legs, dealing 70% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Gloomveil

Periodically enters a Gloomveiled state, increasing its RES to all DMG except Anemo by 50%, enhancing its attacks, and gaining the ability to relocate by disappearing and reappearing, but also losing its immunity to Anemo (Anemo RES in this state is 100%).
Back Kick
Performs a kick with its hind legs, dealing 70% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Dart Barrage
Unleashes a burst of 5 homing wind darts in front of it that each deal 30% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit. This attack can only be used while in the Gloomveiled state.

lore: A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya. With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, they possess a feral instinct for bringing their own power to bear. Should an untrained human face such a Volkodlak with weapons in hand, victory would undoubtedly belong to the latter.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Blunt Strike
Charges up briefly before swinging their weapon, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Slam
Charges up briefly before raising their weapon and slamming it down, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Melee Combo

Roars and imbues themselves with elemental energy, after which they perform a combo of Blunt Strike and Slam, and convert these damages into Cryo DMG, Geo DMG or Pyro DMG as their elements, depending on the basher's elemental affiliation — brown…

lore: A relatively large and powerfully built type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya. With the strength of beasts and humanoid bodies, their powerful upper bodies allow them to throw with greater force and precision. Volkodlak may not excel at shaping Prime Ice or wielding elemental power, but among the many fae lineages, few can match their command over physical strength.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Swipe
Swipes at the player with their claws, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Headbutt
Rears their head back before lunging at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Flask Throw
If far from the player, grabs a flask from their pouch and hurls it at them, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Combo
Roars and imbues itself with elemental energy, after which they use one of two following combos depending on the player's distance from them.

lore: A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya. With their swift movements and senses keener than a human's, they can evade many attacks in battle by instinct alone, making them quite troublesome opponents in close-quarters combat.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Slash
Performs a backhand swing with their weapon, dealing 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Slam
Charges up before performing a small leap into the air and slamming their weapon down, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Combo

Howls and imbues themselves with elemental energy, after which they perform two instances of Slash followed by an instance of Slam, and change their damages into Dendro DMG, Electro DMG or Pyro DMG, depending on the raider's elemental affiliation —…

lore: A relatively small and agile type of Volkodlak found among the many that roam Snezhnaya. They possess senses keener than those of humans. Whether in their perception of wind speed or their vision under certain conditions, these traits give them unique advantages, allowing them to achieve far greater accuracy than ordinary people when firing bows, crossbows, or cannons from long range.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Single Shot
Fires a single shot from their weapon, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Triple Shot

Howls and imbues themselves with elemental energy, after which they fire three rapid shots from their weapon, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG (for sharpshooters with green horns/markings), Cryo DMG (for sharpshooters with azure horns/markings), and Anemo…

lore: A Volkodlak that has become extremely powerful after inheriting more of the mighty power in its bloodline. Their clan once prospered to the point that they could serve as an independent army under the King of Beasts. Yet after the Belyi Tsar, master of the Pale Star's royal court, unified the frozen lands, the clan's relatively small losses in the war caused them to fall under suspicion. They gradually declined, and by the time the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, they had withdrawn from the center of power in Snezhnaya. Today, most wolf-pack Volkodlak make their homes in the snowy plains and mountain forests.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Single Shot
Fires a single arrow at the player either while standing or crouched, dealing 60% ATK as Cryo DMG when standing, or 70% ATK as Cryo DMG when crouched.
Double Shot
Fires two arrows at once, dealing 50% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Triple Shot

Imbues her bow with Cryo energy before firing three homing shots at the player. The arrows deal 100% ATK Cryo DMG. The middle arrow will always hit first, while the side arrows will follow-up immediately and hit simultaneously.
Kick
If the player is too close to the hunter, she may perform a roundhouse kick, dealing 60% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Leap
If the player is too close to the hunter, she may jump a short distance away.
Burrow

Burrows into the ground and summons a single Hindering Root. This root indicates where she will reappear. If destroyed before she reappears, she will appear on the spot and becomes stunned for 13 seconds.
Arrow Shower
Summons two Hindering Roots and launches a rapid barrage of six arrow showers in a moderate AoE on the player's location.
Triple Shot

Imbues her bow with Cryo energy before firing three homing shots at the player. The arrows deal 90% ATK Cryo DMG. Repeated hits from the side arrows are reduced accordingly to the Damage Sequence. Stellar Reaction effect is the same as the normal version.

lore: A priestess of the Masters of the Night-Wind who has lived apart from her tribe, honing her abilities in utter solitude. It is said that her Spiritspeaking powers surpass those of ordinary priests and shamans, a result of having had the protection of the Masters of the Night-Wind's Wayob bestowed upon her. Both a blessing and a curse, these powers were at first beyond her ability to control, which was why she set out to master them in isolation from her tribe. Though she has since done so, to this day she still lives in seclusion, a habit that has earned her a reputation as a loner and a recluse. Rumor has it, however, that she is more than willing to teach those who seek her guidance — though always on her own terms...
tips: The Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker will summon identical Radiant Reflections and hide amongst them. Destroy all the Radiant Reflections' Elemental Wards during this time to reveal and weaken the real body. Additionally, Iktomisaurs and Masters of the Night-Wind characters can Hold their Aim over Radiant Reflections to pause their movement for a short time...
attacks: Paint Splash
Spins her staff, dealing 25% ATK as Cryo DMG, and releases a blast forward, dealing 100% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Double Sweep
Performs 2 paintbrush strokes, dealing 60% ATK, 75% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Gliding Sweep
Releases a blast around herself to propel herself up, dealing 36% ATK as Cryo DMG, then glides towards the player and performs 2 paintbrush strokes, dealing 85% ATK, 85% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Snowball
Fires a snowball at the player, dealing 95% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Chilling Blast
Marks a circle at the player's location and deals 100% ATK as Cryo DMG up to 3 times consecutively.
Radiant Reflections

Returns to the center of the arena to initiate a ritual, dealing 75% ATK as Cryo DMG around herself. Marks 4 circles on the ground, and at the location of each circle, deals 25% ATK as Cryo DMG and spawns a Radiant Reflection.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. Putting Fungi on ice does not make them taste any better, but it does at least help with relieving the heat.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Whirling Cryo Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Whirling Cryo Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Fungus Art: Senho
Digs underground and approaches before jumping out and bumping the player, dealing 60% ATK as Cryo DMG.
Whirling Bump
Rapidly spins before bumping into the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. Research has shown that this sort of fungal beast's internal electric current will change periodically. If further developed, perhaps this study may give rise to a wide range of uses...
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Whirling Electro Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Whirling Electro Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Whirling Rush
Rapidly spins while charging at the player, dealing 60% ATK as Electro DMG.
Whirling Bump
Rapidly spins before bumping into the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A spore organism of some intelligence. It possesses extreme adaptability. Due to the abundant amount of Pyro these creatures contain, they have a tendency to cause forest fires during dry seasons, and thus are considered a dangerous invasive species to the forest.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift

When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Whirling Pyro Fungus will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Whirling Pyro Fungus can only undergo state shift once.
Explode
Inserts itself into the ground and produces an explosion after charging, dealing 60% ATK as Pyro DMG.
Whirling Bump
Rapidly spins before bumping into the player, dealing 30% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come. All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.
tips: A ghoul corrupted by the taint of the Abyss, doomed to stalk the frozen wilderness for all eternity... Those who march beneath the banner of the Wild Hunt can only be truly defeated by reducing their Max HP to zero. Drain its HP completely or use Skills enhanced by Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam to send it into a brief Grief-Stricken state, during which, you can deal DMG to reduce its Max HP and suppress it completely!
attacks: Teleport
Teleports towards the player to close the distance. Out of combat Wilderness Exiles will teleport around the area they are roaming in.
Claw Strike
Swipes their hand at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG. May follow up with Pincer.
Pincer
Performs a pincer attack with their arms, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Headbutt
Jerks slightly before charging at the player with their head once or twice, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Orb of Corrosion
Throws an orb of abyssal energy at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Grief-Stricken State
After its HP is depleted to 0, the Wilderness Exile will enter a Grief-Stricken state instead of dying immediately.

lore: A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come. Many great champions of a lost ancient kingdom lie buried beneath the frozen northlands. Though the remnants of the past have been long wiped clean, these noble spirits yet defend their golden homeland. Awakened by Abyssal taint, these warriors now see all who trespass as prey.
tips: A ghoul corrupted by the taint of the Abyss, doomed to stalk the frozen wilderness for all eternity... Those who march beneath the banner of the Wild Hunt can only be truly defeated by reducing their Max HP to zero. Drain its HP completely or use Skills enhanced by Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam to send it into a brief Grief-Stricken state, during which, you can deal DMG to reduce its Max HP and suppress it completely!
attacks: Melee Combo 1
Performs a two-hit combo consisting of an axe swing and a cleave, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Melee Combo 2

Performs a three hit combo consisting of an axe swing, a hand slam, and a stronger axe swing, dealing 80% ATK, 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG. The first or final attacks may be omitted, in which case the combo may be followed by Grab.
Grab
Its hand glows before it quickly lunges forward and grabs at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Axe Throw
Throws a spinning axe at the player, dealing 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Abyssal Frenzy

Temporarily discards its axe and tears its chest open with its axe hand, causing a barrage of homing abyssal projectiles to burst out of it that travel on erratic trajectories and deal 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Grief-Stricken State
After its HP is depleted to 0, the Wilderness Hunter will enter a Grief-Stricken state instead of dying immediately.

lore: An elite agent among the Fatui. "Operatives" have no ordinary military rank among the Fatui. Based on their orders and the content of their missions, they can work in concert with other soldiers, work alone, or in tandem with the "tacks" hidden and scattered across the world. They spy, conduct counter-espionage, protect, assassinate, and conduct other tasks. In order to effectively carry out missions of a more special nature, "Operatives" also need to master all kinds of other skills and even various arts and talents.
tips: An elite Fatui special agent who can manipulate Anemo in battle. In combat, they will use the Hunt Down skill to attach a Bond of Life to characters they hit. While Bond of Life is active, the character will take continuous DMG, and Hunt Down will deal more DMG to them.
attacks: Fakeout

Raises a barrier in front of herself. If attacked from the front while the barrier is active, the DMG dealt will be nullified and the Operative will teleport to the player's location and strike down with her cane, dealing 70% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Spikefield
Marks an area around the player and deals 100% ATK as Anemo DMG in that area.
Galeshot
Consecutively fires 1, 1, and 2 wind orbs at the player. Each orbs deals 50% ATK in the first 2 waves and 60% ATK in the final wave respectively as Anemo DMG on hit.
Hunt Down

Sacrifices 5% of her Max HP (or 25% of current HP if HP percentage is under 20%) to initiate Hunt Down: Locks onto the player, teleports her cane above the player which then strikes down, dealing 90% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Bloody Pursuit

On Fearless/Dire difficulty in Stygian Onslaught, interruption RES completely amplified, making characters abilities impossible to interrupt and when preparing to use Hunt Down, it will enter the Bloody Pursuit state:

lore: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability. Going well past mere appearances, this being even imitates the habits of birds. When it flies about, it will scatter icy flowers in its wake. These crystal cores, too, are spores. This creature has a position of command amongst colonies of fungal beasts and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift
When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Winged Cryoshroom will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Winged Cryoshroom can only undergo state shift once.
Slap
Slaps the player twice with its wings, dealing 70% ATK, 85% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A mimetic life form made out of spores that has extreme adaptability. Going well past mere appearances, this being even imitates the habits of birds. It can use its spore-built wings to fly in the sky, spreading yet more spores to yet more distant places. This creature has a position of command amongst colonies of Fungi and exhibits heightened intelligence to match.
tips: A monster with basic intelligence that evolved from spores. When first hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, it will enter either an Activated or a Scorched state based on the elemental attack type used. Defeat this transformed fungus to obtain different types of rewards...
attacks: State Shift
When hit by Electro or Pyro attacks, the Winged Dendroshroom will enter an Activated or Scorched state respectively, gaining enhanced attacks. A Winged Dendroshroom can only undergo state shift once.
Slap
Slaps the player with its wings, dealing 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Spore Bullet
Conjures an orb at its tail and throw it at the player, dealing 70% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Divebomb
Dives down from above and throws 2 bombs at the player, with each bomb dealing 85% ATK as Dendro DMG.

lore: A winged Vila capable of flight. Records show that in the century after the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, the Vila went through many turbulent periods. Among them were fae who launched small-scale rebellions out of dissatisfaction with the Tsaritsa's policies toward the fae nobility. The rebellions were soon suppressed, but the fact that their leaders were descendants of the old Vila nobility once led to a major split within the Vila people.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Halberd Throw
Charges up and forcefully hurls her halbrerd as an arrow at the player, dealing ?% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Halberd Slash
Performs an upward slash followed by up to 2 horizontal slashes, each dealing ?% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Halberd Thrust
Plunges her spear into the ground, dealing ?% ATK as Anemo DMG.

lore: A winged Vila capable of flight. It's said that the Vila were among the fae clans that followed the Belyi Tsar from the very beginning of his campaign to unify the frozen lands. Their ability to take brief flight gives them exceptional mobility, allowing them to scout enemy formations and carry out long-distance raids with ease. Most members of the Druzhna, the personal guard founded during the Belyi Tsar reign, were Vila.
tips: In Snezhnaya, many opponents can be affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction, which can cause them to lose the ability to use certain skills. Make use of the Stellar Glimmer reaction to create an advantage for you on the field!
attacks: Sword Throw
Charges up sword as an arrow and fires it at the player, dealing ?% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Sword Slash
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword attacks, each dealing ?% ATK as Anemo DMG.

lore: A warrior from the clifftops, and a tribal guardian that patrols the steep mountain ridges. Proud sword wielders whose blade strokes are as sweeping as a Qucusaur's outstretched wingspan. Blood sprays forth like scattered feathers from the wounds they inflict.
attacks: Slash
Slashes twice with her sword, dealing 75% ATK, 80% ATK as Physical DMG.
Stab
Lunges forward and stabs once, dealing 85% ATK as Physical DMG.
Flying Axekick
Performs an airborne flip and cleaves down at the player with her heel, dealing 120% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A warrior from the clifftops, and a tribal guardian that patrols the steep mountain ridges. By observing and emulating the claw strikes of airborne Saurians, these warriors have grasped the essence of harnessing their own power. Their kicks, delivered from up high, should not be underestimated.
attacks: Slash
Slashes twice with his claymore, dealing 90% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Cleave
Stabs forward with the butt of his claymore and cleaves down, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Flying Axekick
Performs an airborne flip and cleaves down at the player with his heel, dealing 120% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: A warrior from the clifftops, and a tribal guardian that patrols the steep mountain ridges. These tribal warriors trust their own two hands more than any weapon. Above all else, they are renowned for their lithe and agile bearing.
attacks: Punch
Punches twice, dealing 80% ATK, 90% ATK as Physical DMG.
Kick
Performs a kick, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Flying Axekick
Performs an airborne flip and cleaves down at the player with her heel, dealing 120% ATK as Pyro DMG.

lore: The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses. Hilichurl warriors who have wooden shields. These shields are not only sturdy defensive tools but also treasured items within the tribe. According to many reports, hilichurls will often charge at travelers making camp to cook and will snatch their pot lids after chasing them away.
tips: Wards off attacks using a wooden shield, which is comprised of Dendro. Maybe there's a way to set it on fire.
attacks: Wood Shield

The Wooden Shield Hilichurl Guard's shield and club are considered objects, and can be burned and destroyed with Pyro. It is possible to burn only the shield and leave the club intact, and vice versa.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Hit
Swings its club at the player once, dealing 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Jump and Hit
Charges and swings its club at the player powerfully, dealing 200% ATK as Physical DMG and knocking the player back.
Swing That Club
Performs 3 consecutive swings at the player, dealing 100% ATK, 100% ATK, 125% ATK with each swing as Physical DMG.
Rock Throw
Digs a small rock out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Punch
Approaches and swings its fist at the player, dealing 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Rock Throw
Digs a small rock out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.

lore: A muscular hilichurl who has been forged in countless fights. They know how to use Dendro Slimes to create tough shields which they wield in combat. With their powerful muscles, glossy fur, and sturdy, reliable silhouettes, they help the hilichurls withstand the pitiless assaults of adventurers, and they hold a rather exalted rank amongst the tribes.
tips: Wards off attacks using a large wooden shield, which is comprised of Dendro. Maybe there's a way to set it on fire.
attacks: Crudewood Greatshield
The Wooden Shieldwall Mitachurl is equipped with a shield, which blocks incoming DMG from the direction that it is facing. can be burned and destroyed with Pyro unless it reacts with another element.
Shield Charge

Charges towards the player with its shield, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players in its path. At the end of the charge, swings its shield at the player, dealing an additional 100% ATK as Physical DMG.
Charge
When without its shield, charges towards the player character with brute force, rapidly dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG to players in its path.
Smack
If the player strays too close, swings it shield or delivers a punch with its fist, dealing 100% ATK or 75% ATK as Physical DMG.
Dendro Slime Throw
If the player is at a different elevation or is out of range, the Mitachurl roars before digging a Dendro Slime out of the ground and throws it at the player, dealing 50% ATK as Physical DMG.
Shield Recreation
When without its shield, digs a Dendro Slime out of the ground to create a new shield.

lore: Xuanwen Beasts, named for the dark patterns on their bodies, are fierce creatures that inhabit the mountains of Chenyu Vale. In the region's folklore, these beasts were the servants of an adeptus in ancient times, tasked with vanquishing evil and protecting the region. However, they devolved into brutal creatures after said adeptus passed away. These legends cannot be verified, and no one knows the true identity of this adeptus. This much is for sure, however — one should stay away from these aggressive creatures for one's safety. For over a thousand years, these beasts have lost a tremendous amount of territory that once belonged to them to relentless human encroachment. These days, they can only occasionally be spotted in the remote mountains of Chenyu Vale...
tips: An illuminated beast that dwells deep within the mountains. Use Elemental Reactions to freeze this creature and use Shatter, Melt, and other Elemental Reactions to break the ice and render it immobile temporarily.
attacks: Double Swipe
Swipes its claws for two melee strikes, dealing 50% ATK, 60% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Charged Swipe
Forms a vortex around its claw and performs a single swipe, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Windblade
Performs a flip, launching a wind blade from its tail towards the player, dealing 80% ATK as Anemo DMG on hit.
Orb Volley
Conjures 4 water orbs and fires them at the player, each dealing 25% ATK as Hydro DMG on hit.
Chase
If the player is far away, charges at the player and attacks twice with its claws, dealing 60% ATK, 100% ATK as Anemo DMG.
Frozen Weakness
Freezing a Xuanwen Beast then using Shatter, Melt, Superconduct, Swirl, or Crystallize to remove the Frozen aura will paralyze it.

lore: A young Yumkasaurus with the ability to spit Flamegranate pectin hidden in their cheek pouches out, wrapping around distant objects. Their hold on pectin-coated objects isn't strong enough, nor is their sense of balance good enough to allow them to move freely through the air. Sometimes, they'll even fall over to one side just sitting on their tails. However, one day, they will grow into the form that can swing freely between the trees without a care.
attacks: Kick
Bounces off its fluffy tail, attacking with its claws, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Grappling Strike
Uses its tongue to swing itself forward, performing a headbutt, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG.

lore: A Saurian with powerful hind legs and a fluffy tail, capable of spitting Flamegranate pectin hidden in their cheek pouches out, wrapping around distant objects. According to legend, the original Yumkasaurs were not at all like today, but much smaller, so small that they were difficult even to see. They could roam freely with the wind, cling to the bodies of the massive dragons, or gather in groups to move about like clouds. However, in order to maintain their form after their abilities degenerated, they had no choice but to assume their current shape.
attacks: Tail Whirl
Swings its tail in a circle, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Claw Strike
Bounces off its fluffy tail, attacking with its claws, dealing 50% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Grappling Somersault
Uses its tongue to swing itself forward, performing a front flip and attacking with its claws, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG.

lore: A powerful warrior from the Canopy, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. A warrior who can use a grappling hook to extend their attack range. Following intricate mechanical tinkering, the handcannon they wield can be fired using said grappling hook. For the Saurian-Crowned warriors of the Scions of the Canopy, refining one's skills and thought is more important than training the spirit and will.
attacks: Melee Combo
Performs up to 2 melee strikes with her cannon, dealing 50% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG.
Scattershot
Hooks herself over towards the area around her before firing 8 bullets at once, each dealing 30% ATK as Dendro DMG. Repeated hits have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Cannon Shot
Loads ammo into her cannon, then fires a cannonball at the player, each dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Flowing Skyfire

Swings her cannon using a thread, dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG, then scatters 9 cannonballs into the sky, each dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG upon landing. Repeated hits from cannonballs have their DMG reduced according to the Damage Sequence.
Grapple

After using Flowing Skyfire, three grapple points will spawn in the air. The Local Legend will hang from one of the grapple points and shoot bullets at the player, each dealing 66% ATK as Dendro DMG. She will periodically move to a different grapple point.

lore: A powerful warrior from the Canopy, whose bravery has been acknowledged and for which they may wear the Saurian Crown. A warrior who can use a grappling hook to extend their attack range. Grappling hooks are an indispensable part of daily life for the Scions of the Canopy. However, only the wildest warriors will combine the hooks with sawblades to create a weapon both exceptionally lethal and difficult-to-control.
attacks: Melee Combo 1
Swings his saw twice, dealing 60% ATK, 60% ATK as Physical DMG.
Melee Combo 2
Swings his saw horizontally then either up or down, dealing 60% ATK, 70% ATK as Physical DMG. If the second attack is swung down, briefly powers his saw, dealing 10% ATK × 3 as Physical DMG.
Hook and Slash
Hooks himself forward towards the player, riding on his saw while dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit, then follows with a horizontal slash, dealing 80% ATK as Dendro DMG.
Whirling Leaves
Imbues his saw and lashes twice, dealing 80% ATK, 80% ATK as Dendro DMG, then hurls the infused blade, tossing it forward, and retracts it, dealing 100% ATK as Dendro DMG on hit.
